segments.he: וע"כ נוהגין ללוש מצת מצוה בערב פסח אחר שש שעות, כי זה עיקר השלימות בבחי' סור מרע ועשה טוב לבער החמץ תחלה בזמנו וכשמגיע זמן איסור החמץ מן התורה שאז עיקר זמן חורבן והכנעת הסט"א אז עיקר הזמן לעסוק בבנין המלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' מצת מצוה:
segments.en:
Siman 242 — To Be Careful in the Honor of Shabbos
 סִימָן רמ״ב — לְהִזָּהֵר בִּכְבוֹד שַׁבָּת

 
 [§1]
 The matter of Shabbos has already been partially explained in the book 
 Yikara d'Shabbata [that appears in the source work]. 
 But nonetheless I said to explain here also some main headings of this.

segments.he: וע"כ אין לשין במקום השמש ולא סמוך לחום התנור בכדי שלא ישלוט בה החמימות דסט"א: וע"כ לא יניחו העיסה בלי עסק אפילו רגע אחת, כי צריך לידע שהשונא עומד ואורב עליו מכל צד ובכל רגע ועיקר שליטתו בעת שהאדם פנוי ובטל מעסק תורה או מצוה, וזה שאמרו כל זמן שמתעסקין בו אפילו כל היום אינו מחמיץ, כי על ידי העסק נותנין כח במלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' העיסה שלא יוכל החימוץ לשלוט ולהתאחז בה, ואם הניחו בלא עסק שיעור מיל שהוא בחי' תחום שבת תחום וגבול הקדושה שהיא בחי' מלכות (עיין מאורי אור) הוי חמץ, וגם שיעור מיל הוי ח"י מינוטין ובזה נפגם בחי' החיות דקדושה והתגבר החמץ סיטרא דמותא ח"ו (ויש אומרים שמיל הוא שיעור שני חומשי שעה וכו' עיין שו"ע), ואחר שנתעסקו בבצק ונתחמם בידים אם יניחוהו בלא עסק מיד יחמיץ כי אז מתגבר הסט"א ביותר בכדי לקבל יניקה מהקדושה כידוע ע"כ צריכין ליזהר אז בשמירה יתירה ביותר:
segments.en:
[§2]
 For the holiness of Shabbos encompasses the completeness of all the holy rectifications mentioned above — 
 for Shabbos is the aspect of tachlis [ultimate purpose] of heaven and earth — 
 and the ultimate purpose of all is only 
 "in order that they know Him" — as stated — 
 and this is impossible except through the rectifications mentioned above. 
 And therefore they are all encompassed in the holiness of Shabbos.

segments.he: וע"כ אין מתעסקין במצת מצוה ע"י עכו"ם שהוא מצד הסט"א ואפילו ע"י ישראל שהוא אינו בר דעת ואין לו חלק בשכל דקדושה כגון חרש שוטה וקטן אסור ג"כ. וע"כ גדולי ישראל היו מתעסקין בעצמן במצת מצוה בכל כחם כי כל מה שמתעסק בה בר דעת גדול ביותר ובכל כחו על ידי זה משפיע בה כח גדול ביותר וממקום גבוה ועליון ביותר, ועל כל פנים יהיו עומדין בעצמן בשעת עשייתן ומזרזין את העוסקין בהם כי על ידי שנעשה הכל בהשגחתו נמשך עליה גם כן הארה יתירה ביותר וגם כפשוטו כי כל מה שדעתם גדולה ביותר ממילא נזהרין בשמירת המצת מצוה בזהירות יתירה ביותר:
segments.en:
[§3]
 For Shabbos is the aspect of Shabbas Malkesa [the Sabbath Queen] — 
 the aspect of holy Malchus — 
 and corresponding to her is the first Shabbos meal on Friday night — 
 the aspect of Chakkal Tapuchin Kadishin [the holy orchard of apple trees] — as is known. 
 And on Shabbos shines the light of supernal Chochmah — 
 the aspect of Kodesh — 
 and corresponding to this is the aspect of 
 seudasa d'Atika Kadisha [the feast of the Holy Ancient One] — 
 for He is the source of Chochmah — 
 the aspect of ches — the aspect of vitality — 
 and therefore *"those who taste it merit life"* [Shabbos liturgy]. 
 And in it is the completeness of Torah reading — through which one gives strength to holy Malchus. 
 And in it is the completeness of the acceptance of prayers — as is known. 
 And this is the aspect of 
 *"and as for me, my prayer is to You, Hashem, at an auspicious time"* [Tehillim 69:14] — 
 which one recites on Shabbos at Minchah.
 

 
 [§4]
 And this is the aspect of the honor of Shabbos — 
 for all the aspects mentioned above are the aspect of kavod [honor]: 
 Chochmah — the 32 paths of Chochmah correspond in number to kavod — 
 in the aspect of *"the wise shall inherit honor"* [Mishlei 3:35]. 
 Torah — in the aspect of: "there is no honor except Torah." 
 Malchus — the aspect of the Melech HaKavod [King of Glory]. 
 Prayer — the aspect of kavod — as explained in the discourse Emor, Siman 2.

segments.he: סימן תס"ב וכו'
segments.en:
[§5]
 And this is the aspect of oneg Shabbos [Shabbos delight] — 
 and it is explained in the holy Zohar that the letters of עֹנֶג [oneg] 
 are an acronym for עֵדֶן נָהָר גַּן [Eiden — Nahar — Gan] — 
 which also allude to the aspects of Chochmah, Torah, and Malchus — 
 which is the aspect of prayer — as is known.
 

 
 [§6]
 And therefore one is careful to eat fish on Shabbos — 
 for dag [fish] is called in the language of our Sages nun — 
 in the aspect of the nun mentioned above — 
 and this is the aspect of einah pekicha [the open eye] of fish — 
 alluding to Chochmah — 
 in the aspect of *"and the eyes of them both were opened"* [Bereishis 3:7] — 
 which was said concerning wisdom — as stated. 
 And therefore Yosef — who merited most fully to the aspects mentioned above — 
 his children were blessed with the blessing of fish — 
 as it is written: *"and they shall multiply like fish"* [Bereishis 48:16] — and as our Sages taught.

segments.he: וע"כ מי פירות בלא מים מדינא אין מחמיצין כלל. שדייקא המים שרומזין לבחינות גבוהות כידוע והם בחי' מימי הדעת מימי החסד מימי התורה מימי התשובה והתפלה כ"ש שפכי כמים לבך וארז"ל מים קדמו לעולם ע"כ לעומת זה גם הסט"א שהם בחי' המים הזדונים (שבהם עיקר אחיזת עשו וישמעאל המלכיות דסט"א כמובן בזוה"ק בשלח ס"ד ע"ב) כרוכים אחריהם ומחמיצים את העיסה. מה שאין כן מי פירות אין מחמיצין. אבל אם יש בהם איזה מים אזי ממהרין להחמיץ. כי אז הסט"א כרוכה אחר המים ביותר מאחר שהם מעורבים עם מי פירות שיש בהם מתענוגות בני אדם.
segments.en:
[§7]
 And this is the aspect of the holiness of the Shabbos meal — 
 for it has already been explained above 
 that during weekday eating there is a hold for the aspect of Esav — 
 whose hold is in the gullet and the liver — the implements of eating — 
 and therefore one must be especially careful then 
 not to give them nourishment beyond their sustenance. 
 But Shabbos eating is entirely holy — 
 as is explained in the discourse Sha'alu et Rabbi, Siman 57. 
 And therefore the Shulchan Aruch states that it is forbidden to eat the bread of non-Jews on Shabbos. 
 And it is customary to knead sufficient dough at home 
 to fulfil the mitzvah of challah and produce loaves for Shabbos — 
 for Shabbos eating is holy, 
 and it is forbidden for non-Jews to have any hold in it.
 

 
 [§8]
 And one sanctifies the bread — which is the essential meal — 
 with additional holiness through kneading the measure of challah 
 and fulfilling thereby the mitzvah of separating challah — 
 which is called reishis [beginning/firstness] — 
 the aspect of Chochmah — as is explained within. 
 And challah is also the aspect of the Shechinah — 
 as is explained in the holy Zohar and the Tikkunnim — 
 the aspect of holy Malchus that receives from Chochmah — as stated. 
 And this is what is cited in Likutay Torah of the Ari, Parshas Shelach — 
 that the mitzvah of challah corresponds to the aspect of 
 the Chochmah d'Nukva [feminine Wisdom] — etc. — 
 as is cited in the Maurai Or.

segments.he: גם אין יוצאין עם מצה כזו חובת מצה כי אין זה לחם עוני שהוא בחי' המלכות דקדושה בחי' מסכן רק הוא מצה עשירה (אלא אם כן המי פירות בטלין בסמ"ך ואין מרגישין טעמם עיין בשו"ע) ובמדינות אלו נוהגין שלא ללוש אפילו במי פירות לבד אם לא בשעת הדחק לצורך חולה וזקן וכו' כמבואר בשו"ע:
segments.en:
[§9]
 For challah is the aspect of the Shechinah when joined with the Forefathers — 
 for this too is the aspect of Shabbos holiness: 
 שִׁין בַּת [shin-bas] — 
 the aspect of the Forefathers — whose root is in the three holy mochin — 
 and bas [daughter] is the aspect of the Shechinah — Malchus. 
 And this is the aspect of chen — and through this all prayers are accepted. 
 And therefore it is explained there that challah is also the aspect of prayer — 
 in the aspect of *"and Moshe implored [vayechal]"* — as stated.

segments.he: סימן תס"ח וכו'
segments.en:
[§10]
 [(Author's note: See the book Yikara d'Shabbata which brings from the holy Zohar 
 that on Shabbos Hashem Himself, as it were, receives the prayers of Israel. 
 And therefore our Sages taught: 
 "good is a handful with quiet" — this is Shabbos — 
 the aspect of "words spoken in quietness are heard" — as explained within.)]
 

 
 
 Siman 243 — One Who Rents a Shop or Bathhouse to a Non-Jew
 סִימָן רמ״ג — הַמַּשְׂכִּיר חֲנוּת וּמֶרְחָץ לְעַכּוּ״ם

segments.he: וזה בחי' איסור מלאכה מערב פסח אחר חצות. כי נמשך אז בחי' הארת קדושת יום טוב שהוא בחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§1]
 For the holiness of Shabbos was given only to Israel and not to non-Jews — 
 as it is written: *"between Me and the children of Israel"* [Shemos 31:17] — 
 and as our Sages taught: 
 "A non-Jew who rests on Shabbos is liable to death." 
 And our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Shemos]: 
 a parable of a king and his matron sitting facing one another — etc. — 
 for during the weekdays — which are the days of labor — 
 and labor is performed in order to clarify and elevate the holy sparks from within the sitra achra — 
 therefore [the sitra achra] has some hold and connection 
 with the aspect of holy Malchus — 
 in the aspect of: "this is Jerusalem which I have set in the midst of the nations" [Yechezkel 5:5] — 
 for she must descend among them to clarify from them the holy sparks. 
 But on Shabbos the Shechinah rests, as it were — 
 and "when Shabbos enters she is unified and separated from the other side" [Zohar] — 
 and "all the dominions of anger flee and depart from her and there is no dominion elsewhere in all the worlds" [ibid.]. 
 Therefore no labor is permitted on Shabbos — 
 and even upon the thought of labor our Sages cautioned: 
 "cease from the thought of labor."
 

 
 [§2]
 And therefore we separate from non-Jews on Shabbos in the most complete separation — 
 for "then all who work iniquity will be separated" [Tehillim 92:10] — 
 and therefore even instructing a non-Jew to perform a prohibited act on Shabbos — 
 amirah l'akum — is [rabbinically] forbidden. 
 For since the non-Jew does the labor on the intention and thought of the Jew — 
 it is as if the Jew performed the labor — 
 and this would give yet more power to the sitra d'mosa — 
 and therefore the Torah says mechaleleha mos yumas [one who desecrates it shall die] — 
 and even via a non-Jew through rabbinic decree it is forbidden — 
 and even maras ayin [the appearance of wrongdoing] 
 is a concern in this context — 
 for the osos [signs] of Shabbos — 
 שִׁין בַּת — allude to the aspects of 
 shemen [oil] and pessilah [wick] — 
 the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — 
 and the eyes [ayin] — the aspect of the beholder — 
 correspond to the three colors of the eye which are the aspect of the three holy mochin. 
 But if the non-Jew acts entirely on his own account 
 and in a manner that involves no maras ayin — it is permitted.

segments.he: וזה בחי' תענית בכורים בערב פסח זכר לנס וכו', כי מאחר שזכו לבחי' בכורה שרומזת להמשכת התיקונים הנ"ל. ע"כ עליהם מוטל ביותר לעסוק ביום זה בתשובה ותענית להכניע בחי' המלכות דסט"א שעיקר אחיזתה בבחי' האכילה שזה בחי' מה שאמר עשו הלעיטני נא ועי"ז פגם בקדושת הבכורה כמו שכתוב שם ויבז עשו את הבכורה וכנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§3]
 And likewise what is explained in Siman 246 
 regarding the resting of one's animal — 
 for a Jew's animal also alludes to [that spiritual dimension] — 
 as understood somewhat from what was explained above 
 regarding *"You save man and beast alike, Hashem"* [Tehillim 36:7] — 
 for behemah [animal] alludes to the aspect of Malchus — 
 and therefore one is commanded regarding its resting — 
 as it is written: *"you shall not perform any labor — you — etc. — and your animal"* [Shemos 20:10].
 

 
 
 Siman 248 — Traveling Before Shabbos
 סִימָן רמ״ח — יְצִיאַת שַׁבָּת

segments.he: וע"כ גם איסטניס לא יאכל ביום כדי שיאכל בלילה מצה לתיאבון. כי מאחר שהיא אכילה דקדושה בחי' מיכלא דמהמנותא ומאיר בה בחי' מלכות שמים ואור השכל דקדושה ע"כ צריכין שתהיה לתיאבון באהבה וברצון שיהיה גם הגוף נהנה ממנה בכדי להמשיך עי"ז קדושה ודעת על כל הנאת הגוף שיהיו ג"כ רק לשם שמים ובקדושה גדולה כראוי. וע"כ כל אדם אסור לו ג"כ לאכול פת (דהיינו מצה עשירה) בערב פסח משעה עשירית עכ"פ בכדי שיאכל בלילה מצה לתיאבון:
segments.en:
[§1]
 And therefore one may not set sail at sea, 
 nor join a caravan fewer than three days before Shabbos — 
 for three days before Shabbos the illumination of the coming Shabbos's holiness 
 begins to shine — as is known — 
 and they correspond to the aspects of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah — 
 which are also the aspects of the three rectifications mentioned above — 
 namely: the yoke of Heavenly Kingship, Torah, and Chochmah. 
 And therefore one must prepare oneself from that time 
 to receive the coming Shabbos's holiness in its fullness — 
 and guard oneself from having any distress or confusion on Shabbos — 
 and certainly not to come to any desecration of Shabbos, G-d forbid. 
 But for a matter of mitzvah it is permitted even within the three days — 
 for this is the ultimate purpose of all the rectifications — 
 to fulfil His commandments — 
 and one trusts in Hashem that He will save him from all distress 
 and from any desecration of Shabbos.

segments.he: וע"כ אסור לאכול מצה בערב פסח כל היום וארז"ל כל האוכל מצה בערב פסח כאלו בועל ארוסתו בבית חמיו. היינו קודם החופה ושבעה ברכות כמובא בחק יעקב סי' תע"א בשם הלבוש ומהרי"ו כי מאחר שמצה רומז לקדושה עליונה כזו ע"כ אין לאכול אותה קודם זמנה וביותר צריכין ליזהר סמוך לשיגיע זמן התגלות קדושתה וזמן הכנעת וביטול הסט"א שהיא אז בבחי' חמץ ומרחיקין אותה בתכלית הריחוק עד שאוסרת תערובתה אפילו במשהו. ע"כ יש אז התגברות גדול מן הסט"א ר"ל ואם יאכל אז מצה קודם שיגיע זמן שלימות הארתה יש לחוש שלא יהא אחיזה לבחי' הסט"א באכילה זו ויקבלו מזה איזה יניקה וכח ח"ו, ע"כ אסור לאכל עד שיגיע זמנה ונמשך עליה ועל כל ישראל הארה גדולה ונפלאה שהיא בחי' סוד החופה הקדושה העליונה ומברכין עליה שבעה ברכות. ואז אין באכילה זו שום אחיזה להסטרא אחרא חס ושלום רק אדרבא נמשכין על ידי אכילה הקדושה הזאת תיקונים נפלאים ונוראים לכל השנה כולה לכל אחד ואחד כפי בחינתו כמובן בזוהר הקדוש ובכתבים:
segments.en:
Siman 249 — Not Establishing a Feast on Erev Shabbos
 סִימָן רמ״ט — שֶׁלֹּא לִקְבֹּעַ סְעוּדָה בְּעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת

 
 [§1]
 And therefore it is forbidden to establish a feast and banquet on Erev Shabbos — 
 unless it is an obligatory [mitzvah] meal at its proper time — etc. — 
 And people of exemplary conduct fast every Erev Shabbos — 
 for it has already been explained that the essential completeness of holy eating is on Shabbos — 
 for then Esav — the sitra achra — has no hold in the eating and the meal. 
 And therefore one must prepare oneself for this — 
 to be eager to eat on Shabbos — 
 and to defer and prevent oneself from a weekday meal 
 in honor of the Shabbos meal — 
 and thereby to subdue the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the yetzer hara — the dominion of Esav — 
 [whose hold is in weekday eating] — 
 before the Shabbos meal when holy Malchus ascends in its fullness. 
 For Yaakov is the first of whom it is written that he kept Shabbos — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: סימן תע"ב וכו'
segments.en:
Siman 250 — Rising Early on Friday to Prepare for Shabbos
 סִימָן ר״נ — לְהַשְׁכִּים בְּבֹקֶר יוֹם ו׳

 
 [§1]
 One should rise early in the morning on Friday to prepare for Shabbos' needs — 
 for our Sages taught: 
 "One who labored before Shabbos will eat on Shabbos" — etc. — 
 for Shabbos is the aspect of the World to Come — 
 for then one will merit to receive from the light of supernal holy Chochmah in its fullness — 
 which is the essential life of the World to Come — 
 in the aspect of "the righteous sit and benefit from the radiance of the Shechinah" — 
 that they will merit to attain His G-dliness in full attainment — through the aspect of Malchus.

segments.he: עיין זוה"ק ויצא דף קנ"ז כד הוו ישראל במצרים הוו ברשותא אחרא עד בעא קוב"ה לקרבא לון לגביה יהיב לון אתר דלחם עני לחם עני מאן עני דא דוד מלכא דכתיב ביה כי עני ואביון אני. וההוא לחם איקרי מצה נוקבא וכו' עיי"ש מענין שמתחלה אכלו מצה שהוא לחם מארעא דחי ולבתר לחם מן השמים וכו'. ומענין שאין התינוק יודע שום ידיעה עד שטועם טעם לחם וכו' עיי"ש עוד. ועיין בדף רכ"ו ע"ב בפסח על התבואה לקביל רתיכא עילאה רזא דאבהן ודו מלכא וכו'. ועיי"ש מענין מצה שהיא בחי' מלכות וביעור חמץ דאינון טעוון אחרנין ממנן על עמין וכו' ואיקרי חמץ יצה"ר וכו' עיי"ש. ועיין בדף רנ"ה מענין בקדמיתא ליל שמורים ולבתר הלילה לזה לה' כד אתקריב זה לזאת. ומענין הקרבת קרבן פסח ומענין קרבן מוסף של פסח. ועיין זוהר תצוה דף קפ"ג מענין מצה דהיא אסוותא למיעל ולמנדע ברזא דמהימנותא וכו' ועיין זוהר אמור דף צ"ה מענין ליל שמורים תרי זווגא דסיהרא בשימשא.
segments.en:
[§2]
 But not all will be equal then — 
 and "every Tzaddik is burned by the canopy of his fellow" [Bava Basra 75a] — as our Sages taught — 
 for everything is according to the abundance of one's deeds. 
 And the more a person strives in this — 
 even in this world, to accept upon himself the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship 
 and to bind himself and look only at the wisdom and intellect and divine life-force 
 in every thing — 
 the more he merits this in the World to Come — 
 in the aspect of: 
 "one who labored on the eve of Shabbos will eat on Shabbos."
 

 
 [§3]
 And therefore one must hasten to engage in this from one's very youth — 
 for *"precious is one hour of repentance and good deeds in this world"* [Avos 4:17] — etc. — 
 and there is no loss like the loss of time — 
 for it has already been explained that in every moment and time 
 is clothed a new wisdom of how to recognize Him 
 and draw close to Him through it. 
 And therefore even regarding the practical preparation of Shabbos — 
 one must also rise early on Friday morning.

segments.he: ומענין החירות שצריכין להראות באותו הלילה וענין הד' כוסות שהם כנגד ד' גאולות והשמחה הגדולה של לילה זו ומה שגומרין בה את הלילה.
segments.en:
[§4]
 And therefore one must repent every Erev Shabbos — 
 to rectify through one's repentance whatever one may have damaged 
 in the days of the week — 
 through following one's yetzer — 
 the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 which is the opposite of the holiness of Shabbos.

segments.he: ועיין בדף רנ"א מענין שמצה מברחת לכל סטרין בישין ועביד קטטה בהון כגוונא דשדי דמזוזה וכו' וכו' ומני קוב"ה לברך לה שבע ברכות ליל פסח וכו'. ועיין זוהר חדש פ' כי תשא מענין ארבע כוסות וארבע גאולות. קידוש על היין לקבליה דדוד.
segments.en:
[§5]
 And therefore one should remove cobwebs from the house on Erev Shabbos — 
 for they are from the aspect of the sitra achra — 
 the kingdom of Esav — as our Sages expounded on the verse 
 *"a spider grasps with its hands"* [Mishlei 30:28].
 

 
 [§6]
 And this: the mitzvah to taste from the Shabbos dishes on Erev Shabbos — 
 for our Sages taught that Yaakov took as his portion the World to Come — 
 and yet he is also of necessity obligated to pass through this world — 
 only that in truth the aspect of Yaakov 
 has no desire or will for any worldly matter — 
 rather even his this-worldly affairs are only for the World to Come — 
 and all his actions are only for Heaven's sake. 
 It follows that in his this-world as well he tastes the flavor of the World to Come — 
 and this is alluded to in the tasting of the Shabbos dishes on Erev Shabbos.

segments.he: הגדה לקבליה דיעקב. ברכת המזון לקבליה דיצחק.
segments.en:
[§7]
 And one should strive to personally prepare something for Shabbos' needs — 
 for the mitzvah is better performed directly than through an agent — 
 for through every mitzvah holiness is drawn upon the person — 
 in the aspect of "Who sanctified us with His commandments" — 
 and Kodesh is Chochmah — as is known — 
 and therefore one merits through this 
 to bind oneself to holy Chochmah in its fullness 
 through the aspect of the mitzvah — which is the aspect of holy Malchus. 
 And the greater one's effort for the sake of the mitzvah, the greater the reward — 
 and the greater the holiness one merits — 
 for through the effort and strength invested in performing the mitzvah 
 one gives strength to holy Malchus to overpower the kingdom of the sitra achra. 
 And therefore the mitzvah is certainly better performed directly — 
 especially the mitzvah of preparing for Shabbos — 
 which is itself called Kodesh.
 

 
 [§8]
 And therefore one should sharpen the knife on Erev Shabbos in honor of Shabbos — 
 and this is derived from: 
 *"and they shall prepare [v'heichinu] what they bring"* [Shemos 16:5] — 
 אֵת alludes to the aspect of Malchus — 
 and sikkin [knife] also alludes to the aspects of Malchus and Binah — 
 see the Maurai Or.

segments.he: הלל הגדול לקבליה דאברהם מתתא לעילא סליק.
segments.en:
Simanim 252–267 — Laws of Commencement of Labor, Shofar, and the Shabbos Lamp
 סִימָן רנ״ב–רס״ז

 
 [§1]
 It is permitted to begin labor on Erev Shabbos near twilight 
 even though the labor completes itself on Shabbos [Siman 252] — 
 for the essential clarifications that are clarified through labor 
 all occur only through the power of Chochmah — which is called reishis [beginning] — as stated. 
 And therefore when the beginning and commencement of the labor — 
 which is performed by the person who possesses wisdom and intellect — 
 takes place before Shabbos — 
 even if it is then completed on Shabbos on its own — there is no concern — 
 since the person does nothing more — 
 it all happens through the power of the beginning made before Shabbos. 
 Except when there is concern he may assist in the labor on Shabbos itself — 
 such as lest he stoke the coals — in that case it is forbidden. 
 And in this is also explained what is stated in Simanim 253, 254, 255, 257, 258, and so on.

segments.he: כגוונא דא מצה לקבליה דדוד וכו'. ועיין תיקונים תיקון ה' ואמאי איתקרי ה"א. תתאה חצי האמה בגין דאתקריא מצה פרוסה לחם עני וכו'. ועיין בתיקונים תיקונא תליסר מענין מצה פרוסה ומצה שלימה ומרור והלל גמור ושאינו גמור בפסח וכו':
segments.en:
[§2]
 They would sound the shofar on Erev Shabbos to separate the people from labor [Siman 256] — 
 for the blasts of the shofar are the aspect of the arousal of the mochin 
 from their slumber — as is known. 
 For the wisdom and mochin of the weekdays are the aspect of mochin d'katnus [small consciousness] — 
 the aspect of sleep — compared to the mochin one merits to receive on holy Shabbos. 
 And therefore on the weekdays they are days of labor — 
 and therefore one sounds [the shofar] on Erev Shabbos 
 to separate the people from labor 
 and prepare them to receive the holiness of the Chochmah and mochin that shine on Shabbos. 
 And this too is the aspect of the blasts themselves — 
 as our Sages taught: 
 "the sounding of the shofar is wisdom and not labor."

segments.he: הנה הארכתי לציין כמה ציונים מדברי זוה"ק וכולם מכוונים לעינינו כמובן ממילא בפשיטות. והכלל כי אז היה עדיין קודם קבלת התורה הק' והסט"א התגברה מאד מחטאי הדורות דור המבול והפלגה ואנשי סדום וע"כ באו הנשמות האלו שהיו בשרשן מבחי' גבוה מאד אלא שהתגברה עליהם הסט"א שהוא היצה"ר להחטיאם ובאו עכשיו להתתקן ע"י שיעבוד מצרים כמבואר כ"ז בכתבי האריז"ל.
segments.en:
[§3]
 The mitzvah of bathing in hot water on Erev Shabbos [Siman 260] — 
 and it is explained in the kavanos that this is the secret of 
 the flame of fire that descends on Erev Shabbos to subdue the klippos — 
 meaning one draws the illumination of supernal Chochmah — 
 the aspect of Yaakov and Yosef — who are the aspect of the flame of fire — as stated — 
 as it is written: 
 *"and the house of Yaakov shall be fire and the house of Yosef a flame"* [Ovadyah 1:18] — 
 and through this one burns and subdues the klippos — 
 the aspect of Esav — the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the aspect of the yetzer hara's fire — 
 for from fire they came and fire will consume them. 
 And this is the aspect of: 
 "always let a person arouse the good inclination against the evil inclination" — 
 and the arousal is from the aspect of judgments and gevuros — the aspect of fire. 
 And afterwards one immerses in the mikveh — 
 which is the aspect of encompassing oneself in the waters of supernal chesed — 
 which flow from the aspect of the holy supernal intellect — 
 the aspect of chesed and mercy.
 

 
 [§4]
 Three things one must say at twilight on Erev Shabbos [Siman 260 cont.]: 
 "Did you tithe?" — corresponding to the aspect of Malchus — 
 the aspect of maaser [tithe] — 
 "Did you make the eruv?" — corresponding to Torah study — 
 as explained in the Tikkunnim: 
 eruv is the middle pillar — the aspect of Torah — as is known — 
 "Light the lamp" — corresponding to the illumination of supernal intellect 
 that shines even in the dark — 
 in the aspect of: *"for You light my lamp, Hashem — my G-d illuminates my darkness"* [Tehillim 18:29].

segments.he: וזה היה תוקף הנס והחסד הגדול של יציאת מצרים. כי אחר קבלת התורה אזי ע"י עסק התורה נותנין כח למלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' היצ"ט להתגבר על הסט"א. אבל אז היה קודם קבלת התורה וגם לא הגיע עדיין זמן וקץ גאולתן אלא שראה הקב"ה שהם בסכנה גדולה שלא יהיו נשקעים ח"ו בטומאת מצרים ע"כ עשה הקב"ה בזכות האבות והאמהות ושלח להם גואל ומושיע הוא משה רבינו ע"ה והוציאם משם באותות ובמופתים נוראים ובמורא גדול זו גילוי שכינה וזכו אח"כ לקבל התורה על ידו שעי"ז יש כבר רח לבחי' המלכות דקדושה להתגבר עד שנזכה לגאולת עולם ב"ב. ומחמת זה נקראת המצה אז לחם עני והוא מצה פרוסה בחי' לב נשבר מחמת שלא היתה הגאולה מצדינו מחמת מעשינו הטובים ובאתערותא דלתתא, רק באתערותא דלעילא בחסד עליון ית' ובזכות אבות כנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§5]
 The Shabbos lamps [Siman 261] — 
 and it is explained in the kavanos that they correspond to 
 Binah and Malchus — 
 meaning Malchus then receives the illumination of supernal Chochmah through Binah — 
 for they are the two companions that never separate — as is known. 
 And this is the aspect of: 
 "One who wishes to become wise should face south — for the Menorah is in the south" — as our Sages taught. 
 And this is the aspect of the setting of the table on Shabbos — 
 for Malchus ascends then from the aspect of poverty to the aspect of wealth — 
 in the aspect of the royal table — 
 in the aspect of: "one who wishes to become wealthy should face north — for the Table is in the north."
 

 
 [§6]
 And therefore it is a mitzvah to honor Shabbos in fine garments — 
 for it has already been explained that 
 the supernal intellects are the aspect of the garments of honor of the person — 
 and therefore it is a mitzvah to wear white garments then — 
 corresponding to the supernal whiteness — 
 in the aspect of *"and streams from Lebanon"* — 
 from the whiteness of the brain [levunah d'mocha]. 
 And לָבָן contains the letters ל-ב-ן — 
 which are the initials of: lamed-beis nativot — 
 the thirty-two paths of Chochmah — 
 and also ל״ב נוּ״ן — lamed-beis and nun — 
 meaning one binds the nun — the aspect of Malchus — 
 to the 32 paths of Chochmah.

segments.he: ועיין בכוונת האריז"ל נפלאות גדולות בכל הענינים של לילה הקדושה הזאת ומסתמא כל דבריו הק' מכוונים ומוסכמים עם דברי הזוה"ק ואין לנו עסק בנסתרות לבאר בענינים גבוהים כאלו אך אעפ"כ יש בשם ג"כ ענינים רבים השייכים לענינינו סמוך לפשוטו ג"כ. והנה שם מבואר כי פרעה ומצרים הם כנגד בחי' העורף העליון שהוא בחי' אחוריים של הדעת העליון והיו יונקים כל השפע והיו יונקים מכל בחי' היו"ד דמים שהם בחי' דם טהור ודם נדה וזה סוד ואראך מתבוססת בדמייך שבחי' סטרא דמותה אבי אבות הטומאה בוססין ויונקים מהדמים ואומר לך בדמיך חיי וכו'.
segments.en:
[§7]
 And therefore one is strict about the Shabbos lamps — 
 that the oil and wicks should be valid — 
 so that the oil flows after the wick — 
 for the wick alludes to Malchus and the oil to Chochmah — as is known — 
 and therefore they must be joined and unified in a complete union — 
 that no aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra of Chochmah and Malchus 
 should have any hold — G-d forbid — 
 so that the holy light burns well and does not go out — 
 and so that one not come to desecrate Shabbos.
 

 
 
 Siman 266 — The Traveler Overtaken by Shabbos
 סִימָן רס״ו — מִי שֶׁבָּא בַדֶּרֶךְ

segments.he: וכפי ענינינו הוא כי עיקר החיות דקדושה הוא מבחי' המוחין והדעת והחיות של הנפש המלובש בדם כי הדם הוא הנפש והדם הוא מרה אדומה בחי' יסוד האש שזה בחי' החמימות והתלהבות דקדושה שזה בחי' העבודה עם חיות דקדושה. ואז היו הם יונקים מבחי' אחורי הדעת והמוחין ומהדמים הנ"ל שהם בחי' דם טהור ודם טמא שזה בחי' החמימו' דסט"א של היצה"ר, ולפעמים מחמם אותו לדבר עבירה ממש וזה נמשך ממה שיונק מבחי' הדם טמא ששרשו מבחי' הגבורות של בחי' נוקבא ולפעמים מתלבש עצמו במצוות וזה נמשך ממה שיונק מבחי' הדם טהור ששרשו מבחי' החסדים.
segments.en:
[§1]
 And this is what [the Sages] said: 
 one who is traveling and Shabbos overtakes him on the road — 
 he may not place his purse upon his donkey — 
 for he is commanded regarding [the donkey's] resting — 
 but should give his purse to a non-Jew — etc. 
 For even a donkey — which is an impure animal and is from the aspect of the sitra achra — 
 nonetheless, since it belongs to a Jew, 
 it has already gained some hold in the side of holiness — 
 for it has become a chariot toward it — 
 and therefore one is commanded regarding its resting. 
 And therefore he gives his purse to the non-Jew 
 who has no part in holiness. 
 And moreover — this was only permitted regarding 
 money that already belongs to him — 
 for the money of a Jew too has a root in holiness — 
 as is stated elsewhere: 
 *"in the shadow of wisdom, in the shadow of silver"* [Koheles 7:12] — 
 and likewise holy wealth is from the aspect of holy Malchus — as stated above. 
 But money that has not yet come into the Jew's hands — 
 such as if he found a lost object — 
 he may not give it even to the non-Jew — 
 for it is forbidden to damage the holiness of Shabbos even through a non-Jew — as stated. 
 And therefore if there is no non-Jew with him — 
 he is permitted to place [the purse] upon the donkey — 
 but only in the manner described in the Shulchan Aruch — see there — 
 and from this the other matters explained in this Siman are understood.

segments.he: והשי"ת חמל עלינו אז בחסדו הגדול ונתן לנו דם פסח ודם מילה שהם כנגד בחי' דכר ונוקביה חסדים וגבורות הנ"ל כמבואר שם ובזוה"ק ועי"ז זכינו להנצל ממות לחיים שזה בחי' בדמיך חיי שזכינו לקבל מוחין גדולים וגבוהים מאד שהם בבחי' חיי המלך כמבואר שם היינו כנ"ל. (וזה הסוד מרומז בדברי ר' מתיא בן חרש הובא בפירש"י פרשה בא) ועיי"ש מענין המוחין הגדולים דגדלות וקטנות דאבא ודאימא הנכנסין בלילה הזאת ומרומזין בענין המצה והמרור והכוסות וכו' עיי"ש באריכות.
segments.en:
Siman 267 — Not Concluding with Shomer Yisrael on Shabbos Night
 סִימָן רס״ז — אֵין חוֹתְמִין שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּלֵיל שַׁבָּת

 
 [§1]
 And therefore on Shabbos night one does not conclude with "Shomer amo Yisrael" 
 [Guardian of His people Israel] 
 in the blessing of Hashkiveinu — 
 for Shabbos itself is the protection from all afflictions — G-d forbid — 
 for then the light of Chochmah and daas shines with wondrous illumination — 
 and through this all afflictions are automatically absent — 
 as it is said: *"they shall not harm and they shall not destroy"* [Yeshayahu 11:9] — 
 for "the earth shall be full of knowledge of Hashem." 
 And also: all the sitra achra — from which all afflictions come — 
 are fully subdued then — as stated.

segments.he: ומחמת שאז נכנסין המוחין שלא כסדר ומוחין דגדלות קודמין למוחין דקטנות ע"כ הזהירה התורה ע"ז ביותר בענין שאלת הבנים ולהודיע להם ג"כ הנפלאות של יציאת מצרים וחז"ל תיקנו בשביל זה כמה שינויים בשביל לעורר התינוקות שישאלו.
segments.en:
Simanim 268–269 — Shabbos Night Prayer and Kiddush
 סִימָן רס״ח–רס״ט — תְּפִלַּת לֵיל שַׁבָּת וְקִדּוּשׁ

 
 [§1]
 And this is the aspect of the Shabbos night prayer — 
 one begins with Psalms — recounting in them greatly the greatness of Hashem 
 and His Kingship — and the nullification of the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the aspect of other gods. 
 And then one recites Mizmor l'Dovid — etc. — 
 and the three [paragraphs of] Havu — 
 corresponding to the three opening blessings of the prayer — as our Sages taught — 
 and they correspond to the three mochin encompassed in Chochmah. 
 And then seven Koles [voices] — 
 corresponding to the seven attributes — 
 which are the totality of Creation — 
 to bind them all to supernal holy Chochmah. 
 And then Lechah Dodi [Come my Beloved] — etc. — 
 and the Mizmor Shir l'Yom HaShabbos [A Psalm, a Song for the Shabbos day] — 
 its initials: לְמֹשֶׁה [Moshe] — 
 and its letters rearranged also spell שְׁלֹמֹה [Shlomo] — 
 Moshe is the aspect of daas and Chochmah — 
 and therefore "the face of Moshe was as the face of the sun" — 
 and Shlomo: "in the days of Shlomo the moon was at its fullness" [Zohar] — 
 and it was through him that "he became wiser than all men" [Melachim I 5:11] — 
 for it is impossible to receive the light of Chochmah 
 except through the aspect of the nun — the aspect of Malchus — 
 and on Shabbos both aspects shine with a great light.

segments.he: וארז"ל חוטפין מצה בלילי פסחים כדי שלא יישנו התינוקות. וכן משחקים להם בקליות ואגוזים בשביל זה.
segments.en:
[§2]
 "It is good to give thanks to Hashem, to sing praises to Your Name, Most High" — 
 for it has already been explained that Chochmah and Malchus are the aspect of shem [Name] — 
 and on Shabbos they are at a supremely elevated level — 
 and this: "to sing praises to Your Name Most High." 
 And this: "to declare in the morning Your chesed" — whose root is in Chochmah — 
 and "Your faithfulness at night" — whose root is in Malchus — which is the attribute of night — 
 *"the lesser luminary to rule the night"* [Bereishis 1:16]. 
 And this: "upon the ten-stringed [instrument]" — the aspect of Malchus — 
 the tenth attribute — called maaser. 
 And "upon the nevel" — the aspect of the 32 paths of Chochmah — 
 for the lights that shine from it into this world are the aspect of novelos Chochmah [the overflow of Chochmah] — 
 and "upon the kinor" — the aspect of Torah — as cited in the holy Zohar — 
 and kinor rearranged is כ״ו נֵר [26 — a lamp] — 
 as cited in the holy Tikkunnim — 
 the aspect of the union of sun and moon through Torah study.
 

 
 [§3]
 And this: "for You have gladdened me, Hashem, through Your deed — 
 at Your handiwork I will sing" — 
 joy in the morning — the aspect of Chochmah — 
 and song at evening — the aspect of the moon — 
 for through both aspects one can recognize Him 
 and draw close to Him through all of Creation — 
 and therefore one is filled with joy and song through every thing. 
 And this: "how great are Your deeds, Hashem" — the aspect of Malchus — 
 which dwells in Asiyah — 
 "Your thoughts are very deep" — the aspect of Chochmah — 
 "the brain is concealed thought" [Zohar]. 
 Then one begins to recount and give thanks to Hashem also for the opposite — 
 for the world was created with the power of free choice — 
 and this: "an ignoramus does not know and a fool does not understand this" — 
 the aspect of: "the fool desires not wisdom" — said of the yetzer hara — 
 and there are many wicked who follow his counsel — 
 and yet one must not look at this at all — 
 for "when the wicked blossom like grass — it is to destroy them forever". 
 And this: "But You are exalted forever, Hashem."

segments.he: ואעפ"כ לא יאמר הקידוש עד שתחשך.
segments.en:
[§4]
 Then one prays Maariv and recites 
 "Atah Kidashta es Yom HaShevi'i" [You sanctified the seventh day] — 
 meaning the light of Chochmah and mochin — 
 which are called Kodesh — shone within it. 
 And this: "for Your Name" — the aspect of Malchus. 
 And this is the tachlis [ultimate purpose] of heaven and earth — 
 that all was created "in order that they know Him" — 
 and to this one merits only through the holiness of Shabbos. 
 It follows that the ultimate purpose and completeness of all labor is completed 
 through the holiness of Shabbos — 
 and this: Vayechal, Vayishbos, Vayevorech, Vayekadesh — 
 all allude to the two aspects mentioned above.

segments.he: כי כל המצוות והתיקונים שבלילה הזאת אינם שייכים אלא בזמנם בלילה דייקא:
segments.en:
[§5]
 Kiddush over wine [Siman 269] — 
 for the cup is the aspect of Malchus — as is known — 
 and the wine within it is the aspect of the mochin and Chochmah 
 that are drawn to Malchus — as stated. 
 And if there is no wine available one recites Kiddush over bread — 
 for the Shabbos loaves and meals are also in the aspects of these rectifications — 
 and therefore there is no Kiddush except in the place of the meal. 
 And when beginning Kiddush one gazes at the Shabbos candles — 
 for the Shabbos candles also allude to these aspects — 
 and then one gazes at the cup of blessing — 
 for one must look with open eyes 
 upon the light of the intellect mentioned above. 
 And therefore some say one may only recite Kiddush 
 in the presence of a candle [Siman 273] — 
 for the Shabbos candle alludes to the light of the intellect. 
 And therefore the custom was to recite Kiddush in the synagogue — 
 for the synagogue alludes to the aspect of Malchus — as stated — 
 and the primary institution was for the wayfarers 
 who ate and drank in the synagogue — 
 as explained in Siman 269 — 
 and these are the aspect of the righteous — 
 of whom it is said: 
 *"the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn"* [Mishlei 4:18] — 
 for the essential life-force of their eating and drinking 
 is through the light of the intellect they receive at every turn 
 through the aspect of Malchus — which is called bei kenishta [the House of Assembly] — as stated.
 

 
 
 Siman 274 — Lechem Mishneh [Double Bread] on Shabbos
 סִימָן רע״ד — לֶחֶם מִשְׁנֶה שֶׁל שַׁבָּת

segments.he: וזה יסדר שלחנו (שהיא בחי' שלחן מלכים) בכלים נאים וכו' ויכין מקום מושבו שישב בהסיבה דרך חירות כי אז המלכות בבחי' שמלכך בן חורין כידוע.
segments.en:
[§1]
 This is the aspect of the double bread of Shabbos — 
 for then one receives a doubled abundance through the illumination of supernal Chochmah — 
 the aspect of reishis [beginning] — the aspect of bechorah [firstness] — 
 and the firstborn receives a double portion. 
 And therefore Shabbos eating is entirely holy — 
 for it is the aspect of spiritual abundance 
 from the illumination of holy Chochmah — 
 which is the essential life-force. 
 And physical abundance is automatically included within this — 
 in the aspect of: "in the shadow of wisdom is in the shadow of silver" [Koheles 7:12] — 
 for the lower is included within the higher. 
 And therefore all years are blessed from it — 
 for it is the source of blessing — and all influences flow from it.
 

 
 
 Siman 275 and on — Fire and Labor on Shabbos
 סִימָן רע״ה — אֵשׁ וּמְלָאכָה בְּשַׁבָּת

segments.he: וזה בחי' הד' כוסות שהם כנגד ארבע לשונות של גאולה והוצאתי והצלתי וגאלתי ולקחתי וכנגד ארבע מלכיות וכנגד ארבע כוסות של תרעלה שעתיד הקב"ה להשקות לאו"ה וכנגד ארבע כוסות של ישועה לישראל כמבואר בב"ר פ' וישב. היינו שנמשך בחי' הכנעת המלכות דסט"א וניצולים ישראל משעבודם ועבודתם והמלכות דקדושה מתעלה ומקבלת כח והארה גדולה מבחי' החכמה העליונה. וזה שסיים וידעתם כי אני ה' וכו':
segments.en:
[§1]
 It has already been explained above that all weekday labors are the aspect of clarifications — 
 and everything is only through the power of thought — which is Chochmah. 
 And on Shabbos there are no clarifications — as stated — 
 and therefore all labors are forbidden. 
 And because of this, the holy Torah specified fire in particular — 
 as it is written: *"you shall not kindle fire"* [Shemos 35:3] — 
 for fire alludes to the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — as stated — 
 through which all the holy clarifications of the weekdays are made. 
 And therefore many labors are performed through fire — 
 such as kindling and extinguishing and cooking and baking — 
 and most of the labors are performed through iron tools — 
 which are all made through fire. 
 And therefore our Sages prohibited many things 
 lest one come to desecrate Shabbos through fire — 
 and thereby give strength to the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the fire of the yetzer hara.
 

 
 
 Siman 281 and on — The Shabbos Morning Prayer and Torah Reading
 סִימָן רפ״א — תְּפִלַּת שַׁחֲרִית שֶׁל שַׁבָּת

segments.he: וע"כ ד' כוסות אלו צריך לשתותן על הסדר וכו' כי כשהמלכות מקבלת הארת החכמה דקדושה אז נעשה גם היא מבחי' כסדר כמובן בליקות"נ סי' פ"ב:
segments.en:
[§1]
 And therefore one delays going to the synagogue on Shabbos in the morning somewhat — 
 since one sleeps a little into the day [as the Magen Avraham brings in the name of the Bach] — 
 for even sleep on Shabbos — which is for the renewal of the mochin — 
 is very precious — 
 for then one merits to receive very elevated and holy mochin — 
 through the soul being renewed during sleep 
 through the aspect of Malchus — which ascends on Shabbos with an extraordinary ascent — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ אפילו עני שבישראל לא יאכל עד שיסב ולא יפחתו לו מארבע כוסות של יין כי אז בחי' המלכות דקדושה הוא בבחי' מסכן וחכם כי מצד עצמה כביכול היא בבחי' עניות ושפלות כנ"ל ואעפ"כ השי"ת בחסדו הגדול מאיר עליו אז מוחין גדולים ונפלאים שזה סוד המצה וארבע כוסות שצריכין להיות בהסיבה ודרך חירות דייקא כנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§2]
 And this too is the aspect of the many songs and Psalms one recites on Shabbos — 
 all for the sake of the ascent of Malchus then in its great elevation — 
 in the aspect of: "Sing praises to our King — sing praises" [Tehillim 47:7]. 
 And likewise for the illumination of Chochmah and intellect that shines then — 
 in the aspect of: "sing praises with understanding" [zammeru maskil — ibid.].
 

 
 [§3]
 And this is the aspect of the Torah reading on Shabbos — 
 for the completeness of all the rectifications above 
 one merits through Torah — as stated — 
 and it is the essential Chochmah — as it is written: 
 "I am wisdom" [Mishlei 8:12] — and: 
 "through me kings shall reign" [ibid. 8:15]. 
 And then one reads the Haftarah from the Prophets — 
 for one draws the illumination of Chochmah from level to level — 
 in the aspect of what our Sages taught: 
 "a wise man surpasses a prophet" — as it is said: 
 "and a prophet has a heart of wisdom" [Tehillim 90:12] — 
 and they also taught: 
 "the superiority of Torah over prophecy is great" — 
 for regarding a prophet it is written: "the sign and wonder comes to you" [Devarim 13:3] — 
 while regarding Torah it is written: "according to the Torah they instruct you" [Devarim 17:11] — 
 and through all of this one draws the illumination of holy Chochmah and mochin to Malchus.

segments.he: וע"כ גם הנשים חייבות בכל מצוות הלילה הזאת כי הם ג"כ מבחי' מלכות בחי' אשה יראת ה' ומקבלין אז ג"כ הארה גדולה לנשמתם ושכלם ע"י התיקונים של הלילה הזאת:
segments.en:
[§4]
 Reading the weekly portion twice in the Hebrew text and once in Targum [Aramaic translation] — 
 it is explained in the kavanos that 
 the two [readings of the Hebrew] correspond to the aspects of Yaakov and Yosef — 
 who merited most fully to bind themselves to the holy Chochmah — as is explained within — 
 and the one Targum corresponds to the building of the Nukva — the aspect of Malchus — 
 which was through the aspect of tardemah [deep sleep] — 
 as it is written: 
 *"and Hashem caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man"* [Bereishis 2:21] — etc.
 

 
 [§5]
 And our Sages taught that through this one's days and years are lengthened — 
 for one merits life and length of days 
 from the aspect of supernal Chochmah — 
 as it is written: *"and wisdom gives life"* [Koheles 7:12]. 
 [(And see the commentary on Siman 292, where it is explained: 
 Atah Kidashta [You sanctified] corresponds to Shabbos Bereishis — 
 [the aspect of the revelation of His Kingship 
 that occurred then through the completion of all Creation — 
 which was created for the revelation of His Kingship — as explained elsewhere]. 
 Yismach Moshe [Moshe shall rejoice] corresponds to Shabbos of Matan Torah — 
 the aspect of Torah study — 
 and therefore one recites there: 
 "as he stood before You upon Mount Sinai, 
 and two tablets of stone he brought down in his hands" — etc. — 
 and: "You did not give it, Hashem our G-d, to the nations of the lands" — etc. — 
 for through the holy Torah one subdues the sitra achra 
 and separates it from holiness 
 so that it has no hold in the holiness — 
 and this is the aspect of what is said regarding Shabbos: 
 "between Me and the children of Israel" — etc. — 
 and: "a non-Jew who rests on Shabbos is liable to death" — as stated above. 
 Atah Echad [You are One] corresponds to Shabbos of the World to Come — 
 for then Israel will merit to attain the light of supernal Chochmah in its fullness — 
 until through this they will merit to be encompassed in His unity — 
 as the saying: "if I knew Him I would be Him" — 
 and as explained in the discourse Atika, Siman 21 — 
 and this: Atah Echad u'Shimcha Echad u'mi k'Amcha Yisrael Goy Echad — 
 You are One, and Your Name is One, and who is like Your people Israel — one nation.)]

segments.he: וזה מוזגין לו כוס ראשון ומקדש עליו ומברך שהחיינו. כי הכוס של קידוש רומז להארת החכמה וכו' שהיא בחי' קודש. וע"כ מברכין עליו על שבחר בנו וקדשנו ונתן לנו את הימים טובים מקראי קודש והכל מחמת הארת החכמה הק' שמאירה בהם וזה עיקר החיות דקדושה כנ"ל ע"כ מברכין אז שהחיינו וזה מרומז בסי' קדש:
segments.en:
[§6]
 And then one prays Musaf — 
 corresponding to the additional Shabbos offerings — 
 and then Malchus ascends to the level of the mochin — as explained in the kavanos. 
 And this: tikkanta Shabbos ratzisa korbanoseha [You established Shabbos, You desired its offerings] — etc. — 
 and it is cited in the Tur that it was founded with the letters in reverse — tashrak — 
 alluding to the redemption — 
 for then will be the complete ascent of Malchus to the mochin. 
 And this: ratzisa korbanoseha — 
 and the Beis Yosef explains this means there is no sin-offering among the Shabbos offerings — 
 only burnt-offerings — 
 for the sin-offering comes on account of sin — 
 which flows from the hold of the yetzer hara — 
 and the sin-offering is its rectification. 
 But on Shabbos the yetzer hara has no hold whatsoever. 
 And therefore in truth one who keeps Shabbos as required 
 is forgiven for all his sins that came from the side of the yetzer hara — 
 for certainly through the power and merit of Shabbos's holiness 
 he will merit complete repentance and sin no more. 
 And then one partakes of the Shabbos meal — 
 which is the seudasa d'Atika Kadisha — 
 the source of holy Chochmah and mochin.
 

 
 [§7]
 And one must also complete on Shabbos the hundred blessings 
 through fruits and delicacies — etc. — 
 for they are the secret of the hundred bases [adanim] — 
 which are the aspects of the rectifications of Malchus — as is known — 
 and through this one merits to receive the light of Chochmah — 
 in the aspect of: 
 "do not read mah [what] but me'ah [one hundred]" — as explained above.

segments.he: ואח"כ ורחץ כי נוטלין ידים להמשיך מימי הדעת מימי התורה הק' ולדחות עי"ז הסט"א והטומאה הרוצה להאחז בהידים הק' שצריכין לאכול ולטבול בהם:
segments.en:
Simanim 291–292 — Shabbos Minchah and the Three Meals
 סִימָן רצ״א–רצ״ב — מִנְחָה שֶׁל שַׁבָּת וְשָׁלֹשׁ סְעוּדוֹת

 
 [§1]
 And then one prays Minchah of Shabbos and recites Atah Echad — as stated above — 
 and recites Va'ani Sefilasi — etc. — 
 for through all these rectifications the prayer is accepted. 
 See in the kavanos of the Shabbos Minchah prayer and the matter of the three meals — 
 and you will understand somewhat according to the approach above.

segments.he: ומטבילין את הכרפס שרומז ג"כ לבחי' מוחין כמבואר בכתבים ומברכין עליו:
segments.en:
[§2]
 And this is the aspect of the three passages of Tzidkascha [Your righteousness] that one recites then — 
 corresponding to Moshe, Yosef, and Dovid — who departed on Shabbos afternoon — 
 for Moshe is the aspect of daas and supernal Chochmah — 
 Dovid is the aspect of Malchus — 
 Yosef is the aspect of the union and connection that joins Malchus with Chochmah — 
 and therefore Yosef merited both aspects — as stated above. 
 Or alternatively: 
 Yosef alludes to the aspect of Chochmah — 
 as it is written: *"for he is a son of old age to him"* [Bereishis 37:3] — 
 and Onkelos translates: 
 "for a wise son is he to him." 
 Moshe is the aspect of Torah — 
 in the aspect of: "Remember the Torah of Moshe." 
 Dovid is the aspect of Malchus and prayer — as stated. 
 And this is cited: that Yosef — Moshe — Dovid in numerical value equals Tefilah [prayer] — 
 for through this the prayer is accepted — as stated. 
 And therefore each of them departed to his root on that afternoon. 
 And this is what is cited in the kavanos: 
 that tiftach [Atah Echad] corresponds to the union of groom and bride — as stated.

segments.he: ואח"כ יחץ שפורס ומשבר המצה האמצעית והחלק הגדול ממנה הרומז להמשכת המוחין בחי' וא"ו מטמינה לאפיקומן והחלק הקטן ממנה שהיא בחי' דל"ת בחי' מלכות מניחה על הקערה ומסדר עליה ההגדה. כי עיקר המשכת המוחין הוא ע"י שמתקנין תחלה בחי' המלכות כנ"ל. ומחמת שעיקר הארתה וכחה הוא ע"י החכמה והמוחין הק'. ע"כ בשעת בציעה מצרפה להשלימה העליונה שהיא בחי' יוד בחי' חכמה כמבואר בכוונות עיי"ש:
segments.en:
Siman 293 and on — Motzai Shabbos and Havdalah
 סִימָן רצ״ג — מוֹצָאֵי שַׁבָּת וְהַבְדָּלָה

 
 [§1]
 And therefore one must add from the weekday upon the holy — 
 both at its entry and at its exit — 
 in order to encompass also the weekdays 
 and bind them in the holiness of Shabbos. 
 And therefore one delays the evening prayer of Motzai Shabbos.

segments.he: ואח"כ מגיד מתחיל לסדר ההגדה ומגביה הקערה שהיא בחי' מלכות. עם המצות שעליה שרומזין לתלת מוחין הק' עם שאר הדברים שעליה שרומזין לשאר המדות הק' שעל ידם נמשכין המוחין לבחי' מלכות כמובא בכוונות.
segments.en:
[§2]
 And this: one recites Atah Chonantanu [You have graced us] in the blessing of Atah Chonen — 
 and one prays to be saved from every sin and iniquity — 
 from the side of the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 and to be attached to awe of Him — 
 the aspect of the mora [awe] of holy Malchus — 
 which is itself also the essential holy Chochmah — 
 in the aspect of: *"behold — the fear of Hashem is wisdom"* [Iyov 28:28].
 

 
 [§3]
 And then one recites Vihi No'am — 
 which alludes to the illumination of the supernal mochin — 
 where the essential pleasantness is — 
 and "may the work of our hands be established" — 
 for Asiyah is the aspect of Malchus — as stated. 
 And immediately afterwards one recites Yoshev b'Seser [He who dwells in the shelter — Tehillim 91] — 
 a psalm of protection from all afflictions — 
 which come from the sitra achra — the aspect of Esav — 
 whose essential hold is in Asiyah — 
 and therefore he is called Esav — as is known. 
 And this: "upon the lion and the viper" — 
 the initials spell עֵשָׂו [Esav] — as is cited. 
 And then one recites V'Atah Kadosh — see the kavanos.

segments.he: ומתחיל ואומר הא לחמא עניא עיין בכוונות ותבין השייך לענינינו וע"כ כל דכפין ייתי וייכול וכו'. כי ע"י גמילות חסד וצדקה והכנסת אורחים עניים נעשה בחי' אתערותא דלתתא להרים קרן הקדושה ג"כ מעניותה ושפלותה וכאן הוא אדרבא מאחר שהשי"ת חמל עלינו רק באתערותא דלעילא והקים מעפר דל וכו'. ע"כ גם אנחנו צריכין להתנהג במדה זו לחוס ולרחם על העניים בפרט כי חג הפסח הוא כנגד אברהם אבינו ע"ה והוא היה מופלג מאד במדה זו של הכנסת אורחים כמבואר בתורה הק' וכשארז"ל.
segments.en:
[§4]
 And then one recites Vayitein Lecha [And He will give you] — 
 the blessings that Yaakov requested — 
 and all the other verses of blessing and success — 
 all of which flow through the rectifications mentioned above. 
 And then one recites Havdalah over the cup of wine — 
 which also alludes to the drawing-down of these rectifications — 
 and one blesses over the fragrance — 
 the life of the soul in the brain — as stated — 
 and then one blesses over fire — 
 the aspect of Malchus — as cited in the kavanos: 
 the lights of fire are from the aspect of Malchus — 
 and therefore their essential light is at night — 
 which is the aspect of this. 
 And therefore one only blesses over a light that is of Israel — 
 so as not to give hold to the aspect of the sitra achra — the impure fire — 
 the fire of the yetzer hara.
 

 
 [§5]
 And then one recites the blessing of Havdalah — 
 in order to draw through this specifically the holiness of Shabbos 
 onto the six weekdays — 
 as Rashi explains on the verse: 
 *"and G-d saw the light that it was good — and He separated the light from the darkness"* [Bereishis 1:4] — 
 "He saw that it was good and it was not fitting for the wicked to use it — so He separated it." 
 And similarly in our context — 
 for through truly believing in the holiness of Shabbos — 
 that although it appears to the eye as just another day 
 [as the wicked Turnosrophos asked: 
 "What makes this day different from any other?"] — 
 yet its holiness is tremendous and awesome — 
 and there is a vast difference between this day and the other days — 
 and it is the essential life and sustenance of them all — 
 in the aspect of: "the days were formed and one of them is not" [Tehillim 139:16] — 
 this is Shabbos — as our Sages taught — 
 through this one yearns for its holiness also in all the weekdays — 
 pursuing any spark of its holiness — 
 and one mentions its holiness at every turn — 
 in the aspect of: "remember the Shabbos day" — 
 and our Sages expounded: "remember it from the first day of the week" — 
 through this one draws the illumination of its holiness 
 onto the weekdays as well.

segments.he: וזה השתא הכא לשנה הבאה בארעא דישראל וכו' כי ארז"ל בניסן נגאלו ובניסן עתידין ליגאל. וארז"ל במ"ר בא פ' י"ח על פסוק ליל שמורים הוא לה' וכו' ובו אליהו ומשיח מתגדלין שנאמר אמר שומר אתא בוקר וגם לילה וכו' ביום שעשיתי לכם תשועה ובאותה לילה היו יודעים שאני גואלכם וכו'. אם כן מבואר ומובן שבכל לילה ראשונה של פסח נמשך התנוצצות הגאולה שלעתיד ובזה אנו מתנחמין בגליותינו להמשיך עלינו עכשיו ג"כ בחי' החירות והארת המוחין שלעתיד.
segments.en:
[§6]
 And the very fact of attaining some perception of the holiness of Shabbos 
 and distinguishing it from the weekdays — 
 one merits this also only through the illumination of holy daas that shines on Shabbos. 
 And our Sages taught: 
 "Why was Havdalah instituted in the blessing of Chonen HaDaas?" — 
 for "if there is no daas, whence comes distinction?" [Berachos 33a] — 
 and this: 
 "Who distinguishes between holy [Kodesh — the aspect of Chochmah] and weekday — 
 between light and darkness — 
 for Chochmah is the essential light — as stated — 
 between Israel and the nations — 
 for this is the essential distinction — 
 for Israel are of the seed of Yaakov — 
 who merited to receive the Torah 
 and to accept upon themselves the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship — 
 and to bind themselves through all this only to the wisdom and intellect 
 and divine life-force that exists in every thing — 
 aside from the great distinction between them from the side of their souls — 
 in the aspect of: 
 *"and I have separated you from the peoples to be Mine"* [Vayikra 20:26] — 
 and between the seventh day and the six days of labor."

segments.he: וע"כ גם בסיום ההגדה מסיימין ג"כ לשנה הבאה בירושלים. כי אלמלא וכו' בוודאי ובלתי ספרק היה ראוי להיות כך כפי הארת הקדושה העליונה המאירה על כל אחד מישראל בלילה הזה.
segments.en:
[§7]
 And since after the withdrawal of the light the darkness begins to grow stronger — 
 in the aspect of what Adam said when the light that served on the first Shabbos was withdrawn: 
 "and I said: surely darkness shall cover me" [Tehillim 139:11] — 
 and it is known that forgetting also flows from the aspect of darkness — 
 for שָׁכַח [shachach — forgot] is the letters of חֹשֶׁךְ [choshech — darkness] — 
 as cited — and as understood in the discourse Dirshu, Siman 37 — 
 therefore we are concerned lest the darkness and forgetting strengthen 
 and cause one to forget, G-d forbid, 
 the reshimah [impression] that remains from the light of Shabbos's holiness — 
 and therefore one immediately adjures the minister of forgetting 
 that the foolish heart depart from him — 
 which is from the side of Esav — the old and foolish king.
 

 
 [§8]
 And immediately one recites Noach matzah chen [Noah found grace] — 
 for through this one merits the aspect of chen — as stated. 
 And then one recites Eliyahu — etc. — 
 for Eliyahu is from the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of Ben [ב-נ] — as is known — 
 and concerning the Mashiach it is said: 
 *"Behold, my servant shall understand"* [Yeshayahu 52:13] — etc. — 
 and our Sages taught: 
 "If Israel would keep two Shabbosim they would immediately be redeemed" — 
 for through the holiness of the mochin and daas 
 they would receive on the first Shabbos — 
 and through the bond with Shabbos's holiness they would maintain in the weekdays — 
 they would merit to receive the second Shabbos's holiness with additional light — 
 until all aspects of the yetzer hara and the kingdom of the sitra achra 
 would be completely subdued and nullified — 
 and they would be redeemed.

segments.he: ואז נתעוררין התינוקות לשאול מה נשתנה כי גם הם לפי קטנות דעתם מרגישין שינוי גדול והארה חדשה בנפשם ושכלם ומתעוררין לשאול מאביהם מה זה ועל מה זה. ורז"ל סדרו אותם בד' שאלות והלבישו בהם סודות גדולות והכל מיוסד על יסוד התיקונים הגדולים הנמשכין בלילה הזה בדרך הפלא ופלא מאד כמבואר בכוונות.
segments.en:
[§9]
 And then one sets the table for Melaveh Malkah [Escorting the Queen] — 
 and one recites: "This is the feast of Dovid the King." 
 And through this one binds oneself 
 [through the power of the reshimah that remains from Shabbos's holiness] 
 to the aspect of holy Malchus in its fullness — 
 in such a manner that even in the weekdays — 
 the time of the withdrawal of the Shabbos mochin's illumination — 
 one still remains bound to the holiness of holy Malchus at least. 
 And through this eating, holiness is drawn upon all the weekday meals — 
 as explained in the writings — 
 meaning the hold of the side of Esav will not touch the weekday meals — G-d forbid — 
 but even they will be in holiness — 
 in the aspect of: "the righteous eats to satisfy his soul" — as stated.
 

 
 
 Siman 301 and on — The Thirty-Nine Prohibited Labors
 סִימָן ש״א — לָ״ט מְלָאכוֹת הָאֲסוּרוֹת בְּשַׁבָּת

segments.he: וע"כ אפילו שני ת"ח שואלין זה את זה מה נשתנה וכו' כי ע"י ששואלין ומשיבין ומפלפלין בזה בדרך קשיות ותירוצים בזה משברין כח הקליפות (כידוע) וסט"א הרוצים להסתיר ולהעלים גם בחי' ההארה הגדולה של יציאת מצרים וע"י השאלות והתשובות והפלפול והעסק בענין זה בזה משברין כחם ומוסיפין כח בבחי' המלכות דקדושה.
segments.en:
[§1]
 It is impossible to elaborate and explain in detail all the prohibited labors of Shabbos — 
 and also because this would greatly extend the discussion. 
 But the essential summary is: 
 the primary labors are thirty-nine minus one — 
 and our Sages taught that these are all the labors that were in the Tabernacle — 
 with the remaining labors being their derivatives. 
 For it has already been explained that all matters of labor are performed 
 in order to clarify the holy sparks that fell to where they fell — 
 and all through the aspect of holy Malchus that dwells in Asiyah 
 and resides, as it were, among them — 
 in the aspect of: "this is Jerusalem which I have placed in the midst of nations". 
 And the essential clarifications of all are accomplished 
 only through the power of Chochmah and thought — 
 for "all of them are clarified through thought" [Zohar]. 
 And the essential completeness of holy labors was in the work of the Tabernacle — 
 for "the image of the Tabernacle mirrors the image of the act of Creation" [Zohar]. 
 And therefore our Sages truly said concerning Betzalel 
 that he knew how to combine the letters 
 through which heaven and earth were created — 
 and they further taught: 
 just as the act of Creation was done in wisdom and understanding and knowledge — 
 so too in the work of the Tabernacle it is written: 
 *"and I have filled him with the spirit of G-d — with wisdom and understanding and knowledge"* [Shemos 31:3].
 

 
 [§2]
 And this is the aspect of the 39 labors in the Tabernacle — 
 corresponding to the 39 lights contained in the first three letters of the holy Name — 
 which are the aspect of drawing the light of supernal Chochmah 
 to the aspect of the final Heh — the aspect of Malchus. 
 And yet the work of the Tabernacle does not override Shabbos — 
 for on Shabbos all the lights and rectifications flow on their own 
 through the power and merit of Shabbos's holiness — 
 and therefore all labors are forbidden on Shabbos.

segments.he: וזה שארז"ל מוזגין לו כוס שני וכאן הבן שואל כי בכוס ראשון של קידוש לא הרגיש עדיין שום שינוי כי בכל שבת ויו"ט צריכין לקדש וכן על שאר השינוים לא נתעורר עדיין להוציא אל הפועל שאלתו. אבל בכאן בכוס שני שהוא נגד בחי' בינה ומינה דינין מתערין כידוע ומשם שורש כל הקשיות והשאלות ע"כ נתעורר הבן ג"כ להוציא שכלו ומוחין שלו אל הפועל ממש ע"י השאלות ששואל לאביו ובזה שמשיבין לו באריכות ומסדרין כל סדר ההגדה עי"ז ממתיקין הדינים ונמשכין מוחין גדולים וממותקים גם שתיית כוס שני???. וזהו שאומרים עבדים היינו וכו' שהתגבר מאד הכח המלכות דסט"א וכו' ואלו לא הוציא וכו' הרי אנו וכו' כי לא היה שום דרך הטבע לצאת משם לעולם וגם לא זכו ישראל לזה במעשיהם רק ברחמני השי"ת ובידו החזקה וכו' בפרט כי היה אז קודם קבלת התורה כנ"ל.
segments.en:
[§3]
 And the Tur and the Shulchan Aruch arranged the Shabbos laws 
 not according to the sequence of the 39 labors — 
 beginning instead with the matter of walking and talking — etc. — 
 as the Tur explains — 
 for this is the prohibition of pesi'ah gasah [striding] on Shabbos — 
 for it takes one five-hundredth of the light of one's eyes — 
 and the light of one's eyes is from the aspect of the light of Chochmah — as stated. 
 And therefore one must be especially careful on Shabbos — 
 and for a mitzvah — which is from the aspect of holy Malchus — 
 one is permitted to run — 
 and likewise if it brings him delight — 
 and Shabbos delight is from the aspect of holy Chochmah — as is known — 
 one may also run on Shabbos.

segments.he: וע"כ אפילו כולנו חכמים ונבונים ויודעים את התורה בשלימות כל המוחין שהם חב"ד אעפ"כ מצוה עלינו לספר ביציאת מצרים כי הוא נס גדול נפלא מאד יותר מכל הנסים מכמה טעמים וגם מחמת זה בעצמו כי הלא אז היה עדיין קודם קבלת התורה.
segments.en:
[§4]
 And this too is the prohibition of hotza'ah [carrying out from domain to domain] on Shabbos — 
 and the Tanna chose to state it first 
 because it was most beloved to him. 
 And also: bringing in [from outside] is also called hotza'ah [carrying out] — 
 for this is the general principle of the prohibition of labor on Shabbos: 
 not to engage in the clarifications performed through weekday labor — 
 which are the aspect of going out from the private domain to the public domain 
 in order to perform labor and business to earn a profit — 
 and then bringing the abundance and profit from the public domain back into the private domain. 
 And likewise this occurs spiritually — 
 that one descends, as it were, from the private domain — 
 the domain of holy Oneness — 
 into the public domain — 
 the sitra d'mosa — G-d forbid — 
 the aspect of "many have been slain by her" — 
 and: "many — these nations" — as stated. 
 And yet even this is sometimes necessary during the weekdays — 
 in the aspect of: "and Avram descended to Egypt" — 
 in order to clarify and elevate — 
 in the aspect of: "and Avram came up from Egypt". 
 But on Shabbos all of this is forbidden — as stated.
 

 
 [§5]
 "And not speaking on Shabbos as one speaks on weekdays" — 
 for speech is the aspect of Malchus — the mouth — 
 and through it is the essential revelation of daas and Chochmah — 
 in the aspect of: *"from His mouth come knowledge and understanding"* [Mishlei 2:6]. 
 And on weekdays one must sometimes speak words of mundane work and labor 
 for the clarifications — as stated — 
 but on Shabbos even speaking them is forbidden — 
 unless they are heavenly affairs — 
 within the domain of holiness — the private domain — as stated. 
 And therefore it is forbidden to study on Shabbos anything but Torah — 
 and even books of external wisdoms are forbidden [see Shulchan Aruch Siman 307] — 
 for one is not permitted even the slightest deviation from holy Chochmah — 
 even what is permitted on weekdays [for purposes of clarification] 
 is forbidden on Shabbos. 
 And through this one also understands the prohibition of muktza 
 and similar matters explained from Siman 308 onward — 
 for through every movement of a person clarifications are made — 
 even through moving some object from place to place — 
 and therefore on Shabbos our Sages carefully considered 
 and with wisdom and holy spirit determined 
 what to forbid — as it damages Shabbos's holiness — 
 and what to permit — as it does not affect Shabbos's holiness. 
 And all of this is explained through what was said above.

segments.he: וע"כ כל המרבה לספר ביציאת מצרים הרי זה משובח ומובא בכוונות משובח בחסדים כי מעורר כח החסדים הגדולים שנמשכו ונתגלו אז ועי"ז מחיה ומקיים וממשיך קדושה וכח להתגבר על יצרים ולהכניע בחי' הסט"א ולהתקרב אל הקדושה גם אותם שרחוקים גם עכשיו מעסק התורה כגון האנשים הפשוטים וכו' וכמובן מזה באריכות בליקו"ת סימן ע"ח עיי"ש.
segments.en:
Siman 344 — One Who Loses Track of Days in the Wilderness
 סִימָן שד״מ — הַהוֹלֵךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר

 
 [§1]
 One who walks in the wilderness and does not know when Shabbos falls — 
 is forbidden to do any labor — except what is necessary for his basic sustenance — 
 for the essential power through which clarifications are made 
 through weekday labor — all of it is only through the power of Shabbos's holiness — 
 during which one ceases from labor completely. 
 And therefore when Moshe came to warn and command regarding the work of the Tabernacle — 
 he first warned about the holiness of Shabbos — 
 for it is specifically through the power of Shabbos's holiness 
 that the labor is completed in its fullness — 
 with all the rectifications that should come from it. 
 And this is what our Sages expounded: 
 "Remember it from the first day of the week" — 
 meaning to count each day according to its position in the week — 
 so as to always know when Shabbos is — and draw its holiness into every day.

segments.he: ובזה מובן גם מה שכתבנו למעלה שע"י סיפור הגדה ויציאת מצרים נתיישבין הקשיות ונמתקין הדינים היינו ע"י החסדים הגדולים שמתגלין עי"ז כנ"ל ובזה בעצמו משברין ג"כ כח היצה"ר שמתגבר ויונק רק מבחי' הקשיות והסתרת הידיעה כמובן במאמר ויסב סימן ס"ב ע"ש:
segments.en:
[§2]
 And this is also the moral and allegorical teaching: 
 one who has fallen to the aspect of midbar [wilderness] — 
 the place of the sitra achra — 
 and has damaged for himself also the aspect of Shabbos's holiness — G-d forbid — 
 to the degree that he does not know when Shabbos is — 
 for the holy and the weekday have become confused for him — 
 to the point of not feeling Shabbos's holiness at all — G-d forbid — 
 he counts six days and performs no labor except for basic sustenance — 
 and spends the rest of the day engaged in Torah — 
 to give strength to holy Malchus — 
 and throughout all six days yearns for Shabbos's holiness — 
 and certainly when actual Shabbos arrives — 
 certainly he should engage in Torah abundantly — 
 for "Shabbosim were given only for Torah study" — as our Sages taught — 
 especially for such a person. 
 And he yearns and longs greatly for some illumination 
 to shine from the holiness of Shabbos. 
 And this: "and he sanctifies the seventh day with Kiddush and Havdalah" — 
 meaning: for now [before meriting a specific perception of Shabbos's holiness] — 
 one binds oneself strongly to Shabbos's holiness in general — 
 and says with a full mouth that one believes with complete faith 
 that this day is tremendously holy — 
 utterly separate and distinct from all the weekdays — 
 and is the essential life and sustenance of them all — 
 even though one's lowly spiritual level is so great 
 that one does not merit to feel or attain any of its great holiness — 
 nonetheless one binds oneself to its holiness with complete attachment and perfect faith — 
 and gives thanks for one's portion — 
 "Who sanctified us with His commandments and desired us" — etc. — 
 and: "Who distinguished between holy and weekday" — etc. — 
 and on the contrary — it is fitting for me to give thanks even more — with great and intense joy — 
 since I am so distant — and yet I merited this — 
 only in the merit of my forefathers — 
 and fortunate are we — etc. 
 And through all of this one will merit to emerge from the wilderness 
 and subdue the kingdom of the sitra achra 
 and receive the light of Shabbos's holiness in its complete fullness.
 

 
 [§3]
 Siman 345 and on — The Four Domains — 
 for Malchus is the aspect of Dalet [4] — as stated — 
 and therefore in the laws of Shabbos prohibitions there are also four domains — 
 for reshus [domain] is the aspect of Malchus — 
 both in the sense of reshus [dominion — what is in one's power] — 
 and in the sense of poverty and destitution [rash v'ani] — 
 for Malchus is the aspect of Dalet — the aspect of misken v'chacham — as stated. 
 Private domain [reshus hayachid] — 
 ten handbreadths high and four in width — 
 the aspect of Chochmah [ten] and Malchus [four] — 
 when Malchus receives from supernal Chochmah 
 it is in the aspect of the private domain — 
 for one merits through this to be included in His unity. 
 Public domain [reshus harabbim] — 
 the domain of the many — the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 and yet even there are holy sparks of Malchus — 
 and on weekdays one must sometimes go there for clarifications — 
 but on Shabbos this is forbidden from the Torah. 
 Carmelis — a place without partitions and not a public thoroughfare — 
 the light of Chochmah does not shine there fully, 
 nor does the sitra achra have a strong hold there — 
 and therefore from the Torah it is neither reshus hayachid nor reshus harabbim. 
 And likewise a mound or trench that has four by four handbreadths but is not ten handbreadths high — 
 it is alluded to from the aspect of Malchus alone, 
 without the full illumination of Chochmah [which requires ten] — 
 and therefore our Sages forbade carrying into it or out of it 
 whether from the private or public domain. 
 Makom patur [exempt place] — 
 a place that does not have four by four [handbreadths] — 
 not alluding to the aspect of Malchus — 
 yet is more than three handbreadths high — 
 to the very sky — 
 there the external forces have no hold at all — 
 since it is not a public thoroughfare — 
 and moreover they cannot receive life-force from there — 
 since the aspect of holy Malchus is not alluded to there — 
 and therefore it is an exempt place. 
 For even though there is certainly holy life-force there too — 
 in the aspect of *"the whole earth is full of His glory"* [Yeshayahu 6:3] — 
 yet it is there in concealment — 
 since there is no four-by-four place alluding to Malchus — as stated — 
 and therefore clarifications through the labor of carrying do not apply there. 
 [(And if I have erred, G-d forbid, may He Who is compassionate forgive.)]

segments.he: וזה מעשה ברבי אליעזר וכו' והיו מספרין (ומאירין) ביציאת מצרים כל אותו הלילה (שהוא בחי' מלכות שמים שלימה) עד שבאו תלמידיהם ואמרו רבותינו הגיע זמן ק"ש של שחרית שהיא בחי' קבלת עול מלכות שמים שלימה והמשכת המוחין כידוע. וזה אמר ראב"ע וכו' כל ימי חייך ימי חייך הימים שאז זוכין להמשכת המוחין שהם עיקר החיים והם בחי' אור יום ממש כמבפ"נ. כל ימי חייך להביא הלילות שהם בחי' חשך בחי' הסתלקות המוחין שהם בחי' האור אעפ"כ גם אז צריך לזכור יציאת מצרים שהוא בחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל כי הלא ראינו כי התחלת גאולת מצרים היתה דייקא בלילה כ"ש ליל שימורים הוא וכו' (עיין בגמרא).
segments.en:
[§3b]
 And this is understood from it: 
 the air of the reshus harabbim above ten handbreadths 
 is an exempt place — 
 for above ten the power of holiness grows stronger 
 [as our Sages taught: 
 "the Shechinah never descended below ten handbreadths" — etc.] — 
 and therefore clarifications do not apply there. 
 But the air of the reshus hayachid — 
 which alludes to holiness — as stated — 
 is reshus hayachid all the way up to the heavens — 
 for holiness ascends without limit. 
 And therefore even if a place within it has no four by four handbreadths — 
 if it is nine handbreadths high and many people use it as a step — 
 it becomes reshus harabbim — since it serves the public. 
 But above ten handbreadths the power of holiness strengthens — 
 and since it has no four-by-four [Malchus] — 
 clarifications do not apply there — 
 and it is exempt.

segments.he: וחכ"א ימי חייך העוה"ז כל ימי חייך להביא לימות המשיח שאז תהיה גאולה שלימה ויהיו נמשכין התיקונים הנ"ל בתכלית השלימות אעפ"כ גם אז יזכירו יציאת מצרים כי אף שיציאת מצרים בענין מהות הגאולה עצמה תהיה רק טפילה מחמת שלא היתה גאולה שלימה והיה אחריה גליות הרבה אעפ"כ הוא ההתחלה הראשונה ויסוד הראשון של גאולת ישראל ואז זכו ישראל לקבל התורה שעי"ז יש לנו קיום בכל הגליות ועי"ז נזכה לגאולה שלימה והכל בכח ההתחלה הראשונה של יציאת מצרי' ע"י מרע"ה ומה שהיה הוא שיהיה כידוע.
segments.en:
[§4]
 One who carries four cubits in the public domain is liable — 
 for the four cubits of a person are his own [domain] — 
 for amah [cubit] alludes to the aspect of the upper Heh and the Vav — 
 through which the illumination of Chochmah is drawn — 
 for it [the cubit measure] is the numerical value 
 of the filled spelling of the Name Ayin-Beis [72] — as is known. 
 And Dalet [four] alludes to the aspect of Malchus. 
 Therefore our Sages taught: 
 "Since the day the Temple was destroyed 
 [through the strengthening of the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra] 
 Hashem has nothing in His world except the four cubits of Halachah" [Berachos 8a] — 
 for there all the rectifications are drawn through Torah and Halachah study. 
 And therefore one who carries beyond four cubits [in the public domain] 
 is liable — as one who carried from the private to the public domain — as stated.
 

 
 
 Simanim 358–396 — Eruvin
 סִימָן שנ״ח–שצ״ו — הִלְכוֹת עֵרוּבִין

segments.he: וזה ברוך המקום ברוך הוא וכו'. היינו כמו שהשי"ת שנקרא מקומו של עולם ומלא כל הארץ כבודו ואתה מחיה את כולם ואף על פי כן הוא נעלם וסתים מכל סתימין שזה בחי' ברוך הוא, כמו כן באופן זה נתן התורה הקדושה לעמו ישראל כי אורייתא שמא דקוב"ה סתים וגלייא כמבואר בזוה"ק וע"כ התורה היא מחיה כל המדריגות ונותנת חיים לכל אחד ואחד כפי מדריגתו ובחינתו, וע"כ גם המלכות דקדושה עיקר כחה להתגבר וכו' הוא ע"י התורה הקדושה כי היא הולכת עם האדם בכל המדריגות בחי' בהתהלכך תנחה אותך וכו'.
segments.en:
[§1]
 Any enclosure larger than a beis se'asayim [an area of two se'ah measures] 
 — like the courtyard of the Tabernacle — 
 our Sages gave the law of carmelis — 
 for the courtyard is the aspect of Malchus — as is known — 
 especially the Tabernacle's courtyard. 
 And anything larger than this measure departs from this aspect — 
 and therefore one may not carry in it more than four cubits — 
 unless it was enclosed for dwelling purposes — 
 in which case it becomes subsidiary to the house — 
 which too is the aspect of Malchus — as is known.
 

 
 [§2]
 An alley [mavoy] — which also alludes to the aspect of Malchus — 
 that has three walls — is from the Torah a full private domain — 
 for the three walls form the shape of a Beis — the aspect of Malchus — 
 or the shape of a ches — the aspect of Chochmah — as stated. 
 Yet our Sages still forbade carrying in it 
 unless one places a lechee [side-post] — the aspect of Yosef — 
 or a korah [crossbeam] — the aspect of Yaakov — 
 as explained in the Maurai Or — 
 and they are those who first kept Shabbos — as our Sages expounded.

segments.he: וזה כנגד ארבעה בנים דיברה תורה כי היא כוללת כל המדריגות ומדברת עם כל אחד לפי בחינתו ומדריגתו לאחד מרמזת קצת מקדושתה הנעלם בתוכה שזה בחי' מה שארז"ל התורה כולה שמותיו של הקב"ה ועי"ז מכנעת היצה"ר שלו ומגרשת הרוח שטות ממנו.
segments.en:
[§3]
 Our Sages instituted Eruv Chatzeiros [courtyard merger] [Siman 366] — 
 not to carry from one domain to another 
 even between neighbors in the same courtyard — 
 unless they make an eruv. 
 For no two people are equal in their level — 
 especially in the matter of the learning mentioned above — 
 of accepting the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship 
 and truly gazing only at the holy light of the intellect. 
 And therefore, since the other person dwells in his own house — 
 one may not carry into his domain except through an eruv — 
 through which they become as if dwelling together — 
 for the Shabbos meal encompasses all the rectifications mentioned above — 
 and therefore when they have joined through an eruv 
 the two domains are considered as one.
 

 
 [§4]
 The dwelling of a non-Jew does not prohibit [Siman 382] — 
 for on Shabbos the sitra achra is fully subdued — 
 and the non-Jew's dwelling is not considered a dwelling at all on Shabbos — 
 and only forbids if there are two Jews in two separate houses — 
 for then an eruv is needed to prevent the aspect of the alma d'peruda 
 [world of division] from taking hold. 
 And if so, even the non-Jew's domain forbids — 
 and renting from him alone does not help — 
 for it is already nullified — 
 and therefore one must also rent from him. 
 And all of this our Sages instituted in order to 
 distance Israel from dwelling together with non-Jews — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: ועם אחד מדברת באיתגליא דברי חכמה ומוסר השכל ודיבורי יראת שמים בכל הבחינות ובכל האופנים עד שנתעורר עי"ז לילך בדרך הישר, ועיין בפנים במאמר שאנו עוסקין בו ותבין: ועיין בכונות מבואר שסוד ארבעה בנים הם כנגד בחי' המלכות שבדל"ת עולמות ומובא מזה בדברי רז"ל במאמר מישרא סימן למ"ד ונכון ג"כ לענינינו.
segments.en:
[§4b]
 Shitufei Mevo'os [joining of alleyways] [Siman 386 and on] — 
 this too is the same as explained above.

segments.he: וזה אחד חכם כנגד בחי' חכמה הנ"ל ואחד רשע הוא בחי' ההיפך ממש בחי' לא יחפוץ כסיל בתבונה וכו'. ואחד תם הוא בחי' המכריע עצמו אל הקדושה בכח התורה הקדושה שזה בחי' ויעקב איש תם יושב אהלים באהלה של תורה כשארז"ל וע"כ נקרא תם כי תורת ה' תמימה. ואחד שאינו יודע לשאול שזה בחי' המלכות בחי' תפלה כשהיא בעניותה ושפלותה אז כביכול הוא בבחי' שאינו יודע לשאול וכמו שאמר דוד ה' שפתי תפתח וכו' ואצל אסתר (שהיא גם כן בחינת המלכות דקדושה כידוע) נאמר ובהגיע תור אסתר וכו' לא בקשה דבר וכו' וסיים הכתוב ותהי אסתר נושאת חן וכו', אצל השונמית כשאמר לה אלישע היש לדבר לך אל המלך וכו' ותאמר בתוך עמי אנכי יושבת כי ראתה התגברות הדינים שבראש השנה והיתה מתייראת לשאול בפרטיות על עצמה וכמבואר בזוה"ק וזה שאמר דוד ואני נסכתי מלכי וכו' ה' אמר אלי בני אתה וכו' שאל ממני וכו' כי השי"ת בעצמו פתח את פיו ואמר לו לשאול, וע"כ אמר אחת שאלתי מאת ה' וכו' כי אפילו כשאומרין לו לשאול אינו שואל רק לחזות בנועם ה' היינו לקבל אור החכמה העליונה ששם עיקר הנועם והעונג כידוע שזה בחי' מה שהמלכות דקדושה היא בבחי' מסכן וחכם כנ"ל, וע"כ גם אצל שלמה נאמר כשאמר לו הקב"ה שאל מה אתן לך ולא שאל רק שיתן לו לב שומע לשפוט וכו' להבין בין טוב לרע והוטב בעיני ה' ואמר לו יען אשר שאלת וכו' ולא שאלת וכו' הנה נתתי לך לב חכם ונבון וכו' וגם אשר לא שאלת נתתי לך וכו'.
segments.en:
[§5]
 The laws of Techumin [Shabbos boundaries] [Siman 396] — 
 it is explained in the book Yikara d'Shabbata that the secret of the Shabbos boundary — 
 two thousand cubits — 
 alludes to both aspects: 
 the ches and the nun — 
 the aspect of Chochmah and Malchus — as stated. 
 And likewise Eruv Techumin — 
 for since one placed there food for two meals — 
 which also allude to the two aspects — 
 one's location is considered to be there for purposes of the boundary — 
 and one is permitted to walk from there two thousand cubits in any direction. 
 And see the Shulchan Aruch — and you will understand many matters and laws 
 explained there — all according to the above.

segments.he: וזה אתה אמור לו כהלכות הפסח אין מפטירין אחר הפסח אפיקומן, היינו שאין אוכלין אחריו כלום כדי שישאר טעם פסח בפיו וכמו כן הדין לענין אכילת מצת האפיקומן כדי שישאר טעם מצה בפיו. וכבר נתבאר כי פסח ומצה רומזין לבחי' מלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' אמונה וקבלת מלכות שמים שלימה. היינו שמשיבין לו שעיקר העבודה שמוטל עלינו הוא לקבל עלינו עול מלכות שמים באמונה שלימה. ועי"ז באין ממילא להמשכת המוחין הקדושים וכשזוכה לאיזה בחי' המשכת המוחין אזי תכלית הידיעה היא אשר לא נדע ואז משיג יותר שעדיין איני יודע כלל רק שזוכה לאמונה בהירה וזכה ביותר ואז זוכה להמשיך מוחין גדולים ביותר וחוזר חלילה עד עולם. כנ"ל לענין מה שהשיב השי"ת למשה שיאמר לישראל ששמו אהיה אשר אהיה. נמצא שלעולם נשאר האדם רק על יסוד האמונה וקבלת מלכות שמים כנ"ל. וע"כ הפסח ומצה שהם בחי' המלכות דקדושה נאכלים באחרונה בתשלום כל הסעודה כדי שישאר טעמם בפיו היינו כנ"ל.
