segments.he: נמצא שמשיבין לו על שאלתו ששואל ומבקש להודיע לו בחי' המשכת המוחין הקדושים ועל זה משיבין לו כהלכות הפסח שהוא אותיות פ"ה ס"ח כמובא בכוונות היינו שהחיוב עלינו העיקר לשוח ולדבר אחד עם חבירו בדיבורי האמונה הקדושה בבחי' אודיע אמונתך בפי שזה בחי' מלכות פה ועי"ז בעצמו זוכין להמשכת המוחין שהם עיקר החיים גימטריא ס"ח. וזה בחי' אהיה הויה אהיה גימטריא חיים בחי' חיי המלך כמובא בכונות. היינו שמתחילין באמונה ומלכות רק שמצפה ומשתוקק להשיג איזה ידיעה דקדושה שזה בחי' אהיה דא אנא זמין למיהוי ועי"ז בעצמו זוכין לבחי' המשכת המוחין שזה בחי' הויה כידוע ואז זוכה לידע ולהשיג ביותר שאינו יודע עדיין כלל ומתחזק רק באמונה ומלכות שמיים ומצפה להשיג עוד מוחין גדולים ביותר שזה בחי' אהיה השני וזה עיקר בחי' החיים כמבואר מזה במ"א באריכות.

segments.he: וזה מבואר בפ' ואתחנן כי ישאלך בנך מחר לאמור מה העדות וכו' (שזה שאלת הבן חכם) ואמרת לבנך עבדים היינו לפרעה במצרים וכו' ואתנו הוציא משם למען הביא אותנו לתת לנו את הארץ וכו'. היינו שיודיעו שאע"פ שבוודאי צריכין להשתוקק להמשיך בחי' השגת המוחין כי זה בחינת מסכן וחכם הנ"ל אבל צריך להיות בלב נשבר ורוח נמוכה ושפלה מאד וידע כי לא זכה לזה במעשיו רק שמצפה ומבקש מתנת חנם מאת בעל החסד והרחמן האמיתי כי ה' יתן חכמה וכו' למען יזכה עי"ז לקבל עליו עול מלכותו ית' בידיעה שלימה ביותר וכשיזכה לאיזה בחי' ידיעה חדשה אזי ישתדל להמשיך הידיעה הזאת העיקר למעשה כי לא המדרש עיקר וכו' וצריך שיהיו מעשיו מרובין מחכמתו.

segments.he: וזה שביארה התורה מה להשיב לו וזה ואמרת לבנך וכפל תיבת לבנך ולא אמר ואמרת אליו כי האמת שבוודאי הוא בן חכם וחביב כי זה עיקר שלימות הבן בחי' חכם בני וכו' ונאמר בן חכם ישמח אב אבל אעפ"כ יודיע לו כי אין זה שלימות לצפות רק להמשכת המוחין והחכמה ולכנוס בזה בדרך שאלה וקשיא מה הם המוחים ומדוע לא זכה גם הוא אליהם. כי האל תיכף שנדמה לו שכבר היגע למדריגה שהיה ראוי להמשכת המוחין אולי הוא בכלל גאוה ורמות רוחא וזה בעצמו מעכב ההשגה כי כל המתגאה חכמתו מסתלקת ממנו ומכש"כ שאינו זוכה להשגה חדשה ובפרט שכל מי שחכמתו מרובה ממעשיו וכו'. ע"כ העיקר לחשוב האדם תמיד על עניותו ושפלות מדריגתו ושמצד עצמו אינו ראוי לשום דבר טוב רק הכל רק בחסדי ה' ובזכות אבותינו.

segments.he: וע"כ מתחיל בגנאי ואומר עבדים היינו וכו' היינו שהתגבר המלכות דסט"א ושיעבדה עמנו וכו'. ויוציאנו ה' ממצרים ביד חזקה (כי לא היינו כדאי לזה) ויתן ה' אותות וכו' במצרים בפרעה וכל ביתו לעינינו היינו שהכניע המלכות דסט"א בהכנעה גמורה ואותנו הוציא משם וכו' היינו שעיקר תכלית היציאה משם להביא אותנו לא"י ולקיים שם כל התורה כולה כי הרבה מצוות תלוים בא"י גם א"י היא בחי' מלכות שמים והמשכת המוחין כי אוירה מחכים. ויצונו ה' לעשות את כל החוקים האלה (שהם בחי' חכמה כמובא בכונות) ליראה את ה' אלהינו (שהוא בחי' מלכות בחי' מוראה של מלכות שזה תכלית החכמה וראשיתה כנ"ל) וזה לטוב לנו כל הימים (שהם בחי' המדות) לחיותינו כהיום הזה כי עי"ז זוכין לחיים שהם בחי' המשכת המוחין. וזה וצדקה תהיה לנו כי נשמור לעשות את כל המצוה הזאת לפני ה' אלהינו כאשר צונו. היינו שלא נחשוב ונתאר מאחר שקבלנו עלינו עול מלכות שמים וקיום מצוותיו ית' א"כ ראוים אנחנו להשגה והמשכת המוחין כי לא זה הדרך כנ"ל רק אנו צריכין לחשוב הכל רק לצדקה ומתנת חנם. וזה כי נשמור לעשות את כל המצוה הזאת. שהיא בחי' קבלת מלכות שמים וקיום מצוותיו כי עשיה היא בחי' מלכות כידוע. וזה לפני ה' אלהינו. זה בחי' המשכת המוחין לידע ולהרגיש במוחו ולבו אלהותו ית' כאלו רואהו עין בעין ועומד לפניו ית'. שזה בחי' שויתי ה' לנגדי תמיד. וזה כאשר צונו. כי באמת צונו לקיים המצוות רק באופן זה וזה בעצמו תחשב לנו לצדקה גדולה ומתנת חנם. ונדבת חסד כנ"ל.

segments.he: נמצא מבואר כל הנ"ל באריכות קצת. וחז"ל כללו כל ענין התשובה להחכם במלות קצרות כפי ענינם כנ"ל. וזה ג"כ מרומז בלשון כהלכות הפסח.
segments.en:
Siman 242 (Kavod Shabbos): Shabbos encompasses all three pillars — Malchus (Shabbas Malkesa), Chochmah (the feast of Atika Kadisha), and Torah (the primary Torah reading is Shabbos). Kavod [honor] = Chochmah (32 paths = numerical value of kavod) + Torah ("no honor except Torah") + Malchus (Melech HaKavod) + Prayer. Oneg [delight] = Eden-Nahar-Gan — Chochmah, Torah, and Malchus. Fish on Shabbos = nun = Malchus + open-eyed wisdom. Shabbos eating is entirely holy — no hold for Esav. The challah mitzvah = first-fruits of Chochmah = the Shechinah united with the Forefathers = chen.

 Siman 243 (Non-Jew and Shabbos): Shabbos was given only to Israel. Non-Jews who "rest" are liable — for the clarification-mission is Israel's alone. Amirah l'akum is prohibited because labor done on a Jew's intention strengthens the sitra achra. Even maras ayin is a concern — for the signs of Shabbos (shin-bat) encompass the three colors of the eye = three holy mochin.

segments.he: כי פסח תרגומו חיים כ"ש זבח פסח ותרגומו דבח חיים וכן עוד כמה וכמו שפירש"י היינו שילמדו ויאמרו לו שידע שהכל רק בדרך חמלה וחנינה וחיים בחי' צדקה כנ"ל.
segments.en:
Simanim 248–250 (Preparing for Shabbos): Three days before Shabbos = Nefesh/Ruach/Neshamah = three rectifications. Erev Shabbos fasting = clearing the palate for Shabbos's holy eating. Knead challah, taste the Shabbos dishes, prepare personally (direct performance draws holiness). Sharpening the knife = אֵת and sikkin both allude to Malchus.

 Simanim 252–267 (Preparatory laws, shofar, candles): Labor that begins before Shabbos and completes on its own = valid, because the reishis (beginning = Chochmah) was before Shabbos. The Erev Shabbos shofar blast = arousal of the mochin. Three pre-Shabbos announcements = tithe (Malchus), eruv (Torah), candle lighting (Chochmah/light). Hot water immersion = drawing Yaakov and Yosef's fire to subdue the klippos, then immersing in the waters of supernal chesed. White garments = whiteness of the brain (lavan = 32 + nun). The Shabbos candle wick = Malchus; oil = Chochmah — they must be perfectly united.

segments.he: וזה רשע מה הוא אומר וכו' כי הוציא עצמו מן הכלל ופרק ממנו עול מלכות שמים וממילא הוא רחוק מן החכמה דקדושה בתכלית כי הוא בבחי' לא יחפוץ כסיל בתבונה ולא עוד שנדמה לו שהוא חכם. בבחי' ראית איש חכם בעיניו וכו'. וע"כ נסמך להחכם.
segments.en:
Simanim 266–267 (Traveler overtaken by Shabbos; Shomer Yisrael): Even an impure donkey belonging to a Jew has some hold in holiness and may not carry on Shabbos. Jewish money too has a root in holiness (betzal hachochmah betzal hakesef). A found object — not yet in Jewish possession — may not be given even to a non-Jew. On Shabbos night one does not conclude with Shomer amo Yisrael — for Shabbos itself is the protection from all afflictions, since its light of Chochmah subdues all the sitra achra.

 Simanim 268–269 (Friday night prayer and Kiddush): Mizmor l'Dovid's three havus = three mochin; seven koles = seven attributes. Lecha Dodi = welcoming the Malchus. Shir l'Yom HaShabbos = Moshe (Chochmah/sun) + Shlomo (Malchus/moon) — one cannot receive Chochmah except through Malchus. The psalm: joy in the morning (Chochmah) and song at evening (Malchus). Atah Kidashta = the ultimate purpose: all Creation was created for "knowing Him." Vayechal, Vayishbos, Vayevorech, Vayekadesh — all allude to the two aspects. Kiddush: cup = Malchus; wine = Chochmah drawn to Malchus. The original institution of Kiddush in the synagogue was for wayfarers (orchim) — the righteous whose essential eating and drinking is through the light of the intellect received through Malchus (bei kenishta).

segments.he: דקדושה כי הוא ההיפך ממש כנ"ל. והוא בחי' עשו הרשע.
segments.en: Siman 274 (Lechem Mishneh): Double bread = doubled abundance from Chochmah = firstness = firstborn's double portion. Shabbos eating is entirely holy spiritual nourishment — physical abundance follows automatically as the lower is encompassed within the higher.

segments.he: וזה ואף אתה הקהה את שיניו. כי הל"ב שניים הם כנגד הל"ב נתיבות החכמה כידוע. כי באמת צריכין חכמה וקדושה גדולה ללעוס את המאכל ולברר כל בחי' הבירורים דקדושה כי כולהו במחשבה איתברירו ועשו שפגם בהחכמה דקדושה ע"כ אמר הלעיטני נא כי אכל בהלעטה ובתאוה גדולה כ"כ עד שלא הספיק ללעוס המאכל בשיניו כראוי רק בדרך הלעטה.
segments.en:
Siman 281 (Shabbos morning): Sleeping in on Shabbos = receiving elevated mochin. The extra songs and Psalms: zammeru l'malkeinu — zammeru maskil — "sing praises to our King — sing with understanding" — Malchus and Chochmah. Torah reading = the completeness of all rectifications. Haftarah = drawing Chochmah downward from level to level. Reading twice plus Targum = Yaakov + Yosef (Chochmah) + building of Nukva (Malchus). The three prayers of Shabbos correspond to three aspects of Shabbos: Atah Kidashta = Shabbos Bereishis (revelation of Malchus through Creation); Yismach Moshe = Shabbos of Matan Torah (Torah separates Israel from the nations — non-Jews who rest on Shabbos are liable to death); Atah Echad = Shabbos of the World to Come (complete attainment of Chochmah — "if I knew Him I would be Him"). Musaf = Malchus ascends to the mochin. The absence of a sin-offering confirms: on Shabbos the yetzer hara has no hold. The Shabbos meal = seudasa d'Atika Kadisha — the source of all mochin.

 Simanim 291–292 (Minchah and three meals): The three passages of Tzidkascha = Moshe (Chochmah), Yosef (the bond of Chochmah and Malchus), Dovid (Malchus + prayer). Yosef-Moshe-Dovid numerically = Tefilah. The third Shabbos meal is the feast of Atika Kadisha [the Holy Ancient One] — the source of all mochin.

segments.he: ע"כ אף לזה הרשע הקהה את שיניו כי למה לו השיניים וגם רומז לבזות ולחרף ולמאס בחכמתו הרעה אשר תקוה לכסיל ממנו כנ"ל. וזה ואמור לו בעבור זה עשה ה' לי וכו' אלו היה שם לא היה נגאל. כי מאחר שהוא רשע ודבק בסטרא דמותא בוודאי היה נשאר שם בין אותם שמתו בשלשת ימי האפילה כשארז"ל.
segments.en:
Siman 293 (Motzai Shabbos — Havdalah): The four components of Havdalah: wine (Malchus), fragrance (soul-life in the brain = Chochmah), fire (Malchus — fire only blessed from Jewish sources), and the Havdalah blessing itself (drawing Shabbos's holiness into the weekdays). Havdalah is placed in the blessing of Chonen HaDaas because "without daas there is no distinction." The reshimah [impression] of Shabbos's light must be preserved against the growing darkness of forgetting. Immediately reciting Noach matzah chen restores the chen. Eliyahu — Malchus — signals the imminent redemption. Melaveh Malkah = escorting the Queen — binding Malchus through the reshimah so that even weekday meals partake of Shabbos's holiness.

 Simanim 301, 344 (39 labors, the lost wanderer): The 39 labors of the Tabernacle = 39 lights in the first three letters of the holy Name — drawing Chochmah to Malchus. On Shabbos all these lights flow without labor — hence all labor is forbidden. The wanderer lost in the wilderness (allegorically: one whose Shabbos sense has been confused) must count six days of Torah study and yearning — sanctifying the seventh in general faith even without specific attainment — until the full illumination is restored.

segments.he: ובדרך צחות יש לומר כי לי מרמז להתקשרות חכמה תתאה בחכמה עילאה שזה בחי' מילוי הלבנה כמבואר בליקות"נ סימן צ"א.
segments.en:
Simanim 345–396 (Four Domains, Eruvin, Techumin): Four domains = Malchus (Dalet). Private domain (10 × 4) = Malchus receiving from Chochmah. Public domain = the many = sitra achra (yet even there are holy sparks). Carmelis: a mound or trench with four by four but not ten — Malchus without the full Chochmah illumination — forbidden rabbinically. Makom patur: less than four by four — no Malchus — exempt, even though G-d's glory fills it, it is concealed there. Air of reshus hayachid extends all the way to the heavens — holiness has no upper limit. Four cubits of a person: amah = upper Heh + Vav = numerical value of the filled Name of Ayin-Beis [72]; four = Malchus. The Sages' institution of eruvin = distancing Israel from dwelling with non-Jews. Shabbos boundary of 2000 cubits = ches + nun = Chochmah + Malchus.

segments.he: וזה בעבור זה עשה ה' לי דייקא כי אני מהמאמינים במשה רבינו ע"ה ואז היה יכול לעלות ממצרים ע"י משה רבינו ע"ה שהיה יכול להעלות גם הרשעים ולהחזירם למוטב עי"ז שהיה מקשר חכמה תתאה בחכמה עילאה כמבואר שם.
segments.en: Part IV: Orach Chaim Simanim 242–397 (complete Shabbos section).

segments.he: משא"כ אותם שיצאו מן הכלל לגמרי ח"ו בוודאי אלו היה שם לא היה נגאל. וזה מבואר גם בתורה הק' בפ' בא והיה כי יאמרו אליכם בניכם מה העבודה הזאת לכם ואמרתם. ולא כתיב ואמרתם אליהם. כי אל תען כסיל כאולתו ואסור להסתכל בפני רשע ולדבר עמו.
segments.en:

segments.he: אך אעפ"כ בדברי תורה כתיב ענה כסיל כאולתו פן יהיה חכם בעיניו בפרט רשע הזה אשר הוא חכם בעיניו ביותר בבחי' עשו הרשע כנ"ל ע"כ כתיב ואמרתם היינו שידבר בעצמו כי כל שלא אמר שלשה דברים אלו בפסח לא יצא ידי חובתו וכו' ע"כ ואמרתם זבח פסח הוא לה' ותרגומו דבח חיים הוא וכו' כי זה רק מרחמיו ית' אשר פסח על בתי בני ישראל, בתי בני ישראל הם בחי' מלכות דקדושה שנקרא בית בחי' בית מלכות וחכמה דקדושה נקרא בית בחי' בחכמה יבנה בית וכנ"ל כ"פ. וזה בנגפו את מצרים שהם מצד הסט"א ואת בתינו הציל נמצא מבואר כי דייקא בתי בני ישראל שהיו דבקים בקדושה הציל וגם זה בחמלתו ית' ובזכות דם פסח שנתנו על המשקוף ועל שתי המזוזות אבל רשעים כאלו אם היו שם לא היו ניצולים ונגאלים:

segments.he: וזה ואמרת אליו בחוזק יד הוציאנו ה' ממצרים וכו' היינו שבשביל זה היה השי"ת באמת צריך לגלות ידו החזקה. וזה ויהי כי הקשה פרעה לשלחנו מחמת זה בעצמו שהיה עדיין קודם קבלת התורה ולא היה זכות ישראל מספיק לזה והסט"א רצתה להתגבר בבחי' החכמה והמלכות שלהם שהם בחי' בכורה דסט"א. וזה ויהרוג ה' כל בכור בארץ מצרים מבכור אדם ועד בכור בהמה וזכינו אז לקדושת הבכורה כנ"ל (עיין בכוונות):

segments.he: וזה ושאינו יודע לשאול שהוא כנגד בחי' המלכות בעת עניותה ושפלותה שנתרחקה מן דודה כביכול ואין לה פתחון פה לשאול שום דבר כלל. ומזה בעצמו נמשך בחי' התגברות הסט"א ויש לו פה להבן רשע ח"ו. כי אמלאה החרבה כתיב. וזה את פתח לו כי בלילה הזאת מחויבין להאיר ולפתוח פתח של חכמה גם לאנשים כאלו מחמת גודל ההארה שמאיר אז וזה בחי' פתח פיך לאלם בחי' פתח דבריך יאיר. וזה שנאמר והגדת לבנך ביום ההוא לאמור. הגדה רמיז בחכמתא. עיין זוהר שלח דף קס"א. היינו שימשיך הארת החכמה גם עליו מאחר שבזה הזמן נמשך הארת החכמה אל המלכות בהארה נפלאה שזה סוד אכילת מצה וביעור חמץ ושאור כנ"ל. ע"כ צריכין להגיד ולספר גם להשאינו יודע לשאול ששרשו מבחי' זאת בעבור זה עשה ה' לי וכו' כנ"ל. ובתוך זה רומז תשובה גם לבן רשע שעיקר התגברותו הוא על בחי' המלכות דקדושה כנ"ל.

segments.he: וזה יכול מר"ח שאז מתחלת הלבנה להתמלאות ונמשך בחי' הארת התיקונים הנ"ל בפרט מר"ח ניסן שאז מאיר הארה גדולה ביותר כנ"ל. ת"ל ביום ההוא וכו' בעבור זה לא אמרתי אלא וכו' כי אז נמשכים התיקנים הנ"ל בשלימות נפלא ואז עיקר הזמן לספר ביציאת מצרים ולהודיע נפלאותיו ית' לכל אחד ואחד כפי בחינתו כנ"ל:
segments.en:
Siman 417 and on — Rosh Chodesh
 סִימָן תי״ז — הִלְכוֹת רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ

[§1]
The laws of Rosh Chodesh. For on Rosh Chodesh the moon begins to rise from its diminishment and fill — and therefore it draws upon itself the aspect of the future state: "the moonlight shall be as the sunlight" [Yeshayahu 30:26] — for in truth it is impossible to receive the supernal light of the intellect — which is the aspect of the sun — except through the aspect of the nun — Malchus — which is the aspect of the moon. And since the essential power of holy Malchus to prevail over the sitra achra is only through Torah study — the essential sanctification of the month depends upon the Great Sanhedrin in Yerushalayim — where the essential completeness of Torah knowledge is — as it is written: *"if a matter is too difficult for you — you shall arise and go up"* [Devarim 17:8]. And this is the aspect of what is required to declare "Mekudash hachodesh" [the month is sanctified] — mekudash specifically — meaning the illumination of supernal Chochmah — which is called Kodesh — is drawn upon it. And since Malchus — the moon — is the aspect of the feminine — therefore specifically women do not perform labor on Rosh Chodesh. And this is the aspect of fasting on Erev Rosh Chodesh and multiplying repentance — to subdue the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav — whose essential hold is in the implements of eating — as stated — and also to rectify whatever was damaged in the aspect of holy Malchus throughout the passing month.

segments.he: ועכשיו מתחיל בגנות עוד הפעם באופן אחר. ואמר מתחלה עובדי ע"ז היו אבותינו ועכשיו קרבנו המקום לעבודתו וזה תשובה מספקת וידיעה הכרחית לכל אחד לבל יתפלא על עצמו מהנעשה עמו בכח בחירתו כי הוא פעם כשר ופעם פסול וכו' כי מושרש בנו דבר זה ממה שאבותינו היו מתחלה עובדי עבודה זרה ככל הגוים רק שבחסדו קירב אותנו אלו ובחר בנו מכל העמים וכו' וע"כ היצר הרע וכל האומות שהם בחי' הסט"א מתגרים בנו ביותר, רק שגם זאת צריך לידע שעכשיו קרבנו המקום לעבודתו, וידוע שמלת "ועכשיו" מגבלת את הזמן ביותר, היינו ועכשיו דייקא בזה היום והשעה והרגע שאנו מדברין ועוסקין בו. כי צריכין להאמין שבלילה הזאת ובפרט בשעה זו שישראל יושבין על הסדר ועוסקין בסיפור יציאת מצרים ולקיים המצות שבזאת הלילה נמשך אז מלמעלה הארה גדולה כזאת על כל אחד מישראל עד שכל אחד יכול להתקרב לעבודת השי"ת בהתקרבות אמיתי אפילו אם עבר עליו מה שעבר.
segments.en:
[§2]
And this is the aspect of Rosh Chodesh — Rosh [head] specifically — for through the ascent of holy Malchus one merits to receive the illumination of the Head and the mochin anew. And see in Yalkut Chadash — it is brought there how the guardian angel of Esav is subdued on Rosh Chodesh — and this is the secret of the goat-offering of Rosh Chodesh — see there. And therefore Rosh Chodesh itself is forbidden in fasting and eulogy — and it is a mitzvah to increase one's meal — for the klippa of Esav — the sitra achra — which is the aspect of grief and sighing — is subdued. And therefore one does not sanctify the month at night — for the essential sanctification is to draw upon Malchus the light of day — so that the moonlight should be as the sunlight. And therefore specifically during the day — if one omitted Ya'aleh v'Yavo one returns — for one must mention the holiness of Rosh Chodesh in every prayer — for through its holiness — which is the aspect of redemption — one must therefore also recite Hallel. And this is the aspect of the Torah reading — for the essential power of Malchus to prevail is through Torah — as stated. And this is the aspect of the four who are called up [to the Torah] — for through Torah one elevates Malchus from poverty and destitution to the aspect of Chochmah — where the essential wealth is. And afterwards one prays Musaf — corresponding to the Rosh Chodesh offerings — for an additional high holiness is drawn: "a time of atonement for all their generations" — and: "a remembrance for all of them — and the salvation of their souls from the enemy" — and it is cited in the Eshel Avraham that "the enemy" means the yetzer hara — the essential enemy — as stated. And this: one is to intend on Rosh Chodesh the holy Name Shaday — for this Name is most efficacious in subduing the yetzer hara. And this is what is explained in the holy Zohar — that the Musaf of Rosh Chodesh corresponds to the aspect of Malchus — and therefore one mentions in it the songs of Dovid — who merited the aspect of holy Malchus in its fullness. And this: our Sages taught [Rosh Hashanah 23a]: "Rebbi said to Rabbi Chiya: 'Go out to a good place and sanctify the month — and send me the sign: Dovid King of Israel — alive and enduring'" — and Rashi explains: he is compared to the moon — and: "alive and enduring" — for Malchus — the aspect of Dovid — the aspect of the moon — receives from the aspect of Chochmah — the source of life — in the aspect of: *"and wisdom gives life"* [Koheles 7:12]. And therefore one prays: "May this month be an end and a limit" — etc. — "a beginning and a head for our redemption" — to subdue the yetzer hara and Malchus of the sitra achra — from which come all of Israel's troubles — "our enemies became the head" — and we merit the complete redemption through the complete ascent of holy Malchus. See the kavanos of Rosh Chodesh and the sanctification of the month.

[§3]
And this is what our Sages said: "The Torah need not have begun except with 'This month shall be for you'" [Shemos 12:2] — which is the first commandment — for this is the entire [principle of] holy Torah: to overpower the yetzer hara and give strength to holy Malchus — until the light of supernal Chochmah shines upon it in its fullness — so that every person of Israel merits to look only at the intellect that exists in every thing — as stated. And this: why did [the Torah] begin with Bereishis? — "Because the power of His deeds He declared to His people" [Tehillim 111:6] — for the essential sanctification of the month is only through ordained judges in the Land of Israel — for the essential drawing of these rectifications in their fullness is in the Land of Israel — which is the aspect of holy Malchus — and its air makes wise [avira d'Eretz Yisrael machkim]. And so that the nations not say: "You are robbers" — for when a Jewish person comes to prevail over the yetzer hara and fulfil "Know Him in all your ways" [Mishlei 3:6] — binding himself only to the intellect and divine life-force in every thing — even in physical things and bodily needs — doing all his actions only for Heaven's sake — then the yetzer hara and the outer forces say: "You are robbers" — for they claim that all of this world belongs to their side — G-d forbid. Therefore the Torah opened with Bereishis — relating how through the word of Hashem the heavens were made — and "all of them were made with wisdom" — making clear that holy intellect and divine life-force exist in all things in the world — He gave it to them for the sake of free will — and in His will He took it from them and gave it to us — all in the merit of the holy Torah. And thus our Sages said: Hashem tells the ministering angels: I and you shall ask the court below [regarding the sanctification of the month] — and why? "For who is like Hashem our G-d whenever we call upon Him?" — and "calling" refers only to the appointed times — as it is said: "These are the appointed times of Hashem — holy convocations" [Vayikra 23:2] — for through the mitzvah of sanctifying the month one joins the aspects of ches and nun — making chen — and our prayer is accepted. And in particular through Moadei Hashem — the holy convocations — when the ascent of Malchus in its fullness through the holiness of the Land of Israel — for "it is Israel who sanctifies them" — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: וזהו שמבאר שנאמר ויאמר יהושע דייקא (שהוא בחי' לבנה ואליו ולבחינתו נוגע הדבר ביותר כי הלבנה פעמים היא חסרה ופעמים היא מלאה ומזה שורש הבחירה של האדם) אל כל העם, כי זה מוכרח לכל אדם לידע מזה. כה אמר ה' וכו' בעבר הנהר ישבו אבותיכם וכו' ויעבדו אלהים אחרים ואקח את אביכם את אברהם ואולך אותו בכל ארץ כנען, ששם מסוגל ביותר להמשיך קדושת התיקונים הנ"ל. וארבה את זרעו (כי שם דייקא זכה לבנים) ואתן לו את יצחק ואתן ליצחק את יעקב ואת עשו ואתן לעשו את הר שעיר לרשת אותו, הר שעיר הוא בחי' היצה"ר והסט"א שהם בחלקו של עשו, ויעקב ובניו ירדו מצרים להצטרף שם בקושי השיעבוד ולברר משם ניצוצי הקדושה עד שזכו עי"ז למה שזכו כמבואר שם להלן במקרא:
segments.en:
[§4]
And this is the aspect of Esav and the other nations counting by the solar calendar while Israel counts by the lunar calendar — for physically the sun's light is certainly greater than the moon's — and therefore it is called "the great luminary." But since its light is so great even physically — no one can gaze directly at its light — as is known from experience — and as our Sages taught: "the sun is only one of His servants." And even more so spiritually — since the light of the holy intellect — the root of the sun's light — is so great — one cannot receive it except through the aspect of the nun — the moonlight. And therefore the nations — who are in the aspect of: "the fool desires not wisdom" — count by the sun — satisfied with the physical pleasures it provides. They also worship the sun rather than its Creator — for they are external — looking only at the external and not at the inner divine holiness in every thing. But Israel — the holy nation — look only at the inner life-force and divine holiness — the aspect of supernal Chochmah — the root of all lights. Yet since the light of the intellect is so great and can only be received through the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of contraction — the moonlight — where is the root of all counting and numbering — therefore they count by the lunar calendar — and through this they merit in the spiritual realm to receive from the light of holy Chochmah. And also because one can gaze directly at the very light of the moon — alluding to Yaakov — who looks only at the light within every thing — and through the aspect of the moonlight one contemplates and attains the true light — the root of all lights — as stated. And therefore our Sages taught: "Just as the great [luminary] rules by day but not by night — so Esav rules in this world but not in the World to Come. The lesser [luminary] rules by day and by night — so Yaakov rules in this world and in the World to Come" — as stated — for Esav took for himself this world which is physical and visible to the senses — but did not desire the World to Come which is spiritual — for "the fool desires not wisdom." Accordingly he counts by the sun whose light is physically greater. But Yaakov's way is the opposite — for he took the World to Come as his portion — and although its light is very great and certainly impossible to attain in this world — for of it it is said: "no eye has seen" [Yeshayahu 64:3] — nonetheless Yaakov merits to receive from it even in this world through the aspect of the moon — which is the aspect of faith and the complete acceptance of the yoke of Heaven and the yoke of Torah and mitzvos in their fullness — and from his own standpoint he is in the aspect of poverty and destitution — "for he has nothing of his own" — for this is the aspect of: "poverty is becoming to Israel" — meaning each one should look at their own great poverty and lowliness in this world from their own standpoint — in general and in detail — for: "vanity of vanities — all is vanity" [Koheles 1:2] — and therefore at every turn one looks and yearns only to receive some illumination and new flickering from the aspect of the light of holy Chochmah — which is the aspect of the life of the World to Come — and thus one merits both — and rules in this world and in the World to Come.

segments.he: וזה ברוך שומר הבטחתו לישראל ברוך הוא. כי גם ענין זה הוא סתים וגליא כי מלבד הנגלות לנו מהנסים והנפלאות שעשה השי"ת עמנו בכל דור מלבד זה יש בזה נסתרות הרבה לאין חקר בבחי' לעושה נפלאות גדולות לבדו וארז"ל אין בעל הנס מכיר בניסו והעיקר בענין המלחמה הגדולה שיש לו לאדם עם היצה"ר שזו מלחמה תמידית כשדרז"ל על פסוק מציל עני מחזק ממנו וכו' וכשארז"ל בכל יום ויום יצרו של אדם מתגבר עליו ואלמלא הקב"ה עוזרו לא היה יכול לו שנאמר צופה רשע לצדיק וכו' וה' לא יעזבנו בידו. וזה שהקב"ה חשב את הקץ לעשות וכו' וגם את הגוי אשר יעבודו דן אנכי ודרז"ל לרבות שאר מלכיות וכו' ואחרי כן יצאו ברכוש גדול. כי סוף כל סוף תתהפך הירידה לעליה גדול וישראל הקדושים יעלו במעלה נפלאה עד אין חקר.
segments.en:
[§5]
And there is yet more to explain in this. And this is what is brought in the holy Zohar [Bereishis 97]: that every Rosh Chodesh Yaakov goes with the Holy One, blessed be He, to visit the souls of the departed righteous — and when the soul sees the radiance of the holy Shechinah it prostrates and says: "Bless Hashem, my soul" [Tehillim 104] — etc. — [and this is the basis for the custom of reciting Borchi Nafshi on Rosh Chodesh] — for on Rosh Chodesh specifically Yaakov goes — as stated — and goes to visit the souls of the righteous — who engaged in this during their lives in this world — to look only at the divine life-force in every thing — and when the righteous see the radiance of the Shechinah — which they merited now through having done this while in this world — they recite Borchi Nafshi — in which is explained much about this matter: "how manifold are Your works, Hashem — all of them You made with wisdom" — and the entire psalm is founded on this: how divine life-force and Providence are visible in every thing — etc. — and see in the discourse Maketz Zikkaron [Siman 54 of Likutay Moharan] — this verse is cited there also concerning these aspects — meaning one must cleave one's thought to the World to Come — in general and in detail — and to understand from all that is in the world — allusions to draw close to His service — etc. — see there.

 Siman 426 and on — Kiddush Levanah [Sanctification of the Moon]
 סִימָן תכ״ו — בִּרְכַּת הַלְּבָנָה

segments.he: (ויאחז הכוס בידו שמרמז לבחי' מלכות כידוע ויאמר) והיא שעמדה לאבותינו ולנו וכו' שבכל דור ודור עומדים עלינו לכלותינו (ממש ח"ו) והקב"ה מצילינו מידם. צא ולמד מה ביקש לבן הארמי לעשות ליעקב אבינו וכו'. כי יעקב אבינו זכה לבכורה ולברכה שמרמז על קדושת התיקונים הנ"ל ובשביל זה וישטום עשו את יעקב וכו' והוצרך יעקב אבינו לברוח אצל לבן ונאמר שם וישלח יצחק את יעקב וכו' אל לבן וכו' אחי רבקה אם יעקב ועשו. בזה רימז לנו הכתוב כי שרש הרע שבעשו היה מלבן כמארז"ל רוב בנים הולכים אחר אחי אמם ולבן היה קליפה קשה ורעה יותר מעשו והכרח לילך לשם והלכניע הסט"א בשרשה ולברר משם כל קדושת ישראל שהם האמהות והשבטים.
segments.en:
[§1]
The blessing of the moon — and it is called Kiddush Levanah — for one blesses Hashem for having drawn the light from the aspect of Kodesh — which is Chochmah — upon the moon — the aspect of Malchus. And this: "Who with His utterance created the heavens" — etc. — "Who performs truth" — this is the aspect of the light of Hashem Himself — Who did and made all with His wisdom — which is the aspect of emes [truth] — the totality of the holy mochin. And: "His action is truth" — His action is the aspect of holy Malchus — and it too is emes — for through the aspect of Malchus one attains the light of the mochin — which is the aspect of emes. And the letters of emes are the beginning, middle, and end [of the alphabet] — as is known — for the drawing of these rectifications encompasses all of Creation from beginning to end — for from every thing in the world one must recognize and know Hashem — for all was created only "in order that they know Him."

[§2]
And this: "and to the moon He said: renew yourself" — etc. — for its descent and diminishment — as it were — is also only for the sake of its ascent and renewal. And this: "a crown of glory" — the aspect of *"a worthy wife is the crown of her husband"* [Mishlei 12:4] — as is known — "for those carried from the womb — who in the future will renew themselves like her" — for the descent of Israel and their exile is also only in the aspect of this — for clarifying the holy sparks — and as our Sages taught: "Israel went into exile only so that converts should be added to them" [Pesachim 87b] — and many other wondrous matters accomplished through this — and through this specifically Israel will renew with great ascents in the future — for the exile is like the aspect of sleep — which is for the renewal of the mochin — and this: "when Hashem returns" — etc. — "we shall be like dreamers" [Tehillim 126:1] — etc.

segments.he: וע"כ כששלח לעשו עם לבן גרתי וכו' נפל עליו פחד גדול כשארז"ל.
segments.en:
[§3]
And this: "to glorify their Creator — for the sake of the glory of His Kingship — specifically" — "Blessed" — etc. — "Who renews the months." And this: "Blessed is your Maker — Blessed is He Who fashioned you — Blessed is He Who created you — Blessed is He Who brought you into being" — corresponding to the four worlds — for in each world there is the aspect of Malchus — etc. — as explained in the discourse Yeshara [Siman 30 of Likutay Moharan] — and the initials of these four phrases spell Yaakov — Yaakov specifically — as stated. And this: "Just as I dance toward you and cannot touch you — so may all my enemies be unable to touch me" — etc. — for the essential enemies are the yetzer hara — the kingdom of the sitra achra. "May they fall upon them" — etc. — also against the nullification of the power of the sitra achra. "Dovid King of Israel — alive and enduring" — the aspect of the strengthening of holy Malchus — as stated. And: "Kol dodi — the voice of my beloved — behold he comes" — for this is the aspect of the glimmer of the future redemption.

[§4]
And this is what our Sages taught: "one who blesses the moon at its renewal is as if he received the face of the Shechinah" — for the drawing of these rectifications — through which one merits to attain the light of Hashem from every thing in the world — is the aspect of receiving the face of the Shechinah. And: "Were Israel to merit it — to receive [the moon's face] once a month — that would suffice." And Abaye said: "Therefore one must recite it standing." For although the moon — Malchus — is the feminine aspect — the aspect of sitting — as is known — nonetheless since through this one merits to attain supernal intellect — in particular since Kiddush Levanah alludes to the future renewal when Malchus will be in the aspect of the crown of its husband — therefore it must be recited standing — which is in the secret of the masculine world — as is known. And afterwards one prays to fill the diminishment of the moon — and may the moonlight be as the sunlight — as stated. And: "May it be fulfilled in us what is written: 'And they shall seek Hashem their G-d and Dovid their king'" [Hoshea 3:5] — to seek and strive only to attain the light of Hashem — attainable only through the aspect of Malchus.

segments.he: וזהו שמספר בעל ההגדה שלבן ביקש לעקור את הכל וכו' וזהו וירד מצרימה אנוס ע"פ הדיבור כי היה מתיירא מאד לירד לשם מחמת שידע גודל כח הסט"א שמתגברת שם. רק שהקב"ה הכריחו לזה ואמר לו אל תירא מרדת מצרימה וכו' וזה ויגר שם מלמד שלא ירד להשתקע וכו' ג"כ מטעם הנ"ל ושאר הענין מבואר ממילא.
segments.en:
[§5]
And since the essential strengthening of holy Malchus is through Torah — which is the aspect of seven — as it is written: "she hewn her seven pillars" [Mishlei 9:1] — therefore one does not bless it until seven days have passed. Unless Motzai Shabbos falls after the third day from the molad — then one blesses at that time — for since the fullness of these rectifications is drawn on Shabbos — as stated — the mitzvah is greater to bless immediately at Motzai Shabbos. And one does not bless it on Shabbos night or Yom Tov night — for we ascend in holiness — and the illumination of holy Malchus through the holiness of Shabbos and Yom Tov is greater than the illumination received at the time of Kiddush Levanah — as is similarly explained in the Shomer Emunim in his responsa. And therefore one makes rejoicing and dancing during the sanctification of the month — in the manner of the joy of a wedding — for they are one aspect: Malchus uniting with its Beloved — as it were — which is the aspect of drawing these rectifications — the aspect of the fullness of joy — as stated.

segments.he: וזה וירעו אותנו המצרים כמה שנאמר הבה נתחכמה לו וכו' ופירשו המפרשים שעשו אותנו לרעים. היינו כנ"ל כי כשהסט"א שהוא היצה"ר מתגבר והוא הרע הגמור כי יוצרו קראו רע ואז גם זה שנמשך אחריו נעשה ג"כ רע כ"ש אוי לרשע וכו' והעיקר ע"י ההתחכמות והמחשבות רעות שחושב על האדם עד שמכניס בהאדם עצמו ג"כ אלו המחשבות ר"ל שהם עיקר היצרין רעים כ"ש כי יצר מחשבות לבו רק רע כל היום וכמבואר במאמר לשמש סי' מ"ט. ועי"ז נעשה האדם רע כי עיקר האדם הוא המחשבה (וכמובא בסי' כ"א) והרהורי עבירה קשין מעבירה. וזה ויענונו וכו'. מבואר ממילא כמו כן שאר הדרשות וכו'. וענין העשר מכות מבואר לעיל קצת (ועיין בכוונות) וזה כמה מעלות טובות וחושב ט"ו מעלות כנגד עליית הלבנה ומלואה עד קרוב לט"ו יום (ועיין לקמן). וגומר כל הענין ומברך על הכוס שני ונוטל ידיו עוד הפעם להמשיך מימי הדעת והתורה הק' לטהר הידים לסעודה ונוטל המצות שמרמזין למוחין גדולים ולבחי' מלכות שמים כנ"ל ומברך עליהם. ואוכל ביראה ובשמחה גדולה.
segments.en:
[§6]
And this is the aspect of months — one full and one deficient — except for Cheshvan and Kislev as is known. A full month is when the second Rosh Chodesh is two days — in which case the first day of that Rosh Chodesh counts as the thirtieth day of the preceding month — for "the end is embedded in the beginning" — for it is impossible to attain the light of the aspect of reishis Chochmah except through the aspect of Malchus — which is the aspect of the end. And likewise the essential fullness of Malchus is when it receives from the light of supernal Chochmah. And therefore a deficient month — one not joined to the second Rosh Chodesh — has only 29 days and is called chaser [deficient]. But when joined to the second Rosh Chodesh it has thirty days — corresponding to the fullness of Malchus which is acquired through thirty levels — and it is called maleh [full]. And therefore every month that contains a Yom Tov is full — and such a month is called melech [king] — as explained in the Maharil — for through its Yom Tov's holiness the illumination of Malchus flows in its fullness. And this is the aspect of the secret of the ibbur [leap year] — to equalize lunar and solar years — whose root is to unite Malchus with its Beloved in fullness. And since the essential rectification is through Torah — the aspect of seven — therefore in every small lunar cycle there are seven leap years.

[§7]
And were I not afraid to speculate — I would say that for this intention the Tur and the Shulchan Aruch gave in Siman 428 the mnemonic for the fixing of the festivals: Aleph-Tav / Beis-Shin — etc. — for Aleph-Tav / Beis-Shin is the aspect of connecting the Aleph-Beis in order with Tav-Shin-Resh-Kuf which is in reverse order — the aspect of Malchus — as explained in Likutay Moharan [Siman 82]. And this: the first letters are from the Aleph-Beis in order — and the second letters are from Tashrak in reverse — alluding that through the Yom Tovim [the Moadim] one unites the aspect of Malchus with its Beloved — and everything becomes in the aspect of b'seder [in order]. And the mnemonic begins with Aleph-Tav — alluding to the fact that whenever the first day of Pesach falls on a given weekday — Tisha b'Av will always fall on the same weekday. This alludes to the aspect of misken v'chacham — as explained within — for on Tisha b'Av Malchus is in the utmost poverty and lowliness. And yet even then — a great spiritual illumination flows upon it from the aspect of the Chochmah and mochin d'gadlus that shine at Pesach — for this is the aspect of the glimmer of Mashiach that shines on every Tisha b'Av — as is cited. And therefore Tisha b'Av too is called moed — and the general principle: "the end is embedded in the beginning and the beginning in the end." And in holiness each aspect is comprised of its companion. And at the height of ascent one must remember the aspect of poverty and lowliness of the days of descent — and bind oneself strongly to the holy intellect so that it illuminates even then — in the aspect of: "on a good day be in good" — and nonetheless: "on a bad day — see" [Koheles 7:14] — meaning: see to guard yourself even then from the aspect of the "bad day." And likewise at the very height of descent and lowliness — one must look and reflect carefully — and will find even then the chesed and goodness of Hashem — in the aspect of: "in my straits You gave me relief" [Tehillim 4:2] — as explained elsewhere. And therefore on Pesach night — when the mochin shine greatly — one alludes to remembering even the days of descent — in the aspect of: "upon matzah and bitter herbs they shall eat it" [Shemos 12:8] — for the redemption was not yet complete — and afterwards they were exiled again on Tisha b'Av. And on Tisha b'Av specifically the light of the future redemption glimmers.

segments.he: ואח"כ נוטל המרור. ומצוה בחזרת שנקרא חסא דחס הקב"ה עלן וכו' וגם כי תחלתו מתוק וסופו מר וטובלו בחרוסת ומברך ואוכל. ומבואר כבר שהמרור רומז שלא היתה עדיין הגאולה בשלימות כי יהיה אחריה גליות רק אעפ"כ היא היסוד לכל הגאולות כנ"ל. וגם כי אפילו אחר בחי' הגאולה והישועה כשזוכין להתגבר על יצרו ולהכניע המלכות דסט"א ולקבל עליו עול מלכות שמים שלימה ולהמשיך מוחין גדולים אעפ"כ צריכין לזכור היטב גודל המרירות שעבר עליו קודם שזכה לזה בכדי להודות לה' חסדו על גודל הנפלאות שעשה עמנו. וגם כי באמת המרירות הזה יש לו חלק גדול בהגאולה והישועה שזכה אח"כ. כי אח"כ כשזוכין לתשובה שלימה ולכנוס בחדרי הקדושה אזי הקב"ה מצרף וחושב ומזכיר גם אלו המחשבות של המרירות שהיה לו לאדם קודם שזכה לזה כי ע"י הרגשת המרירות הרבה לצעוק ולהתפלל להשי"ת ע"ז כ"כ עד שנענה וזכה לישועה שלימה ואלמלי לא הרגיש תחלה את המרירות של הפגמים רק כל הדרכים שלו היו ישרים בעיניו ח"ו מי יודע להיכן היה נתעה ונאבד לגמרי ח"ו.
segments.en:
[§8]
And this is the aspect of the eight final verses of the Torah over which one does not pause — etc. — for they speak of the passing of Moshe — who is the aspect of the sun — the aspect of ches — and through this specifically Yehoshua shines — who is the aspect of the moon — the aspect of nun — as it is written right there within those verses: *"and Yehoshua the son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom"* [Devarim 34:9] — Nun specifically — and therefore one does not pause — but one person reads them all — so that the illumination of the ches and the nun together be complete. And from the seventeenth of Tammuz onward one reads the three haftaros of retribution — for those are the days of the Destruction and the descent of Malchus — as it were — through Israel's sins — and therefore the light of supernal wisdom withdraws — and therefore one reads those three haftaros: the first — Divrei Yirmiyahu — prophesies about the destruction of Yerushalayim — which is the aspect of holy Malchus — and the strengthening of the kingdom of the sitra achra — and concludes with the verse: "Holy is Israel to Hashem — the first of His produce" [Yirmiyahu 2:3] — for they are called kodesh and reishis on account of the holy intellect and wisdom. The second — Shim'u Davar Hashem [Yirmiyahu 2] — rebukes them primarily for having damaged — as it were — the Heavenly Kingship — and exchanged His glory for worthlessness — "for My people have committed two evils: they abandoned Me — the source of living waters" [Yirmiyahu 2:13] — which is the aspect of holy intellect — and also: "to dig for themselves broken cisterns" — the aspect of the foolishness of the yetzer hara. And he rebukes them greatly for holding the rope at both ends — for "always let a person arouse the good inclination against the evil inclination" — it is impossible to make peace between them — G-d forbid. And concludes: "Is it not so that from now you will call Me: 'My Father — master of my youth'" [Yirmiyahu 3:4] — to return to their root and source — the aspect of supernal Chochmah — the aspect of: "Abba [Father] founded the daughter." The third — Chazon Yeshayahu — likewise rebukes them and informs them that they damaged both aspects — the month — which is the aspect of the moon — and the Shabbos — which is the aspect of the sun — "the Shabbos — the day of charity to the poor — when the light of holy intellect shines in its fullness" — and therefore it is called kodesh — as is known. And: "Chodesh v'Shabbos — calling a convocation — I cannot [bear it]" [Yeshayahu 1:13] — and the essential damage is in the aspect of the month. And He informs them that through this their prayer is not accepted: "and when you spread your hands" — etc. — "even when you multiply prayer — I do not hear" [ibid. 1:15] — for just as through the rectifications mentioned above — the joining of the ches and the nun — prayer is accepted — so too the opposite — G-d forbid. And He urges them greatly to repent and everything will be rectified. And concludes: "Tziyon will be redeemed through justice — and those who return to her — through righteousness" [ibid. 1:27] — for the essential rectification is through holy Torah — which is the aspect of justice and righteousness — through which one gives strength to holy Malchus to prevail against the opposite.

[§9]
And after Tisha b'Av one reads the seven haftaros of consolation — corresponding to the holy Torah — the aspect of seven — as stated — for it is the essential consolation — in the aspect of: "this is my consolation in my suffering" [Tehillim 119:50] — for through it everything will be rectified. And afterwards one reads the two haftaros of repentance — for one must repent completely and rectify both aspects. And in the haftarah of Dirshu it is explained regarding "for My thoughts are not your thoughts" [Yeshayahu 55:8] — etc. — and it elaborates greatly in praise of those who keep the Shabbos — the aspect of the world of thought and intellect — as stated. And in the haftarah of Shuvah it explains: "take with you words and return to Hashem" [Hoshea 14:2] — through which what was damaged in holy Malchus is rectified — as explained in the discourse Anochi [Siman 4] and the discourse Vayitein Oz [Siman 78]. And: "Assyria will not save us" — etc. — meaning to separate oneself entirely from the kingdom of the sitra achra — the side of the yetzer hara. And: "Ephraim — what more have I to do with idols?" And concludes: "Who is wise — he shall understand these things — the discerning — he shall know them — for the ways of Hashem are upright — and the righteous walk in them" [Hoshea 14:10] — meaning: the ways of holy Torah are straight and correct and very good — and the righteous walk in them — for through holy Torah one subdues the power of the yetzer hara and the kingdom of the sitra achra. And some conclude with the verse: "Who is a G-d like You — Who forgives iniquity" — etc. — "to the remnant of His heritage" [Michah 7:18] — for the sins in which we were caught through the yetzer hara's counsel — Hashem will forgive through our making ourselves like remnants and feeling our poverty and lowliness — the aspect of misken v'chacham. And: "He will return and have mercy upon us — He will suppress our iniquities — and cast all their sins into the depths of the sea" [ibid. 7:19] — the depths of the sea are Samael and his consort — the aspect of sun and moon of the sitra achra — which are the root of all sins. And: "You shall give truth to Yaakov" — the attribute of Yaakov: to look only at the truth — which is the totality of the holy mochin — this is the birthright and the blessing that Yaakov received truthfully and in good faith. And: "lovingkindness to Avraham — as You swore to our forefathers from days of old — and its Aramaic translation recalls the binding of Yitzchak" — meaning Hashem will stir and draw upon us the merit of Avraham's chesed and the merit of the Akeidah — so that through this all the aspects of the gevuros — from which the yetzer hara nurses — be sweetened — and we merit to overpower him and cleave to the yetzer tov. And through the Torah — which is also called emes — as our Sages taught — one merits all the above.

segments.he: וע"כ צריכים לאכול מרור זכר למה שמררו המצרים את חיי אבותינו במצרים. ומצוה מן המובחר בחסא דחס רחמנא עלן ופרקינן. היינו לידע ולזכור שעיקר הגאולה והישועה מן המרירות וגם הרגשת המרירות בעצמו קודם הישועה הכל הוא רק בחמלת השי"ת וברוב רחמיו וחסדיו ית' וגם כי מרור גימטריא מות כמובא שזה בחי' המרירות שסובלין בעת התגברות הסט"א סטרא דמותא ר"ל. וחס"א גימטריא חיים עם הכולל. היינו כי גם אז בתוקף המרירות של התגברות סטרא דמותא ח"ו גם אז הזריח השי"ת עלינו בהעלם וברוחניות גדול מבחי' אור החיים הק' שהוא בחי' התנוצצות מניצוצי אור החכמה העליונה שהיא עיקר החיים ועי"ז בעצמו זכינו להרגיש המרירות (כי אין בשר המת מרגיש באיזמל כשארז"ל) וצעקנו להשי"ת עד שזכינו לישועה. וזה מרומז בלשון התורה הק' בעצמה שכתבה וימררו את חייהם דייקא היינו כנ"ל וגם כי חסא תחלתו מתוק וסופו מר כמו שהיתה עבודתם בתחלה בפה רך וכו' שזה בחי' דרך היצה"ר שמתחלה מתלבש עצמו במצוות כנ"ל ואז זכינו להכניע גם בחי' היצה"ר הזה בשלימות ע"י שזכינו תחלה להרגיש המרירות שבסופו שזה בחי' איזה חכם הרואה את הנולד וארז"ל, הוי מחשב וכו' ושכר עבירה כנגד הפסידה.
segments.en:
Siman 429 — The Laws of Pesach; The Month of Nisan
 סִימָן תכ״ט — הִלְכוֹת פֶּסַח; חֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן

[§1]
One inquires about the laws of Pesach thirty days before Pesach — for at Pesach these rectifications flow in great fullness — and one merits to receive great mochin — and the aspect of Malchus ascends in great ascents — and therefore one must prepare through Torah study — and therefore one must engage especially in the study of the laws of Pesach itself. And this: thirty days specifically — for Malchus is acquired through thirty levels. And since the essential rectification is to give strength to holy Malchus — the aspect of misken v'chacham — therefore before Pesach the custom spread especially to distribute money to the poor or wheat and flour for Pesach — this is great preparation to receive the holiness of Pesach in its fullness and to guard oneself from chometz on Pesach — which is then from the side of the yetzer hara — and to merit fulfilling the mitzvah of eating matzah — called lechem oni — in its fullness. And the gloss states: "the custom is to purchase wheat to distribute to the poor for Pesach" — for wheat is most fitting for daas and intellect — as explained elsewhere — and also: chitah [wheat] in numerical value equals 22 — corresponding to the 22 letters of the Torah — as is known. And the overflow of Chochmah above is Torah. And through purchasing wheat to distribute to the poor — one gives strength to holy Malchus to prevail — and to ascend from poverty and destitution to the aspect of holy Chochmah — whose fullness of rectification is drawn at Pesach.

segments.he: וע"כ מטבלין אותו בחרוסת אותיות חס רות כמובא בכוונות חס גימט' חיים כנ"ל, וגימטריא חכם ורות רומז למלכות שיצאו ממנה מלכים. שזה בחי' יחוד חמה ולבנה הנ"ל היינו שעיקר המתקת המרירות של התגברות היצר הוא רק ברחמי השי"ת שחס עלינו מאד ובפרט על כלל כנסת ישראל שהוא בחי' המלכות דקדושה ומזריח עלינו גם אז מאור החכמה והחיים דקדושה שזה בחי' מה שארז"ל אלמלא הקב"ה עזרו לא היה יכול לו. רק שצריך לנער את המרור מטיבול החרוסת תיכף בכדי שלא לבטל טעמו לגמרי כי כן דרך השי"ת כי אע"פ שמעורר את האדם ועזרו בכ"פ להתגבר על יצרו אעפ"כ הוא רק בבחי' התנוצצות בעלמא לפי שעה בכדי שלא לבטל כח הבחירה לגמרי עי"ז כידוע.
segments.en:
[§2]
And this: one does not fall upon one's face throughout the entire month of Nisan — and one does not eulogize or fast in it — for it is explained in the holy Zohar that Yaakov took as his portion these three months — Nisan, Iyar, and Sivan. And the attribute of Yaakov is as stated — to strive always to receive the supernal light of the intellect through the aspect of nun — Malchus — primarily through Torah study. Therefore these three months — in which Israel left Egypt and the kingdom of the sitra achra was subdued and holy Malchus ascended with great ascents — and they merited to receive very great mochin — and even after the Pesach mochin withdrew they merited to count seven weeks — fifty — nun — days specifically — as explained in Likutay Halachos — until they merited to receive the Torah at Shavuos — therefore these months are from his portion. And of Rosh Chodesh Nisan it is said: "This month shall be for you the head of months" — and it is brought that throughout this month the illumination of Rosh Chodesh shines within it — and especially since the Tabernacle was erected in it and the twelve tribal leaders brought their offerings — and most of the month passed in holiness — therefore throughout this month there is the aspect of the illumination of Yom Tov holiness — and it is forbidden to fast or eulogize.

segments.he: ואח"כ כורך מצה ומרור ואוכלין ביחד זכר למקדש כהלל וכו' כי לדעת הלל היו צריכין לאכול פסח מצה ומרור ביחד כי כיתרון האור מן החשך כך יתרון החכמה מן הסכלות ומובא דר"ל שעיקר מעלת האור ניכר ע"י שרואין גרעון החשך וכן החכמה מן הסכלות ע"כ סבירא ליה שצריך לכלול המצה והמרור כאחד דייקא כי המרירות הגדול בעצמו היה סיבת הישועה הגדולה והמעלה הנפלאה שזכו אח"כ. עוד יש לומר שרומז למה שארז"ל הרוצה שיחיה ימית א"ע וכן לענין כפיית היצה"ר והכנעתו אמרו ג"כ יזכור לו יום המיתה וארז"ל החיים למות והמתים להחיות נמצא שכל דבר קשור ומחובר להפכו. רק העיקר להכניע הכסילות ולהיות מקושר תמיד אל השכל ואז ידע להשתמש עם כל בחינה במועדה ובזמנה ואז טוב לו.
segments.en:
[§3]
And therefore the combination of the holy Name that shines in Nisan is alluded to in the verse: *"Y'ismechu Hashamayim V'tageil Ha'aretz"* [Tehillim 96:11] — and: "And they will say among the nations — Hashem reigns" — for His Kingship is revealed — and through this one merits to attain the light of the intellect in every thing encompassed in all of Creation — in the aspect of: "the heavens and the earth" — to include their offspring — and all was created only "in order that they know Him." And therefore in Nisan when this aspect flows — surely "the heavens shall rejoice and the earth shall exult." And this is the aspect of: the first of Nisan is Rosh HaShanah for kings — and our Sages taught: specifically for kings of Israel — for the essential completeness of Israelite kings is from the Davidic kingdom. And our Sages said: when Hashem shows kindness to Dovid — heaven and earth rejoice — as stated. And therefore the one who offered on the first day was Nachshon ben Amminadav — from whom Dovid descended.

 Siman 430 — Shabbos HaGadol [The Great Shabbos]
 סִימָן ת״ל

segments.he: ואח"כ אוכל סעודתו לכבוד יו"ט בשמחה גדולה כי אז האכילה בקדושה גדולה בסוד סעודת הצדיקים לעתיד לבוא.
segments.en:
[§1]
And this is the aspect of Shabbos HaGadol before Pesach — for since the great mochin also shine at Pesach — it is also called Shabbos — as it is said: "from the day after the Shabbos" [Vayikra 23:15]. But even so — certainly the illumination and holiness of Shabbos itself is greater still. And the principle of the Exodus — the ascent of holy Malchus — is in order to merit through it to receive the supernal intellect — which is the aspect of Shabbos — and the end of the matter was the intent from the first. Therefore Hashem arranged it that on the tenth of the month — when the illumination of Pesach's holiness had already begun to shine — that day fell specifically on Shabbos — and the miracle that occurred on that day — as explained by the legal authorities — and a nes [miracle] alludes to the juxtaposing of the nun — the aspect of Malchus — as explained above. And also nes in numerical value equals mah and Adnus — the aspect of the union of sun and moon — in the aspect of: "both great luminaries" — therefore it was visible to all — the aspect of the ascent of Malchus — called also Shabbos — from the aspect of the lesser luminary to the aspect of the greater luminary. And therefore it is called Shabbos HaGadol — the Great Shabbos.

[§2]
And therefore the great [scholars] are accustomed to deliver a public discourse on Shabbos HaGadol — for our Sages already expounded on the verse "And Moshe assembled" — etc. — that it is a mitzvah to assemble communities every Shabbos and teach Israel. But on this Shabbos it is certainly a greater mitzvah to give a public discourse — and the essential thing: the discourse should be for the sake of Heaven — to teach the people the statutes of G-d and His instructions — as explained by the legal authorities.

segments.he: ואוכל האפיקומן באחרונה כדי שיהיה זכר לפסח שהיה נאכל על השובע בדרך חשיבות ולשם מצוה ולא למלאות רעבונו רק כדרך שהמלכים אוכלים כמבואר בשו"ע וגם בכדי שיהיה נשאר טעם מצה בפיו כנ"ל. ואח"כ מברך ברכת המזון על כוס שלישי ומוזגין לו כוס רביעי וגומר עליו את ההלל.
segments.en:
Siman 431 and on — Bedikas Chometz [Searching for Leaven]
 סִימָן תל״א

[§1]
"On the eve of the fourteenth one searches for the chometz by candlelight" — it is cited that this alludes to what a person must do: to search and seek in every crack and crevice to expunge from himself everything from the side of the yetzer hara — which is then called chometz. And "the eve of the fourteenth" alludes to the Malchus of Dovid — which numerically equals fourteen — and he is the fourteenth generation from Avraham Avinu. And also: fourteen alludes to the fourteen letters of ה׳ א׳ ה׳ — which are the root of holy faith and acceptance of Heavenly Kingship. Meaning: one must arouse then the power of holy Malchus and the yetzer tov — and search out and expunge all the aspects of the yetzer hara — the klippa of Esav — which is the aspect of chometz — as understood in the holy Zohar on the verse: "Crush the beast of the reeds" [Tehillim 68:31]. And: "by candlelight" — our Sages derived [by analogy]: searching from searching — searching from candles — and candles from a candle — as it is said: *"the candle of Hashem is the soul of man — which searches all the chambers of the belly"* [Mishlei 20:27]. Behold they alluded to us: the light of the candle means the light of the holy soul — which is called a candle — and one must arouse then the power and illumination of the holy soul within every Jew — encompassing the general souls of the Children of Israel included within the seventy souls — the twelve tribes of Yaakov — upon whom is the essential revelation of holy Malchus — and through this every person has the power to drive from himself the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of chometz — whose letters rearranged spell metzach [forehead] — the forehead of a harlot [eisheh zona] — as is cited — in the aspect of: "because of the pride of my mistress I flee" [Bereishis 16:8] — as understood in the discourse B'karov [Siman 36]. And the essential light of holy intellect is through the soul — in the aspect of: "and the breath of Shaday [gives them] understanding" [Iyov 32:8].

segments.he: והנה ענין ההלל ארז"ל שיש בו שלעבר ושלעתיד וכו'. ואם תדקדק בו תראה שסובב והולך ג"כ על ענין המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל. והנה פתח ואמר הללו יה שרומז לבחי' חיבור המלכות שהיא בחי' הלל גימטריא אדני לשם יה שרומז על המוחין הק' חכמה ובינה.
segments.en:
[§2]
And therefore one must pause even from Torah study and fulfil the mitzvah of bedikas chometz at its proper time — for although the essential subduing of the yetzer hara is through Torah study — sometimes the yetzer hara gains hold even in the study itself — G-d forbid — bringing one to study for the sake of arrogance and to embarrass others — G-d forbid. And therefore even the study itself needs searching and checking. And therefore at this time when all Israel are engaged in searching for chometz — one must pause from study and engage in this mitzvah.

segments.he: וזה הללו עבדי ה' ולא עבדי פרעה כי זכינו לצאת מתחת רשות המלכות דסט"א ולכנוס תחת רשות ועבדות של בחי' המלכות דקדושה ששם עיקר החירות בחי' שמלכך בן חורין כנ"ל ועבד מלך מלך. וזה הללו את שם ה' כי בו ית' מעצמו לית מחשבה תפיסא ביה כלל רק שצריכין אנו להלל לשמו ית' שהוא כולל הכל. וזה יהי שם ה' מברך ואיתא שזה בחי' מ"ב ר"ך בחי' תחלתו קשה וסופו רך כי עבדות דסט"א ר"ל הוא בבחי' תחלתו רך וסופו קשה תחלתו מתוק וסופו מר כנ"ל כי הוא רק בדרך שקר והטעאה בעלמא. אבל עבדות דקדושה הוא להיפוך כי תחלתו קשה בחי' כל התחלות קשות אבל סופו רך ומתוק וכמו שפירש שרש"י בפ' יתרו על פסוק ועתה אם שמוע תשמעו בקולי וכו'. וזה קרוב לפשוטו לבד מהנסתרות שיש בענין זה של מ"ב ר"ך כמבואר בזוה"ק ובכתבי האריז"ל.
segments.en:
[§3]
And therefore one blesses on it for biyur chometz [the elimination of leaven] — for the searching is the beginning of the elimination. For the essential strengthening of the sitra achra is to blind a person's eyes from reflecting upon his ways — in the aspect of: "the fool desires not wisdom." But immediately when one arouses the power and illumination of the holy soul and begins to scrutinize his actions — then "one who comes to purify himself is assisted" [Yoma 38b] — and a little light drives away much darkness — and the searching itself is already the beginning of the elimination.

 Siman 433 and on — The Laws of the Search
 סִימָן תל״ג

segments.he: וזה ממזרח שמש שזה בחי' זריחת המוחין שזה ששורש אור השמש. עד מבואו מהולל שם ה'. כי שם ה' כולל הכל. כי אפילו לאחר ביאת השמש זורח אז אור בחי' הלבנה שהוא בחי' מלכות בחי' ה"א אחרונה שבשם הקדוש שזה בחי' והיה אור הלבנה כאור החמה כנ"ל. וזה רם על כל גוים ה' וכו' בחי' התרוממות המלכות דקדושה וכו' והתגלותה על כל העולם כולו בבחי' מושיבי עקרת הבית אם הבנים שמחה וכו'.
segments.en:
[§1]
The search must be by candlelight — not by moonlight — for although the moon — Malchus — is also the aspect of contraction relative to supernal intellect — the sun — all this is in the general aspect of the holy lights. But when one needs to seek out the chometz — the yetzer hara — to expunge it from all its cracks and hidden places — one must contract the light even further — until it is in the aspect of a single candle — meaning: to draw some thin, delicate, spiritual spark of intellect that illuminates properly to search thoroughly in all the cracks and crevices — so that no chometz remains. But one need only search in places where there is reason to suspect chometz may have been brought — for each person must search only in what he knows in his own soul that the yetzer hara engages with — for no two people are alike.

[§2]
And therefore in places where chometz is not normally brought — no searching is needed — so as not to scatter one's mind excessively — and not to enter the aspect of excessive thoughts and unnecessary over-scrupulousness — and not to become utterly confused — G-d forbid — for this too is from the counsel of the yetzer hara. And if perhaps chometz truly did reach even those places — it does not matter — for from the Torah nullification alone suffices — since one has already repented in one's heart for all damages from the yetzer hara — and has done everything in one's power — searched and nullified as the Sages instituted — therefore all chometz is automatically nullified and void.

segments.he: וזה בצאת ישראל ממצרים וכו' היתה יהודה לקדשו. בחי' המשכת המוחין שהם בחי' קודש. ישראל ממשלותיו. בחי' המלכות דקדושה שנתגלה אז על ישראל ועי"ז הים ראה וינוס וכו' מה לך הים כי תנוס וכו' מלפני אדון חולי ארץ. בחי' התגלות מלכותו ואדנותו ית' מלפני אלוה יעקב דייקא שהוא עוסק בהמשכת תיקונים הנ"ל. וזה ההופכי הצור. שהוא בחי' מלכות בחי' דינא דמלכותא דינא והוא בחי' אש כי שרשה מבחי' גבורות ויצא ממנה מים כי על ידה דייקא זוכין להמשיך המוחין שהם בחי' מימי הדעת והשכל כנ"ל (ועיין בליקוטי תורה להאריז"ל בפ' בשלח על פסוק הנני עומד לפניך שם על הצור).
segments.en:
[§3]
And this: synagogues and study halls require searching — etc. — for although the essential subduing of chometz and the yetzer hara is through them — for there is the essential establishment of the yoke of Heavenly Kingship and Torah study — as our Sages truly taught: "draw him to the house of study" — nonetheless they too require checking — for "children" — meaning those of small mind — bring chometz in there too.

[§4]
And this is the aspect of one must sweep one's rooms before the search — for matters known and apparent to the person as being from the yetzer hara — those must be driven out and expunged immediately even before the time of bedikah — without any hesitation — for: *"do not let injustice dwell in your tent"* [Iyov 11:14]. Only the essential search at its proper time is for subtle offenses — through which a person is most often mistaken — in particular since sometimes the yetzer hara clothes himself in mitzvos and misleads the person. Upon these matters one must arouse the power of holy intellect and search in cracks and hidden places. But not for the apparent offenses — for those must be driven out entirely before the search — lest one's mind become totally confused during the search and one be unable to search properly.

segments.he: ועד כאן אומרים קודם הסעודה שמהללים ומודים על העבר ואחר הסעודה מתפללין וצועקין על העתיד ואומרים שפוך חמתך וכו' ועל ממלכות וכו' היינו על הכנעת וביטול המלכויות דסט"א גם עכשיו. וזהו שאומרים לא לנו וכו' כי לשמך תן כבוד וכו' וזה עצביהם כסף וזהב ששורש כסף וזהב הוא מבחי' לבנה וחמה דסט"א. וזה פה להם ולא ידברו וכו' כי אף שמציירין אותם בדמות אדם אבל הכל הוא באמת רק שקר והבל והטעאה בעלמא כי הכל רק בכח המדמה בשביל כח הבחירה וע"כ כמוהם יהיו עושיהם אבל אתם ישראל בטח בה' וכו'.
segments.en:
[§5]
And this: after the search one must be careful about the remaining chometz — guarding it lest another search be required — for even after the search — before the time for complete elimination has arrived — one must still retain some chometz for eating. And likewise regarding our subject — for the complete elimination of chometz — the yetzer hara — in its fullness will not be until the future — as it is written: *"and I shall remove the spirit of impurity from the earth"* [Zechariah 13:2]. But for now — on the contrary — one must give it too some life-force in contraction — just enough for its sustenance — as is known — for it is also currently needed for the maintenance of the world — as our Sages taught [Yoma 69b]: "they imprisoned it for three days and sought a fresh daily egg and could not find one" — etc. — see there. But one must sanctify oneself in what is permitted — doing all things from the side of the yetzer hara — such as eating and the like — entirely for Heaven's sake — in modesty and reverence — so as not to give it any hold — lest it overpower one again — G-d forbid — requiring another search. And this: if a mouse took it before him — the yetzer hara is called "wicked" — as our Sages expounded on the verse "And he said: this is wickedness" [Zechariah 5:8] — and all the wickedness of the wicked is through it. And our Sages taught: "these mice are wicked ones." Meaning: one must not let any wickedness take bold hold of him openly — G-d forbid — in the aspect of: "an impudent man is wicked before him." Or: if his bread is lacking — meaning he sees that something is lacking and does not know what caused the lack — then certainly he must return and search in the cracks and crevices of his soul again. Therefore it is good to guard oneself beforehand so as not to come to this.

segments.he: וכן על דרך זה כל ההלל כולו עד שגומר ואומר הודו לה' כי טוב כי לעולם חסדו ואח"כ אומר הלל הגדול והם כו' כי לעולם חסדו ומספר שם מחסדי ה' בכלליות ובפרטיות ומסודרים על אותיות שהם הוי"ה ב"ה שהוא גימטריא כ"ו ועיין בו ותבין קצת איך שמכוון ג"כ לענינינו. וזה בחי' הסמיכות של לעושה אורים גדולים וכו' את השמש וכו' את הירח וכו' למכה מצרים בבכוריהם וכו' היינו כנ"ל וכן להלן ומובן ממילא.
segments.en:
[§6]
And this is the aspect of the nullification after the search — where one recites: "all chamira and chamia" — the aspect of Samael and his consort — as is known — and all things coming from their side. "Which I have not seen" — etc. — meaning: what one does not see and understand at the time of searching — "shall be nullified and be as the dust of the earth." And the daytime nullification adds: "which I have seen and which I have not seen — which I have eliminated and which I have not eliminated." For perhaps there is some chometz that one saw and yet did not eliminate due to circumstance or forgetfulness — that too should be included in the nullification. And similarly in our context: through nullifying the sitra achra wholeheartedly — and particularly through expressing this nullification with a full mouth — one drives away and nullifies from oneself the hold of the sitra achra completely — for in truth they are nullified and void — for "they are vanity and emptiness together" — they are only the power of imagination — an empty power — as explained elsewhere. And particularly since in the end they will all fall — in the aspect of: "for behold Your enemies shall perish" [Tehillim 92:10] — and anything that stands to be burned is considered as burned — but for the sake of free will it appears as if they have some substance — and the verse treats them as if in the person's domain. And therefore declaring one's indifference to them and nullifying them is sufficient.

[§7]
And this too is the aspect of: "let it be nullified and be as the dust of the earth" — alluding to what our Sages said: "if it departs — good; but if not — let him recall the day of death" — "for you are dust and to dust you shall return" [Bereishis 3:19] — "a person's foundation is from dust and his end is dust" — and through speaking these words with a full mouth one merits truly to nullify and remove the yetzer. And in this spirit I heard a teaching on what our Sages said: "this nation is compared to stars — and compared to dust. When they descend — they descend to the dust. When they ascend — they ascend to the stars." Meaning: even in their descent they do not wish to cleave to the sitra achra — G-d forbid — but descend to the dust — in the aspect of: "recall the day of death" — making themselves as if already dust — and through this they drive the power of the sitra achra away from themselves — and when they ascend they ascend to the stars — meriting to cleave to the holiness of the supernal intellect through sun and moon — as stated.

segments.he: ואח"כ אומר נשמת וישתבח ויהללוך שהם ברכת השיר. כי הלילה הזאת הוא רק להלל ושיר ושבח להשי"ת על שזכינו לכל זאת ורק בחסדיו ורחמיו הגדולים ית' וכ"ש השיר יהיה לכם כליל התקדש חג.
segments.en:
[§8]
And this: if one did not check on the eve of the fourteenth — one checks on the day of the fourteenth — etc. — if one did not check during Pesach — one checks after Pesach — so as not to stumble over chometz over which Pesach has passed — which is forbidden in benefit. All of this is to urge the person in the matter of searching and elimination — even not at its time — and even completely after its time — for one must be extremely careful not to be lax in this war — but to search and investigate after the ways and counsels of the yetzer hara at every turn — for there is no greater lurker and enemy than it — and at every turn it devises against him evil thoughts and stratagems — as our Sages taught. And not only this — but "all its dealings are with you" — as it says: "and toward you is its desire" [Bereishis 4:7] — [Kiddushin 30b]. Therefore one must be wary and guard against it even in cases of doubt and double-doubt — and never permit oneself in these matters — for "a person cannot see his own liability." But even so — everything must be only according to the ways of holy Torah — and where our Sages have said there is no concern — as in the various distinctions explained in these Simanim — then one has no concern at all — but relies on the nullification that one has recited with a full mouth and whole heart — so as not to enter the aspect of excessive thought.

[§9]
And therefore: even if the chometz is not physically his but he has some connection to it through having accepted responsibility — as explained in Simanim 440 and 441 — he too must eliminate it — so as to have no part or connection with the aspect of the sitra achra. But a non-Jew who enters a Jew's house with his chometz in hand — one is not obligated to remove it — as our Sages taught: "you shall not see your own [chametz] — but you may see another's" — for since one has eliminated all the chometz on his own side — one has already nullified all the power of the sitra achra to the extent that from his side and aspect — holy Malchus already has the strength to overpower the kingdom of the sitra achra. And what one sees — that in the general world the power of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra and the kingdom of wickedness is still in full force — this matter does not pertain to him — for it is beyond the power of the individual person to understand all this — for presumably this is Hashem's will for the sake of free will — and presumably not all the holy sparks have yet been completely clarified — and many other matters involved in this — as is known. And even a non-Jew under his jurisdiction — since he is a non-Jew and from the side of the sitra achra and the chometz is his — the Jew has no responsibility for it and need not eliminate it.

segments.he: ואח"כ מברך על כוס רביעי ועוסק עוד לספר יציאת מצרים בכדי להאיר קדושת הלילה הזאת בתוספות עוז ותעצומות כי ליל שמורים הוא לה' כנ"ל. וזהו שאומרים אח"כ הפיוטים מרוב הנסים והנפלאות שנעשו בלילה הזאת.
segments.en:
[§10]
And therefore even a mixture of chometz is forbidden — and moreover it forbids even in the smallest amount [mashehu] — since it alludes to the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — it forbids even in the smallest amount. And as our Sages taught: "such is the way of the yetzer hara — today it says to a person: do such-and-such" — and tomorrow it says to him: "go worship idols." And as our Sages expounded on the verse: "Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of vanity" [Yeshayahu 5:18] — at first it resembles a thread of the shuttle — and in the end it is like cart-rope. And since it sometimes clothes itself in mitzvos — and it is truly a mitzvah that comes through sin — as stated — therefore one must be very careful even from any slightest mixture of chometz.

[§11]
And therefore chometz that was disqualified before the time of its prohibition from a dog's eating — is permitted to retain — since it was not fit for a dog's eating — and the dog is the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — as Esther said: "save my soul from the sword — my only one from the power of the dog" [Tehillim 22:21] — as our Sages expounded — and as they said to Nebuchadnezzar: "you and a dog are equal" — and the yetzer hara is called a dog — as is known. And therefore chometz not fit for a dog's eating has no prohibition applied to it. But if at the time of its prohibition it was fit for eating — even though afterwards it was disqualified from a dog's eating — one is obligated to eliminate it — since the power of the sitra achra already had dominion over it at the time the prohibition took effect. And therefore for chometz over which debris fell — one gives the measure until the dog cannot dig after it — as stated.

segments.he: ואח"כ אדיר במלוכה וכו' ומרבין לספר בשבח גדולת מלכותו ית' ואיך שהמלאכים הק' מקבלים עליהם עול מלכותו מלמעלה וכן ישראל עם קדוש מלמטה. וזה גדודיו יאמרו לו לך ולך ר"ל מאמר הכתוב לך דומיה תהלה וכו' ולך ישולם נדר (כי בוודאי לא יספיק לו יתב' כל שבחים ותהלות רק אעפ"כ צריכין להודות לו כל אחד לפי כחו כי אם לא כן במה ישולם נדרו וחיובו לה' על כל תגמולוהי עליו) לך כי לך. ר"ל לך ה' הגדולה וכו' כי כל בשמים ובארץ לך ה' הממלכה. לך אף לך.
segments.en:
Siman 443 and on — Biur Chometz [Eliminating the Leaven]
 סִימָן תמ״ג

segments.he: ר"ל לך שמים אף לך ארץ וכן לך יום אף לך לילה וסיים לך ה' הממלכה וכו' כי זה עיקר יסוד השיר והפיוט, ואח"כ מתפלל בדרך פיוט על בנין הבית שלעתיד, ואח"כ אומר אחד מי יודע שזה בחי' המשכת המוחין והידיעה ואומר אחד מי ידע וכו' כי זה עיקר שלימות וכו'. שלימות ותכלית כל המוחין והידיעות בבחי' וידעת היום והשבות אל לבבך וכו'.
segments.en:
[§1]
It is explained in the holy Zohar [Part I, 142]: at that time — when Yaakov was blessed by Yitzchak — it was Erev Pesach — and the yetzer hara sought to grow stronger and have the moon — the secret of faith — dominated — etc. — directed to our subject. And see the Targum Sheini on the delivery of Haman — how Israel says during the elimination of chometz: "so shall the wicked kingdom be eliminated" — directed also to this.

[§2]
And this is the aspect of: the time for eliminating chometz from the Torah is after the sixth hour — and it is explained in the holy Zohar and the Tikkunnim that one must eliminate chometz then so as not to separate — G-d forbid — between six and seven — which are the aspects of sun and moon — and: "the moonlight shall be as the sunlight" — see there. But the Sages forbade it two hours earlier. And this: our Sages taught — in the merit of the nullification of the sourdough on the first day — Erev Pesach — Hashem will in the future exact retribution from Esav — who is called the first — as it is said: "the first one came out" [Bereishis 25:25] — as stated.

segments.he: ומסדר והולך עד שלשה עשר ידיעות קדושות וכולל בתוכם האבות והאמהות והשבטים ולידה ומילה ושבת והלוחות ועשרת הדברות ותורה שבכתב ושבע"פ ושלש עשרה מדות וכו'. ותכלית כל הידיעות הוא אחד אלהינו וכו' ואחד ג"כ מספרו י"ג וכלל מספר כולם מאחד עד י"ג עולה צ"א כמנין הוי"ה אדני שזה בחי' התיקונים הנ"ל.
segments.en:
[§3]
And this: our Sages taught — how does one eliminate chometz? One crumbles it and scatters it to the wind — or throws it into the sea — or burns it — and it is cited that these three methods are the aspects of the three primary elements — fire — wind — water — whose root is the three first letters of the holy Name Havayah — and through them one subdues and eliminates all the sitra achra — the aspect of chometz — and gives strength to holy Malchus — the aspect of the final Heh — the aspect of matzah. And the three holy letters are the aspect of the thirty-nine lights — as explained in the discourse Ani Hashem [Siman 11 of Likutay Moharan] — and all are encompassed in the holy Torah — for "the Torah is the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He." And this: "for the dew of lights is Your dew" [Yeshayahu 26:19] — and our Sages taught: "one who has the dew of Torah within him" — tal [dew] specifically — as stated. And through holy Torah one subdues the power of the yetzer hara — the aspect of the kingdom of Esav — as our Sages expounded: "the voice is the voice of Yaakov" — etc. — for the voice comprises fire, water, and wind — as is known. But the essential mitzvah of eliminating chometz is through fire — for "from fire they came and fire shall consume them" — since their essential power is through the yetzer hara — the aspect of fire — the aspect of the red Esav — therefore one eliminates with fire — which is also the aspect of Torah — in the aspect of: *"Is not My word like fire?"* [Yirmiyahu 23:29] — meaning: to study Torah with force and holy burning enthusiasm — and through this one gives strength to holy Malchus which is also a consuming fire. [And this is also the reason the Pesach offering is eaten only roasted over fire — and whatever remains must be burned — so that they gain no nourishment from it — G-d forbid.]

 Siman 451 and on — Hagalas Keilim [Purging Utensils]
 סִימָן תנ״א

segments.he: ואח"כ מסדר והולך מענין חד גדיא פירושים הרבה כידוע ומה שסמוך לפשוטו הוא כי מדבר בענין הקנאה שהיה להשבטים על יוסף עד שמכרו אותו למצרים וזה גרם גלות מצרים שהוא בחי' התגברות המלכות דסט"א שהוא בחי' כלב. ואתא חוטרא הוא בחי' המטה עוז של משה שמרמז לבחי' המלכות דקדושה שעל ידה הוכה פרעה והמצרים בעשר מכות כמובא בכוונת. ואתא נורא ושרף לחוטרא.
segments.en:
[§1]
And this is the aspect of the laws of purging utensils — and the general principle: "as its usage — so its purification" — for even one who has already stumbled — G-d forbid — through the counsel of the yetzer hara — and damaged the aspects of Malchus and the supernal intellect — nonetheless there is a remedy — for "there is nothing that stands before repentance." But the repentance must correspond to the sin and the damage.

[§2]
And therefore: a vessel used with cold liquid only briefly — since the chometz did not rest in it twenty-four hours — one rinses it in cold water and that suffices. And similarly in our context: since the essential damage is through the fire of the sitra achra — if the damage was not through the heat and passion of the yetzer — G-d forbid — but only in the aspect of: "who can discern errors?" [Tehillim 19:13] — and: "G-d has brought it about" [Shemos 21:13] — some unintentional inadvertent damage without any desire for the sitra achra whatsoever — and moreover one did not wait twenty-four hours but immediately reflected and saw the unintentional damage and greatly repented — then cold rinsing suffices — meaning: to wash and purify oneself inwardly and outwardly with the pure waters of Torah and repentance — and to commit to greater care from now on — and that suffices. And similarly one may apply our Sages' teaching [Yoma 86a]: "one who transgressed a positive commandment and repented — one does not move from there until forgiven" — for this too is the aspect of being used with cold — meaning one had coldness and coolness in performing the mitzvah — but immediately reflected and repented — one is forgiven.

segments.he: כי אח"כ התגבר אש היצה"ר שהוא שורש המלכות דסט"א עד שעי"ז נשפל כח המלכות דקדושה.
segments.en:
[§3]
But if used with boiling [liquid] — through the fire itself without water — libun [heating to red-hot] with fire is specifically required — meaning: if the damages were through the boiling passion of the yetzer hara — and one used it through fire itself without water — meaning one was enticed by one's yetzer to commit some willful sin — G-d forbid — then beyond the damage of the sin itself — there is yet a much greater damage: one threw off the yoke of Heavenly Kingship and gave power to the kingdom of the sitra achra — the aspect of idolatry — G-d forbid. Therefore one's repentance too must be with holy burning and enthusiasm to such a degree that it is in the aspect of libun ba'esh — literally — meaning through literal self-sacrifice — or through the Tzaddik and true Torah scholar — who is the aspect of fire and is the root of Malchus — as explained in the discourse Anochi [Siman 4 of Likutay Moharan].
