segments.he: ואתא מיא וכבה לנורא כי עיקר התיקון לכבות האש של היצה"ר הוא ע"י מימי התורה הק'. ואתא תורא. הוא בחי' עשו ושריו זה בחי' התגברות הגלות הזה שמתגבר העיקר על ביטול תורה. ואתא השוחט. רמז על משיח בן יוסף שיכניעם כמובא.
segments.en:
[§4]
Now the nature of fire is not to expel the absorbed [substance] from the vessel — but to burn it within — and it becomes ash — the vessel becoming as earth. And therefore since the power of the sitra achra was rooted in his heart through the fire itself — he requires libun with fire — and through this he rectifies what was damaged in the aspects of the holy fire and earth — which correspond to the aspects of the intellect and Malchus mentioned above. But what was absorbed through boiling [liquid] — where the power of fire and water were mixed — this is the aspect of: sometimes the yetzer hara clothes itself in mitzvos — and truthfully the person himself is culpable — for had he properly reflected on the matter to its truth — for Heaven's sake alone — the yetzer hara could not have so deceived him and blinded his eyes as to make a sin appear a mitzvah — G-d forbid — but presumably he had some self-interest in the matter as well. And there are many other such aspects where the heat of the yetzer is mixed with some good intention — and yet it is a damage and transgression from the side of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — this is the aspect of chometz absorbed through boiling liquid — and therefore hagalah in boiling water is required — meaning: one must engage in Torah — which comprises both fire and water — with force and holy warmth — and through this one expels from within oneself the evil power of the sitra achra — and merits to give strength to holy Malchus — as stated. And for rectifying the damages themselves — the rectification for every damage and sin is already explained in the holy books.

[§5]
And in this there are also various legal distinctions: whether the absorption occurred in boiling liquid on the fire or already removed from it — and between a keli rishon [primary vessel] and a secondary vessel [keli sheini] — and pouring from a primary vessel — and whether one follows the majority usage — and if absorbed cold through soaking twenty-four hours or through a sharp-tasting substance — and the laws of earthenware vessels — and the laws of purging before or after the time of the chometz prohibition — and all of these revolve and proceed according to this approach — as cited in the holy books and as understood in the holy Zohar. And therefore even where only light libun is needed — one still requires at minimum that straw be burned on its outside — to draw the aspect of: *"the house of Yaakov shall be fire — and the house of Yosef a flame — and the house of Esav for straw — and they shall kindle in them and consume them"* [Ovadyah 1:18] — as stated.

segments.he: כי יוסף הוא בחי' שור דקדושה ע"כ יכניע השור דסט"א. ואתא מלאך המות וכו' כי גם הוא יהרג ר"ל כמו שארז"ל וכמובא. רק אעפ"כ ואתה מרום לעולם ה' כי ימין ה' רוממה ואמת ה' לעולם ואתא הקב"ה ושחט למלאך המות וכו' ויתתקן הכל בתכלית השלימות ב"ב אמן.
segments.en:
Siman 453 and on — The Laws of Matzah; The Exile of Egypt
 סִימָן תנ״ג — הִלְכוֹת מַצָּה; גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם

[§1]
The Egyptian exile descended from the sin of Adam HaRishon — who damaged the aspects of these rectifications through eating from the Tree of Knowledge — as is known. And afterwards it was caused by Avraham Avinu saying: "How shall I know that I will inherit it?" [Bereishis 15:8] — through which he damaged the aspect of inheriting the Land of Israel — which encompasses all these rectifications — and then it was said to him: "Know surely that your seed shall be strangers" — etc. [Bereishis 15:13].

segments.he: נשמט מדלעיל כי היה בדעתי לקצר וגם כי הדברים פשוטים ומובנים ממילא. בענין כמה מעלות וכו' שחושב ט"ו מעלות כנגד עלית הלבנה ומלואה שעולה עד ט"ו יום.
segments.en:
[§2]
And afterwards the tribes damaged through their selling Yosef to Egypt — and through all of this the kingdom of the sitra achra gained greater power to subjugate Israel. Only afterwards everything turned to good — in the aspect of: "at the time when the man rules over the man — to his harm" [Koheles 8:9] — for specifically through Yosef's being sold to Egypt — he subdued and broke the power of the sitra achra there — through standing firm in his trial and binding himself to the holy intellect — in the aspect of: "he saw the image of his father Yaakov" — as explained elsewhere — and broke the power of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra there — until Pharaoh himself appointed him ruler over all the land of Egypt — and through this Israel was sustained during the exile — as our Sages taught. But nonetheless for the time being this brought about the descent of Yaakov and his sons — who were the unique individuals of the generation — who merited to accept the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship and bind themselves to holy intellect in its fullness — for only for this was all of Creation: "in order that they know Him." And therefore when they descended to Egypt — the Shechinah descended with them — as our Sages taught — as Hashem promised: *"I will go down with you to Egypt — and I will also surely bring you up"* [Bereishis 46:4].

[§3]
And this: the Torah related: "And these are the names" — etc. — "Yosef died and all his brothers" — etc. — "the Children of Israel were fruitful and swarmed" — etc. — "the land was filled with them" — and through this the power of holy Malchus grew greatly — in the aspect of: "in the multitude of people is the glory of the king" [Mishlei 14:28] — and then the opposing force arose — Malchus of the sitra achra — to scheme against this. And: "a new king arose" — etc. — "let us act wisely against them" — wisely specifically — to strengthen the wisdom and intellect of the sitra achra against holy intellect — the aspect of Moshe — and as our Sages expounded: "against their savior." And: "they placed upon them taskmasters" — strengthened the subjugation of the kingdom of the sitra achra — and: "as they would afflict them — so they would multiply and spread" — for since they were inwardly strongly bound to holiness — every time the sitra achra grew stronger over them physically — holy Malchus grew stronger spiritually — multiplying their offspring — and correspondingly the subjugation grew stronger each time.

segments.he: וזה חושב שהוציאנו ממצרים וכו' עד ונתן לנו את ממונם זה כנגד מה שפרק ממנו עול מלכותם ולא עוד אלא שעשה נקמה בהם ובאלהיהם ובכוריהם ונתן לנו את ממונם שהוא ג"כ מבחי' המלכות שלהם כ"ש עשיר ברשים ימשול. וזה בחי' הבטחת ואחרי כן יצאו ברכוש גדול שכל מה שקבצו ואספו בכח המלכות שלהם נמסר אח"כ לישראל ע"י שזכו לברר ניצוצי הק' מבינותם כראוי.
segments.en:
[§4]
And this: "Egypt enslaved the Children of Israel with crushing labor" — and our Sages taught: "first with soft speech" — etc. — for this is the way of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — who at first entices with smooth-tongued flattery — as if intending for one's good — and sometimes even dresses itself in mitzvos — and deceives the person — and afterwards rules over him with crushing labor — and it seems to the person that he is compelled to go after it — like a sheep led to slaughter — G-d forbid. And afterwards Pharaoh decreed to kill the males — who correspond to holy intellect — and keep the females alive — from the aspect of holy Malchus — in order to defile them — G-d forbid — thereby gaining even more nourishment from holy Malchus.

segments.he: ואח"כ חושב מענין קריעת ים סוף עד והאכילנו את המן שכל זה מבחי' התגלות המלכות דקדושה עלינו בהארה גדולה שקיבלה מבחי' המוחין העליונים שזה בחי' מלכותך ראו בניך בוקע ים לפני משה כמובא. וע"כ סיימו השירה ה' ימלוך לעולם ועד.
segments.en:
[§5]
But Hashem frustrated the counsel of nations — and in the very height of the bitterness Moshe our teacher was born — and his mother saw that he was good — and our Sages taught: "the entire house was filled with light" — for the face of Moshe was like the face of the sun — and he illuminated the eyes of Israel to look only at the intellect of every thing. And [his mother] hid him — etc. — and took for him a papyrus basket and sealed it with tar and pitch — and it is explained in the holy Zohar: "two colors — white and black" — alluding to the two aspects [of Chochmah and Malchus] — as is known. And then Pharaoh's daughter went down to bathe — etc. — and saved Moshe — etc. — until: "Moshe was herding" — etc. — "and the angel of Hashem appeared to him in a flame of fire from within the bush" [Shemos 3:2] — alluding to Malchus — for Malchus was, as it were, in exile — and Moshe greatly wondered why the bush was not consumed — for fire is a consuming force. And then Hashem called to him — and said: "do not come close" — "there is no 'close' [halom] except Malchus" [Megillah 12b] — for it is forbidden to enter such concealment through force — for this is the secret of free will — the ultimate purpose of Creation — and in this world it cannot be comprehended — for then free will would be nullified — as is explained elsewhere. And then He revealed to him that the time of redemption had arrived — and Moshe was somewhat reluctant in his mission — for he knew this was not yet the complete redemption — and the sitra achra would yet strengthen many times — for it is hard to help a being with free will — and each day the yetzer renews and grows stronger — and therefore he also wondered through what merit they would be redeemed. For even though Hashem Himself said He heard their cry and had compassion in the merit of the forefathers — he was nonetheless surprised — for he knew the opposing side as well — for great is the power of free will — as events later proved. And Hashem Himself certainly saw and knew all this — as it is written: "I have surely seen" — and our Sages taught: two seeings — yet it arose in His will to redeem them — for since they would receive the Torah — and through holy Torah ultimately holy Malchus would overpower the sitra achra — everything would be rectified.

[§6]
And this: Hashem informed him: "when you take out the nation from Egypt — you shall worship G-d upon this mountain" [Shemos 3:12] — and Rashi explains: you shall receive the Torah upon it — and this is the merit that stands for Israel — for through this everything will be in order. And then Moshe said: "and you shall say to them: the G-d of your forefathers sent me to you" — this is the aspect of faith — the aspect of Malchus — the inheritance of the forefathers. And: "they will say to me: what is His Name?" — and it is explained in the holy Zohar on another verse: "What is His Name? This is Chochmah" — meaning they would immediately wish to attain the light of wisdom itself. And: Ehyeh asher Ehyeh [I shall be what I shall be] — He informed them that the essence of the intellect itself cannot be attained — for "the ultimate of knowledge is that we do not know" — and therefore the essential thing is to hold oneself always in truth in the aspect of holy Malchus — faith — and through this one merits some flickering of the intellect — and takes upon himself ever more the complete yoke of Heavenly Kingship in clear bright faith — and then merits higher mochin — as explained elsewhere.

segments.he: וזהו והעבירנו בתוכו בחרבה להודיע שזכינו לקבל עול מלכות שמים שלימה ושיקע צרינו בתוכו ועשה אז נקמה בהם בשלימות. וסיפק צרכינו במדבר שזה ג"כ מבחי' המלכות דקדושה בחי' אילנא וכו' ומזון לכולא ביה אנת הוא מלכא. כי הפרנסה נמשך מן המלכות כמבואר במ"א וזה וסיפק צרכינו במדבר ארבעים שנה בחי' בן ארבעים לבינה וכמבואר במ"א כי קיבלה כח מלמעלה ממקום גבוה כנ"ל. וזה והאכילנו את המן שהוא לחם אבירים לחם מן השמים ונמשך ממקום גבוה עליון מאד כידוע.
segments.en:
[§7]
And this: Ehyeh asher Ehyeh — "thus you shall say to the Children of Israel: Ehyeh sent me to you" — to inform them that the ultimate of holy attainment is only in the aspect of: "Ehyeh — I am destined to be" [ana zamin l'mihevi] — to yearn at every turn to attain an ever greater attainment — so as to have an ever higher intellect — and then to yearn for yet higher intellect — and this itself is the aspect of the yetzer tov — holy Malchus — called misken v'chacham — poor and wise — as stated. For at every turn one sees and reflects on one's own poverty — the intellect one has already attained is not considered an attainment at all — one is at a level where this is no attainment — and only stands awaiting the reception of ever higher Chochmah — and this itself is the essential fullness of wisdom and attainment — the aspect of: "the ultimate of knowledge is that we do not know." And: Hashem said further to Moshe: "and I shall give this people favor [chen] in the eyes of Egypt" — meaning the kingdom of the sitra achra — Egypt — will be subdued — and Malchus will ascend — the aspect of nun — and connect with the ches — and through this there will be chen for Israel — even in Egypt's eyes.

[§8]
And this: Hashem said to Moshe: "and you shall say to Pharaoh: so says Hashem — My son — My firstborn — Israel" — etc. — "behold I am killing your son — your firstborn" [Shemos 4:23] — for He immediately informed him of the loftiness of Israel's holiness — that they are in the aspect of the firstborn — who bind themselves to holy intellect — the aspect of reishis — the aspect of the birthright. And likewise holy Malchus is called the firstborn — as it is written: *"I too shall appoint him firstborn — exalted among kings of the earth"* [Tehillim 89:28]. And afterwards when they came to Pharaoh — the power of the sitra achra strengthened further — and Pharaoh said: "who is Hashem that I should listen to His voice?" — "increase the labor of the men" — etc. And this: "Pharaoh will speak to you — and Aharon shall throw his staff before Pharaoh" — etc. — "and it became a serpent" — and through this He showed him that the essential power of the kingdom of Pharaoh — called the great serpent — is also only through the will and Providence of Hashem — the aspect of Heavenly Kingship — which is the true essence of Malchus — the aspect of the royal scepter. And Pharaoh also called his wise men — for he sought to overcome this revelation through the wisdom of the sitra achra. But Aharon's staff swallowed their staffs — and they saw plainly that the power of holy Malchus is very great — and can swallow them all — only everything proceeds according to His will.

segments.he: ואח"כ חושב איך שזכינו עי"ז למעלה גבוה עוד יותר. היינו אל אור השכל בעצמו. וזהו ונתן לנו את השבת שהוא בחי' קדש כידוע. וקרבנו לפני הר סיני שאז זכינו לקבל עוד מוחין גבוהים ביותר בבחי' פנים בפנים דיבר ה' עמכם והיה ג"כ ביום השבת כי בשבת ניתנה תורה ונתן לנו את התורה שהיא דרך כבושה לעשות רצונו ית' תמיד וליתן כח להמלכות דקדושה להתגבר לעולם כמאמר בראתי יצה"ר בראתי תורה תבלין. ועי"ז והכניסנו לארץ ישראל שהיא מלכות שמים שלימה. ובנה לנו את בית הבחירה ששם מאירין המוחין העליונים בבחי' כל מי שיש בו דעה כאלו נבנה בית המקדש בימיו. וזה לכפר על כל עונותינו. כי אל די שע"י השכל והמוחין ניצולין מעוונות כי אין אדם עובר עבירה אח"כ נכנס בו רוח שטות אף גם עי"ז יוכל להתתקן ולהתכפר גם מה שפגם כבר בבחי' ואיש חכם יכפרנה כמבואר במ"א:
segments.en:
[§9]
The Ten Plagues — and yet Pharaoh's heart hardened — etc. — and then came the plague of blood — all the waters of the Nile — which was their essential power and dominion — as cited in the Zohar — were converted to blood — a sign of destruction and death. And also: water alludes to the aspect of daas and intellect — in the aspect of: "knowledge shall cover the earth as the water covers the sea" — and through this He subdued the daas and intellect of the sitra achra. And the fish of the Nile — which is the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — died — etc. — and the magicians also did so — for they strengthened themselves through their evil wisdom and sorcery — yet Pharaoh's heart hardened — etc. — for all this was through the Creator's will.

[§10]
And then the plague of frogs — which came from the water and tormented them — and also acted contrary to their nature — for their nature is to be in water — yet they came into the ovens into fire — and through this He showed them that everything is only through His dominion and Kingship. And the Nile itself — which was their essential power at first — was itself struck — converted to blood — and then from it itself emerged the punishment against them.

segments.he: שייך לענין חד גדיא דלעיל
segments.en:
[§11]
And then the plague of lice — as it is written: "and he struck the dust of the earth" — dust alludes to Malchus — as is known — and the dust of Egypt alludes to the kingdom of the sitra achra — and it was struck with lice. And in this plague their wisdom and their Malchus were both subdued — for: "the lice were upon man and beast" — which are the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — as is known — and then the magicians attempted their incantations — etc. — but could not — etc. — and then the magicians admitted and said: "it is the finger of G-d." And then was the plague of wild beasts — and a wild beast is the aspect of Chochmah — and there is also a wild beast that is the aspect of Malchus — as is known — and the essential harm was primarily to human beings — as it is written: "upon you and your servants and your people" — and human beings are beings of intellect — and they were harmed by wild beasts — which are the aspects of evil wisdom. And also: the yetzer hara is called a wild beast — as it is written: "a wild beast devoured him" [Bereishis 37:33] — and our Sages expounded: regarding the wife of Potiphar.

segments.he: ואתא נורא אולי ר"ל על מלכות נבוכדנצר וגלות בבל שהתגברה האש דסט"א כמ"ש וישרוף את בית ה' ואת כל בית גדול שרף באש וכמוהו רבים והשליך לחנניה מישאל ועזריה לכבשן אש. ובגלות בבל נכלל גם גלות מדי כי היו משתלשלין מזה לזה. וזה ושרף לחוטרא כי התגבר על המלכות דקדושה של זרע דוד שהם חוטר מגזע ישי ואתא מיא וכבה לנורא. כי זכות התורה של גלות יכניה החרש והמסגר אלף וכן של כל הזקנים והנביאים שבאנשי כנסת הגדולה עמדה להם עד שניצולו מצרת המן ימ"ש ועלו מגלות בבל ומדי ושבו לארצם עם עזרא הסופר שהאיר עיני כל ישראל בתורתו וכן להלן.
segments.en:
[§12]
And this: "and I shall distinguish on that day the land of Goshen" — etc. — "so that you may know that I am Hashem in the midst of the earth" [Shemos 8:18] — for at first with the plagues of blood and frogs He said: "in order that you know" — etc. — and: "so that you may know that there is none like Hashem our G-d" — this is the aspect of the knowledge of His G-dliness — the essential holy intellect in general. And now He explained in detail the distinction and separation between Egypt and Israel — because they are connected to holy intellect in detail — and therefore He said: "so that you may know that I am Hashem in the midst of the earth" — for in all earthly matters there is also divine life-force and holy intellect and particular Providence — and this you will see plainly: throughout all the land of Egypt the land was ruined by the wild beasts — but in the land of Goshen there were no wild beasts.

[§13]
And then the plague of pestilence — only on the cattle of Egypt — not those of Israel — and beast corresponds to the aspect of Malchus. And then the plague of boils — on man and beast — corresponding to both aspects. And our Sages taught: "the boils of Egypt were wet on the outside and dry within" — also corresponding to both aspects — for the nature of the moon is moisture and the nature of the sun is dryness — as is known. And therefore it was also then said: "the magicians could not stand before Moshe — because of the boils."

segments.he: ואתא תורא זה מלכות יון שתחלת גבורתה וממשלתה עלינו היה ע"י אלכסנדר מוקדון שהיה קולו כקול השור כמבואר ביוסיפון. וזה ושתה למיא. כי מלכות הרשעה זאת בטלה את ישראל מן התורה וגזרו שמדות ואמרו להם כתבו לכם על קרן השור שאין לכם חלק באלהי ישראל. ועיין בזה במגלה עמוקות בספר מאמר יהונתן על חד גדיא והמלכות הזאת גברה עלינו שנים הרבה כמו שארז"ל.
segments.en:
[§14]
And then the plague of hail — it was only in the field — the aspect of the external aspect of Malchus — but there it encompassed everything: man and beast and grass — the aspects of the animate, animal, and plant worlds — whose roots are fire, wind, and water — as is known. And the hail itself comprised fire and water — corresponding to both aspects — and they were unified together — and the fire descended below to the earth — contrary to its nature — and all of this to punish Egypt and to demonstrate that there is none like Hashem our G-d in all the earth — for the ability is only in His hands — and all is done only through His will and Providence. And then the plague of locusts — and arbeh [locusts] in numerical value equals four times ben [ב-ן] — also corresponding to Malchus — and it encompassed both the field and the houses — for when Malchus ascends to its place it is in the aspect of a house — as is known — and it came through the wind — and affected only growing things. And then the plague of darkness — which is the opposite of holy Chochmah — the essential light — and therefore: "but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings" [Shemos 10:23]. And regarding the announcement of the plague of locusts — Pharaoh agreed that the men should leave — as they are the ones of full daas — but not the women and children — who are of lower level. And for the darkness: he agreed even about the children — but not the flock and cattle — which are the aspect of Malchus — for he wanted to suckle from that aspect at least. And then Hashem said to Moshe: "yet one more plague" — etc. — and then it was said: "Hashem gave the people favor [chen] in the eyes of Egypt" — the aspect of chen — as stated — for this is the totality of the building — to elevate the holy chen of Israel.

[§15]
And then came the plague of the firstborn — against the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus — which are the aspect of the firstborn — as stated — for Chochmah is the aspect of reishis [beginning] from above downward — and Malchus is reishis from below upward — the aspect of: "the beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem" — as is known. And therefore the plague of the firstborn was from the firstborn of man to the firstborn of beast — and it was on the night of the fifteenth of Nisan at the fullness of the moon — and it is brought in the holy Zohar: "that night shone like the day of the summer solstice" — for the aspect of: "the moonlight shall be as the sunlight" was drawn then. And: "no dog barked — not at man nor beast among Israel" [Shemos 11:7] — for they merited the holy aspects of man and beast — and the sitra d'mosa had no dominion over them at all.

segments.he: וזה ואתא השוחט ושחט לתורא. כי שור המועד אין לו שמירה אלא ע"י שחיטה בסכין. וכמו כן אז גברו החשמונאים במלחמה רבה שלא כדרך הישועה מגלות מצרים ומגלות בבל ומדי שהיו רק מישועת ה' בעצמו וכאן ראו ג"כ ישועת ה' ונסים ונפלאות גדולות אבל אעפ"כ היתה הישועה ע"י שהתגברו עליהם במלחמת חרבם שזה בחי' ואתא השוחט ושחט לתורא.
segments.en:
[§16]
And then they were commanded regarding the sanctification of the month — as stated — and regarding taking the Pesach lamb from the tenth and slaughtering it on the fourteenth between the afternoons. See the holy Zohar [Parshas Bo 41; Parshas Emor 95] — directed to our subject. And see there Parshas Bo [38]: "Who would not fear You — O King?" — etc. — "for among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdoms — there is none like You" [Yirmiyahu 10:7] — directed also to our subject. And see there [40] regarding the nullification of sourdough and chometz and the eating of matzah — and in [Part III 251] and [282b] — and in the Tikkunnim in many places — and all directed to our subject. And this that concludes at the end of the passage Vayehi b'Chatzi HaLailah: "and Hashem gave the people favor" — etc. — for this is the totality of the building — to elevate the holy chen of Israel — as stated.

[§17]
And this too is the aspect of the blood of Pesach and the blood of milah — as understood in the holy Zohar and the writings. And this is what our Sages taught: the redemption was in the merit of Yaakov and Yosef — as it is said: *"You redeemed with Your arm Your people — the sons of Yaakov and Yosef, Selah"* [Tehillim 77:16] — for they merited to draw these rectifications in their fullness — as explained within.

segments.he: ואח"כ ואתא המלאך המות. זהו שרו של אדום שגלותו נקרא תהום כמו שדרז"ל ותהום אותיות המות וזה ושחט לשוחט כי גם בחורבן בית שני גברו ישראל הרבה ושחטו אותם בחרבם הקשה רבבי רבבות בלי שיעור ואעפ"כ בסוף גברו עליהם הרומיים בחרבם ואז גלינו מארצינו וכו'. אך אעפ"כ יש תקוה לאחריתינו כי סוף כל סוף ואתא הקב"ה ושחט למלאך המות וכו' וכמו שארז"ל וכל החסדים והישועות הכל הוא על יסוד הישועה הנפלאה שעשה לנו השי"ת בלילה הזאת כנ"ל. ואח"כ נהגו לומר שיר השירים בנעימות ודביקות נפלא כל אחד כפי בחינתו ומדריגתו כי בו כלול הכל כמובן מדברי רז"ל ועוסקין עוד לספר ביציאת מצרים כמבואר בשו"ע:
segments.en:
[§18]
And returning to our subject: therefore one may only fulfil the obligation of matzah through the five species [of grain] — for they are from the side of holiness — as explained in the Zohar [Part II, 120] where they are compared to Israel — and in [Part III, 244] it is explained that no angel is appointed over them — only Hashem Himself — and likewise in Zohar Chadash. And therefore the matzah — which alludes to the aspect of the yetzer tov and holy Malchus — must be specifically from them. And also the other species do not come to fermentation — for this too is zeh l'umat zeh [this corresponding to that] — for since they have exceptional holiness in their root — the sitra achra grows stronger to suckle from them — as our Sages taught: "the yetzer hara engages only with Israel — and especially with the great of Israel."

segments.he: סימן תפ"ח
segments.en:
[§19]
And the custom is to take wheat specifically — for its holiness is most revealed — and therefore they correspond to daas and intellect — and to the twenty-two letters of the Torah — as is known — and the twenty-two letters of the Malchus of the mouth — as stated. And also through this one draws greater rectification for the eating of the Tree of Knowledge — for our Sages taught: "it was wheat."

[§20]
And therefore one must guard the wheat from the time of harvesting — or at least from the time of grinding — for flour alludes especially to the aspect of Malchus — as is known — and requires guarding lest the mayim zeidoim [the yetzer hara's illicit waters] come upon it and cause it to ferment — for "there are waters and there are waters" — as is known. And the essential guarding is for matzas mitzvah — which alludes to these aspects — and requires heightened guarding — and it is also from the attribute of Shamor [guarding — the feminine/lunar aspect]. Indeed Israel are holy and guard all the Pesach mitzvos from the time of grinding at minimum — and certainly from the time of kneading until after baking.

segments.he: מענין התפלה של יום טוב הכל מבואר ממילא. ובחזרת מוסף יום ראשון של פסח מתחילין לומר מוריד הטל שמרמז ג"כ על ענין זה שממשיכין הארת השלש אותיות ראשונות שבשם הוי"ה ב"ה שהם במילואם גמטרי' טל והם בחי' המוחין וכו' ומחברין אותן לה"א אחרונה שהיא בחי' מלכות. גם זה הטל הוא סוד טל של תחיה כי המוחין הם עיקר החיות כנ"ל ועיין בכוונות. ועיין בתיקוני זוהר בהקדמה שניה:
segments.en:
[§21]
And therefore one may not fulfil one's obligation on Pesach with bread of bran or coarse flour — which is not called bread — the aspect of holy Malchus. And therefore one kneads the matzah only with cold water and not with lukewarm — lest the heat of the sitra achra take hold and ferment the dough.

[§22]
And therefore one kneads only with water that has slept [mayim shelanu] — and there are several opinions in the Shulchan Aruch Siman 455 — and all revolve on this approach. For one is concerned lest the heat of the sun — which travels during the day near the springs in winter — took hold in them — and therefore they must cool through the attribute of night — which is the aspect of coolness — and the primary cooling is from midnight until dawn. And one opinion is: the reason is that at night the sun travels under the earth and heats the springs — therefore they must stand in their connection to the earth all day — when the earth — which is also from this attribute — cools them. See the Shulchan Aruch and you will understand further.

segments.he: סימן תפ"ט
segments.en:
[§23]
And therefore one may not knead Pesach dough larger than the measure of challah — a tenth of an ephah — the aspect of Malchus — since it is impossible to work it properly during kneading to protect it from chometz. And the custom is to knead matzas mitzvah on Erev Pesach after the sixth hour — for this is the essential completeness of "turn from evil and do good" — first eliminate the chometz at its proper time — and when the time of its prohibition from the Torah arrives — the primary time for the destruction and subduing of the sitra achra — that is the primary time to engage in building holy Malchus — the aspect of matzas mitzvah.

[§24]
And therefore one does not knead in a sunny spot or near the warmth of the oven — lest the heat of the sitra achra take hold. And one must not leave the dough even a moment without attention — for one must know that the enemy stands in ambush from all sides at every moment — and its essential power is at the moment when a person is idle from Torah or mitzvah. And this: "as long as one is engaged with it — even all day — it does not ferment" — for through the engagement one gives strength to holy Malchus — so that fermentation cannot take hold. But if left without engagement for the measure of a mil — which is the aspect of the Shabbos boundary — the boundary of holiness — the aspect of Malchus [see Maurai Or] — it has fermented — and the measure of a mil is eighteen minutes — and through this the holy vitality was damaged — and the chometz — the sitra d'mosa — G-d forbid — has taken hold. [Some say a mil is two-fifths of an hour — etc. — see Shulchan Aruch.] And after working the dough and warming it in the hands — if left without engagement it immediately ferments — for then the sitra achra grows stronger — seeking nourishment from the holiness — and therefore one must then be especially vigilant.

segments.he: בליל שני מתחילין לספור העומר. עיין זוהר אמור דף צ"ד שבהקרבת העומר מגרשין היצה"ר שהוא בחי' אשת זנונים וכו' כי אע"פ שביום ראשון של פסח קבלנו הארה גדולה ונפלאה. אבל מחמת שהכל היה רק בבחי' אתערותא דלעילא כי לא היינו מוכנים לזה רק הכל בחסדי השי"ת בכדי שלא להשתקע ח"ו בטומאת מצרים כנ"ל. ע"כ תיכף אחר יום ראשון מסתלקת ההארה ולא נשאר רק בחי' רשימו ממנה ואז צריכין להקריב העומר שהוא מאכל בהמה בחי' מלכות ולהניף אותו תנופה לה'. היינו שלא להיות כבהמה ממש ח"ו ולהיות נגרר אחר הבהמיות ר"ל רק להיות בבחי' בהמה דקדושה וע"ד שאמר הכתוב ואני בער ולא אדע בהמות הייתי עמך. וזה בעצמו נמשך מכח הרשימו שנשאר אצלינו מההארה הנפלאה שקבלנו מקודם כי עי"ז זכינו להרגיש ביותר שעדיין לא התחלנו כלל לידע בידיעתו ית' רק צריכין להיות בבחי' בהמה דקדושה היינו לעשות עצמינו כשור לעול וכחמור למשא לקבל עלינו עול מלכותו ית' ולקיים ככל מצותיו ית' ביראה ואהבה כראוי עד שנזכה עי"ז דייקא לעלות מבחי' בהמה לבחי' אדם היינו להשיג השכל דקדושה ולכלול באחדותו ית'. וע"כ היה העומר מנופה בי"ג נפה. אחד גמטריא י"ג כמובא ומרמז לבחי' המשכת תיקונים הנ"ל כמובא לעיל בקונטרס זה.
segments.en:
[§25]
And therefore one may not work on matzas mitzvah through a non-Jew — who is from the side of the sitra achra — and even through a Jew who is not of sound mind and has no part in holy intellect — such as a deaf-mute, an imbecile, or a minor — it is also forbidden. And therefore the great scholars of Israel would work on matzas mitzvah themselves — with all their strength — for the greater and more capable the one who works with it — and the more force he applies — the greater and higher the power he infuses into it. And at minimum they should stand and oversee the production themselves — and encourage those working on it — for through everything being done under their supervision — an additional illumination is drawn upon it. And also literally — for the greater their wisdom — the more carefully they will guard the matzas mitzvah with heightened vigilance.

segments.he: וע"כ העומר הוא בדיקו דאשת חיל כי זה עיקר הבדיקה והניסיון כמשחזקין א"ע בעבודת ה' בעת וזמן הסתקלות הארת המוחין ומקבלין ע"ע אז ג"כ עול מלכות שמים שלימה ונזהר בעצמו מאד לבלי להמשך אחר תאוות הבהמיות ח"ו ולעשות רצונו ית' לבטל כנגד זה כל הרצונות שלו ועושה עצמו כבהמה לסבול על עצמו עול עבודת ה' כנ"ל. כשעומד בניסיון הזה אז זוכה שנפתח לו אור המוחין והדעת ושבילי השכל עד שזוכה למעלות ובחינות גבוהות כאלו שעליהם נאמר אש חיל עטרת בעלה.
segments.en:
[§26]
And therefore fruit juice without water does not ferment at all by law — for it is specifically the waters that allude to lofty aspects — the waters of daas — the waters of chesed — the waters of Torah — the waters of repentance and prayer — as it is said: "pour out your heart like water" [Eichah 2:19] — and our Sages taught: "water preceded the world." And therefore the sitra achra — which is the aspect of the mayim zeidoim [illicit waters] — whose essential hold includes Esav and Yishmael — the kingdoms of the sitra achra — as understood in the holy Zohar [Parshas Beshalach 64b] — clings after them and ferments the dough. But fruit juice does not ferment. However if there is some water mixed in — it ferments even more quickly — for then the sitra achra clings after the water all the more — since they are mixed with fruit juice that contains human pleasures.

[§27]
And moreover one cannot fulfil one's obligation of matzah with such matzah — for it is not lechem oni [bread of poverty] — the aspect of holy Malchus — the aspect of misken — but rather matzah ashirah — rich matzah. [Unless the fruit juice is nullified in sixty parts and its flavor is not detectable — see Shulchan Aruch.] And in these countries the custom is not to knead even with fruit juice alone — except in pressing circumstances for a sick person or elderly one — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch.

segments.he: וזה בחי' ספירת העומר שסופרין אח"כ שבעה שבועות כי ע"י בחי' התקשרות דקדושה וקבלת מלכות שמים שמרומז במצוות העומר עי"ז זוכה להשיג בחי' השכל המלובש בכל בחינה ובחינה בכלל הבריאה שכלולה מז' מדות בחי' ז' ימי בראשית וכל מדה ומדה כלולה מז'. גם כי זוכה עי"ז לתקן כל מדותיו בתכלית השלימות בכל הבחינות שיש בכל מדה ומדה עד שזוכה ביום החמשים שהוא שבועות לקבל הארה והתנוצצות דק' בבחי' השכל העליון הנפלא שהוא בחי' שער החמשים שמשם שורש כל התורה הק' כי אורייתא מחכמה עילאה נפקת. ועיין נפלאות מענין ספירה ושבועות ע"פ המאמר הזה בלקוטי הלכות חושן משפט ה' פקדון באריכות נפלא:
segments.en:
[§28]
And this is the aspect of: the prohibition of labor on Erev Pesach from midday onward [Siman 468] — for the illumination of the holiness of Yom Tov begins to flow then — the aspect of the drawing of these rectifications. And this is the aspect of: the fast of the firstborn on Erev Pesach — in memory of the miracle — etc. — for since they merited the aspect of the firstborn — which alludes to the drawing of these rectifications — therefore they are especially obligated on this day to engage in repentance and fasting — to subdue the kingdom of the sitra achra — whose essential hold is in eating — in the aspect of what Esav said: "feed me now" — and through this he damaged the sanctity of the firstborn — as it is written there: "and Esav despised the birthright" [Bereishis 25:34] — as stated.

[§29]
And therefore even a sensitive person should not eat during the day — so that he eats matzah at night with appetite — for since matzah is holy eating — michla d'mehamnuta [food of faith] — and the light of Heavenly Kingship and holy intellect shines in it — therefore it must be eaten with appetite — with love and willingness — so that even the body enjoys it — in order to draw through this sanctity and daas upon all bodily pleasures — that they too should be only for Heaven's sake and with great holiness. And therefore everyone is forbidden to eat bread [i.e., rich matzah] on Erev Pesach from the tenth hour at minimum — so as to eat matzah at night with appetite.

segments.he: סימן תצ"ה וכו'
segments.en:
[§30]
And therefore eating matzah all of Erev Pesach is forbidden — and our Sages taught: "one who eats matzah on Erev Pesach is as one who has relations with his betrothed in his father-in-law's house" — meaning: before the wedding canopy and the seven blessings — as brought in the Chok Yaakov [Siman 471] in the name of the Levush and the Mahariv — for since matzah alludes to such exalted holiness — one may not eat it before its time. And one must especially be careful close to the time when its holiness is revealed — and the time for the subduing and nullification of the sitra achra — which is then in the aspect of chometz — and it is kept at the greatest distance — until its mixture is forbidden even in the smallest amount. Therefore the power of the sitra achra grows greatly — G-d forbid — and if one eats matzah then before the full illumination of its holiness arrives — there is concern that the sitra achra might gain a hold — G-d forbid — in that eating. Therefore it is forbidden to eat until the time of its holiness' fullness arrives — when upon it and upon all of Israel flows a great and wondrous illumination — the aspect of the supernal holy wedding canopy — and one blesses upon it the seven blessings. And then there is no hold at all for the sitra achra in that eating — on the contrary — through that holy eating wondrous and awesome rectifications are drawn for the entire year — for each and every person according to their aspect — as understood in the holy Zohar and the writings.

 Siman 472 and on — Leil HaSeder and the Haggadah
 סִימָן תע״ב — לֵיל הַסֵּדֶר וְהַהַגָּדָה

segments.he: הלכות יו"ט כל מלאכה האסורה בשבת אסורה ביו"ט חוץ ממלאכת אוכל נפש וכו'. עיין בכוונות ובסידור רי"ק ותבין איך שהכל סובב על דרך עניניו הנ"ל. כי שבת הוא בחי' קדש עצמו שהוא בחי' אור החכמה העליונה בעצמו וגם בחי' המלכות עולה אז ויושבת בחיק אביה בבחי' אבא יסד ברתא בחי' ה' בחכמה יסד ארץ וע"כ נמתקין בו כל הדינים ואין שום אחיזה להחצונים וכו' ונאסרין בו כל המלאכות אפילו מלאכת אוכל נפש. אבל יו"ט הוא מקרא קודש.
segments.en:
[§1 — Zohar Citations]
See the holy Zohar [Parshas Vayeitzei 157]: "When Israel was in Egypt they were under another dominion — until the Holy One wished to draw them close to Himself — He gave them the place of bread of poverty — bread of poverty — who is poor? This is Dovid the King — as it is written of him: 'for I am poor and needy' — and that bread is called matzah — the feminine [Malchus]" — etc. — see there — regarding how first they ate matzah which is bread from the Land of the Living — and afterwards bread from the heavens — etc. — and regarding how an infant knows nothing until it tastes the taste of bread — etc. — see there further. And see [Parshas Emor 226b] on Pesach and the grain — corresponding to the supernal chariot — the secret of the forefathers and Dovid the king — etc. And see there regarding matzah — which is the aspect of Malchus — and the elimination of chometz — which are the outer rulers appointed over the nations — etc. — and is called chometz — the yetzer hara — etc. — see there. And see [Zohar 255] regarding how first it is leil shimurim — and afterwards: "this night is for Hashem" — when zeh draws close to zos. And see there regarding the Pesach offering and the Musaf offering of Pesach. And see Zohar Tetzaveh [183] regarding matzah — which is healing — to enter and know the secret of faith — etc. And see Zohar Emor [95] regarding leil shimurim — the two unions of moon and sun.

segments.he: כי קורין וממשיכין הארת החכמה העליונה על ידי בחינת אתערותא דלתתא בחי' אשר תקרא אותם בחי' בי דינא הוא דמקדשי להו וע"כ אסורין בו ג"כ כל המלאכות חוץ ממלאכת אוכל נפש שהם בחי' יצירה ועשיה כידוע. ובשרשן הם כנגד אותיות ו"ה שבשם הקודש שהם בחי' תורה ומלכות כי מחמת שיש אז עדיין איזה אחיזה לבחי' החיצונים ח"ו ע"כ יש אז עדיין איזה בחי' מלחמה עמהם בכדי לברור מהם הניצוצות הק' ע"י כח התורה הק' והמלכות דקדושה כנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§2 — Zohar continued]
And regarding the freedom that must be shown on that night — and the matter of the four cups — corresponding to four redemptions — and the great joy of that night — and how one extends throughout the night. And see [Zohar 251] regarding how matzah repels all evil forces and wages war against them — in the manner of the mezuzah — etc. — etc. — and Hashem appointed for it seven blessings on the night of Pesach — etc. And see Zohar Chadash Parshas Ki Sisa regarding the four cups and four redemptions. And: Kiddush over wine corresponds to Dovid. Haggadah corresponds to Yaakov. Birchas HaMazon corresponds to Yitzchak. And: the Great Hallel corresponds to Avraham — ascending from below to above. Similarly: matzah corresponds to Dovid — etc. And see the Tikkunnim [Tikkun 5] — why is it called Heh? The lower [Heh] is half an amah — for it is called broken matzah — lechem oni — etc. And see Tikkunna Tlisra regarding broken matzah and whole matzah — and maror — and complete Hallel and incomplete Hallel at Pesach — etc.

[§3 — The Essential Principle]
I have now extended to cite several citations from the holy Zohar — and all are directed to our subject — as is self-evident. And the essential principle: at that time it was still before the receiving of the holy Torah — and the sitra achra had greatly strengthened through the sins of the generations: the Flood — the Dispersion — the people of Sodom. And therefore the souls that came — whose root was from a very high level — the sitra achra had overpowered them through the sins of the generations — and they came now to be rectified through the subjugation of Egypt — as explained in all the writings of the Ari. And this was the tremendous miracle and the great kindness of the Exodus from Egypt. For after receiving the Torah — through Torah study one gives strength to holy Malchus to overpower the sitra achra. But then it was before the Torah — and moreover the time of their redemption had not yet arrived — but the Holy One saw that they were in great danger of becoming sunken — G-d forbid — in the impurity of Egypt — and therefore He acted in the merit of the forefathers and the foremothers — and sent them a redeemer and savior — Moshe our teacher — and took them out through signs and awesome wonders and great awe — this is the revelation of the Shechinah — and they merited afterwards to receive the Torah — through which holy Malchus will ultimately overpower — until we merit the eternal redemption — speedily in our days. And therefore the matzah then was called lechem oni — bread of poverty — and it is a broken matzah — a broken heart — for the redemption was not from our side — through our good deeds and arousal from below — but through arousal from above — from the supreme kindness of Hashem — and in the merit of the forefathers — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ הותר גם מלאכת הוצאה והבערה והכל מחמת הבירורים הנ"ל כמובן מהמבואר לעיל בהלכות שבת. ובזה תבין ג"כ ענין הפלוגתא המבואר בהלכות שבת סימן רמ"ו לענין שביתת בהמו ביום טוב ועוד שאר ענינים כי א"א לבאר הכל מחמת האריכות.
segments.en:
[§4 — The Ari's Kavanos]
And see in the kavanos of the Ari of blessed memory — great wonders in all the matters of this holy night — and presumably all his holy words are directed and agree with the words of the holy Zohar — and we have no business with concealed matters to explain such exalted affairs. But even so — there are there also many matters that pertain to our subject even close to the plain meaning. And it is explained there: Pharaoh and Egypt correspond to the aspect of the upper back [oref] — the aspect of the back-side of supernal Daas — and they would suckle all the abundance — and suckle from all the aspects of the Yud of bloods — which are the aspects of pure blood and menstrual blood — and this is the secret of: "and I saw you wallowing in your blood" [Yechezkel 16:6] — that the sitra d'mosa — the supreme embodiment of impurity — was wallowing and suckling from the bloods — and [Hashem] said: "in your blood — live."

[§5 — Blood, the Soul, and the Mochin]
And according to our subject: the essential holy life-force is from the aspects of the mochin and daas — and the life-force of the soul clothed in the blood — for the blood is the soul — and the blood is the red bile — the foundation of fire — the aspect of the holy warmth and enthusiasm — the aspect of serving with holy vitality. And then they were suckling from the back of the Daas and the mochin — and from the bloods mentioned — which are the aspects of pure blood and impure blood — the aspect of the heat of the yetzer hara of the sitra achra. And sometimes it heats a person to actual sin — and this flows from its suckling from the impure blood — whose root is from the gevuros of the Nukva. And sometimes it clothes itself in mitzvos — and this flows from its suckling from the pure blood — whose root is from the chesed aspect.

segments.he: ומחמת שביו"ט נכנעין הקליפות שהם מבחי' עשו שעיקר אחיזתם מבחי' האכילה שאינה בקדושה כנ"ל. אבלביו"ט האכילה בקדושה בבחי' צדיק אוכל לשובע נפשו ע"כ נקרא אוכל נפש דייקא וזה שדרז"ל אך אשר יאכל לכל נפש הוא לבדו יעשה לכם ולא לעכו"ם כי אין לעכו"ם שום חלק באכילת יו"ט שהוא אכילה דקדושה בחי' אוכל נפש כנ"ל (ועיין סימן תקי"ב)
segments.en:
[§6 — Dam Pesach and Dam Milah]
And Hashem had compassion on us then in His great kindness — and gave us the blood of Pesach and the blood of milah — corresponding to the aspects of masculine and feminine — chesed and gevuros — as explained there and in the holy Zohar. And through this we merited to be saved from death to life — the aspect of: "in your blood — live" [ibid.] — we merited to receive great and lofty mochin — in the aspect of chayei hamelech [the life of the king] — as explained there. [And this secret is alluded to in the words of Rabbi Matya ben Cheresh — brought in Rashi's commentary on Parshas Bo.] And see there regarding the great mochin of gadlus and katnus of Abba and Imma that enter on this night — alluded to in the matzah and the maror and the cups — etc. — see there at length.

[§7 — Mochin Not in Order; Children Ask]
And since then the mochin enter not in order — and mochin d'gadlus precede the mochin d'katnus — therefore the Torah warned extensively regarding this — in the matter of the children's questions — and to also inform them of the wonders of the Exodus. And our Sages instituted several changes for this purpose — to arouse the children to ask.

segments.he: סימן תקכ"ז וכו'
segments.en:
[§8 — Grabbing Matzah; Not Until Dark; Table]
And our Sages taught: "one grabs matzah on the nights of Pesach so that the children will not sleep." And likewise one plays with them — with roasted grain and nuts — for this purpose. And even so: one does not begin Kiddush until it is dark. For all the mitzvahs and rectifications of this night pertain only to their proper time — the night specifically. And this: one sets his table [which is the aspect of a royal table] with beautiful vessels — etc. — and prepares one's seat — sitting in reclining fashion — the manner of freedom — for then Malchus is in the aspect of: "your king is a free person" [malkeich ben chorin] — as is known.

segments.he: וזה יו"ט שחל להיות בערב שבת לא יבשל בתחלה לצורך שבת וכו' וע"י עירוב מבשל בתחלה לשבת. כי מאחר שיו"ט קדוש ג"כ ומאיר בו הארת החכמה העליונה והמלכות עולה בעליות גדולות. הגם כי קדושת שבת גבוה ביותר אעפ"כ אין יו"ט מכין לשבת. אא"כ התחיל כבר בהכנה על שבת מעיו"ט ע"י עירוב תבשילין אז יש לו רשות לגמור הדבר גם ביו"ט ובאופן המבואר בשו"ע שם עיי"ש.
segments.en:
[§9 — The Four Cups]
And this is the aspect of the four cups — corresponding to the four expressions of redemption: v'hotzeisi — v'hitzalti — v'ga'alti — v'lakachti — and corresponding to the four kingdoms — and corresponding to the four cups of poison Hashem will give the nations in the future — and corresponding to the four cups of salvation for Israel — as explained in Bereishis Rabbah Parshas Vayeishev. Meaning: one draws the subduing of the kingdom of the sitra achra — and Israel is saved from its subjugation — and holy Malchus is exalted and receives great illumination from supernal Chochmah. And this: "and you shall know that I am Hashem your G-d" [Shemos 6:7].

[§10]
And therefore these four cups must be drunk in order — etc. — for when Malchus receives the illumination of holy Chochmah — it too becomes b'seder [in order] — as understood in Likutay Moharan [Siman 82].

segments.he: וע"כ צריך להיות העירוב בפת ותבשיל כזה שראוי ללפת בו את הפת לאפוקי דייסא. כי פת לחם מרמז על בחי' מלכות כידוע.
segments.en:
[§11]
And therefore even the poorest person in Israel does not eat until he reclines — and one does not withhold from him the four cups of wine — for then the aspect of holy Malchus is in the aspect of misken v'chacham — for from its own standpoint — as it were — it is in the aspect of poverty and lowliness. And yet Hashem in His great kindness illuminates upon him then great and wondrous mochin — and this is the secret of the matzah and four cups — which must be in reclining fashion — the manner of freedom — as stated.

[§12]
And therefore women are also obligated in all the mitzvahs of this night — for they too are from the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of "a woman who fears Hashem" [Mishlei 31:30] — and they too then receive a great illumination in their souls and intellect through the rectifications of this night.

segments.he: וע"כ שיעור הפת לכתחילה בכביצה שמרמז ג"כ על בחי' מלכות כידוע. והתבשיל שמלפת ומטעים בו את הפת מרמז להמשכת אור המוחין והדעת אל בחי' המלכות. כי הטעם הוא מבחי' חכמה כ"ש וחיך אוכל יטעם וחיך הוא מבחי' חכמה כידוע.
segments.en:
[§13 — The Order of the Seder]
And this: one pours the first cup and recites Kiddush and blesses Shehecheyanu. For the Kiddush cup alludes to the illumination of Chochmah — which is the aspect of Kodesh. And therefore one blesses on it: "Who chose us and sanctified us and gave us the Yom Tovim — holy convocations" — all due to the illumination of holy Chochmah that shines in them — and this is the essential holy life-force. Therefore one blesses Shehecheyanu — and this is alluded to in: Kadeish [sanctify].

[§14]
And then: Urchatz — one washes one's hands — to draw the waters of daas — the waters of holy Torah — and to thereby drive away the sitra achra and the impurity that seeks to cling to the holy hands with which one must eat and dip.

segments.he: וכתיב טוב טעם ודעת למדני. וע"כ לאפוקי דייסא שאין מלפתין בו הפת כי הני בבלאי טפשאי דאכלי נהמא בנהמא כשדרז"ל שם. טפשאי דייקא היפוך בחי' החכמה. וע"כ שיעור התבשיל בכזית שמרמז להמשכת אור החכמה כמובן בהזמר למבצע על ריפתא כזיתא וכביעתא וכו' ועיין במאורי אור.
segments.en:
[§15]
And one dips the karpas — which also alludes to the aspect of mochin — as explained in the writings — and blesses upon it.

segments.he: וע"כ מצוה על גדול העיר שהוא בחי' החכמה והבר דעת שבעיר לערב על כל בני עירו וכו' אבל לכתחילה אינם רשאים לסמוך על עירובו ואינם יוצאים בו כי אם אין אני לי מי לי כי בוודאי כל אחד כפי בחינתו צריך בעצמו לעסוק בזה כמבואר במ"א. וע"כ אברהם אבינו שהוא הראשון שהתחיל להאיר העולם ע"י שעסק בהמשכת התיקונים הנ"ל ע"כ ארז"ל קיים אברהם אבינו אפילו עירוב תבשילין:
segments.en:
[§16]
And then Yachatz — one breaks and splits the middle matzah — the large part — which alludes to the drawing of the mochin — the aspect of Vav — one hides for the afikoman — and the small part — which is the aspect of Dalet — the aspect of Malchus — one places on the seder plate and arranges the Haggadah over it. For the essential drawing of the mochin is through first rectifying the aspect of Malchus — as stated. And since the essential illumination and power of Malchus is through holy Chochmah and mochin — therefore at the time of breaking — one joins it to its upper completeness — which is the aspect of Yud — the aspect of Chochmah — as explained in the kavanos — see there.

[§17]
And then Maggid — one begins arranging the Haggadah and lifts the seder plate — the aspect of Malchus — with the matzos upon it — which allude to the three holy mochin — together with the other items which allude to the other holy attributes through which the mochin are drawn to Malchus — as brought in the kavanos.

segments.he: סימן תקכ"ט
segments.en:
[§18 — Ha Lachma Anya; Hospitality]
And one begins and says: Ha lachma anya — see in the kavanos and you will understand what pertains to our subject — and therefore: "all who are hungry — let them come and eat" — etc. For through acts of lovingkindness and charity and the invitation of poor guests — one creates arousal from below to lift the horn of holiness from its poverty and lowliness. And here it is the opposite — for Hashem had compassion on us only through arousal from above — and raised the poor one from the dust — etc. Therefore we too must conduct ourselves accordingly — to have compassion and show mercy to the poor — especially since Pesach corresponds to Avraham our father — and he was extraordinarily devoted to this attribute of inviting guests — as explained in the holy Torah and our Sages' teachings.

[§19]
And this: "this year here — next year in the Land of Israel" — etc. — for our Sages taught: "in Nisan they were redeemed and in Nisan they will be redeemed in the future." And our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Bo, 18] on the verse: "it is a night of watching for Hashem" — etc. — "and in it Eliyahu and the Mashiach grow great" — as it is said: "the watchman said: morning has come — and also night" — etc. — "on the day I made salvation for you — and on that night they knew that I am their Redeemer." Thus it is clear and understood: on every first night of Pesach the glimmer of the future redemption flows — and in this we comfort ourselves in our exiles — to draw upon ourselves now too the aspect of the freedom and the illumination of the future mochin.

segments.he: ומחמת כי יו"ט נקרא מקרא קודש כי מאיר בו ג"כ הארת החכמה שהוא בחיק קדש ע"כ מצוה לכבדו ולענגו כמו בשבת קדש. כי הכבוד והעונג נמשכין משם כמבואר בהלכות שבת הנ"ל ובמ"א. ולא עוד אלא שהשמחה נוהגת בו יותר משבת כמבואר בפוסקין ובכוונות כי בשבת נמשכת ההארה מלמעלה מעצמה אבל יו"ט ישראל הוא דמקדשי להו וע"כ שמחין בו ביותר וגם מטעם המבואר בכוונת ע"ש. וע"כ לובשין אז בגדים טובים ביותר ואז"ל כיצד משמחן וכו' והנשים בבגדי צבעונים. כי מחמת שקדושת יו"ט הוא מבחי' מילוי הירח בחי' עשה ירח למועדים שזה בחי' חדתותי דסיהרא שהחמה עושה מלבוש להלבנה כמבואר בהמעשה של הבנים שנחלפו.
segments.en:
[§20]
And therefore also at the end of the Haggadah one concludes: "next year in Yerushalayim." For certainly — without any doubt — it would be fitting to be so — according to the illumination of the exalted holiness that shines upon every person of Israel on this night.

[§21 — Mah Nishtanah]
And then the children are aroused to ask Mah Nishtanah — for even they — according to the smallness of their understanding — feel a great change and new illumination in their souls and intellect — and are aroused to ask their father: what is this and why? And our Sages arranged them in four questions and clothed in them great secrets — and all is founded on the great rectifications drawn on this night in a wondrous and awesome manner — as explained in the kavanos.

segments.he: וע"כ לובשין אז בגדים מכובדים ביותר:
segments.en:
[§22]
And therefore even two Torah scholars ask each other Mah Nishtanah — etc. — for through the questions and answers and the pilpul — one breaks the power of the klippos and the sitra achra — which seek to conceal and hide the great illumination of the Exodus — and through the questions and answers and the engagement in this — one breaks their power and adds strength to holy Malchus.

segments.he: ומחמת שעיקר כח המלכות דק' הוא ע"י עסק התורה כנ"ל ע"כ צריכין גם ביו"ט להרבות בעסק התורה כשארז"ל חציו לה' וחציו לכם: וע"כ חייב להאכיל ג"כ את העניים ולשמח את לבם ביו"ט. כי אז עולה בחי' המלכות דק' מבחי' עניות ודלות לבחי' עשירות שהוא בחי' הארת החכמה העליונה כנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§22b]
And therefore all who increase the recounting of the Exodus — this is praised — and it is brought in the kavanos: praised with chesed — for one stirs the great chesed that was revealed and drawn then — and through this one revives and sustains and draws holiness and strength to overpower one's inclinations — and to subdue the sitra achra — and to draw close to holiness — even those who are now still distant from Torah study — such as simple people — etc. — as understood in detail in Likutay Moharan [Siman 78] — see there.

[§22c]
And through this is also understood what we wrote above — that through the narrating of the Haggadah and the Exodus — the difficulties are resolved and the judgments are sweetened — for through the great chesed that is revealed through this — as stated — one also breaks the power of the yetzer hara — which grows strong and nurses only through the concealment and hiding of knowledge — as understood in the discourse Vayisav [Siman 62] — see there.

segments.he: וע"כ חייבים ב"ד להעמיד שמשים ברגלים להשגיח על העם שלא יבואו לדבר עבירה כי כשהמלכות דסט"א שהיא היצה"ר רואה גודל עליית מלכות דקדושה ביו"ט ע"י אתערותא דלתתא של קדושת ישראל שזה בחינת גודל השמחה של ישראל ביו"ט כנ"ל אז מתגרה בהם ביותר ורוצה להביאם לדבר עבירה ח"ו וע"כ מחויבים ב"ד שהם חכמי העדה להשגיח ע"ז ברגלים ביותר. וזה שסיים בשו"ע אלא יהיו כולם קדושים. ר"ל מקושרים אל השכל דקדושה שהוא בחי' קודש כנ"ל
segments.en:
[§22d — Rabbi Eliezer; The Chachamim; Siddur RYK]
And this: the story of Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah and Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Tarfon — and they were recounting and illuminating the Exodus all that night — [which is the aspect of complete Heavenly Kingship] — until their students came and said: our teachers — the time for the morning reading of Shema — Krias Shema of Shacharis — has arrived — which is the aspect of the complete acceptance of the yoke of Heavenly Kingship and the drawing of the mochin — as is known. And this: Raban Gamliel ben Azaryah said — etc. — "all the days of your life" — the days of your life: those are the days — when one merits the drawing of the mochin — which are the essential life — the aspect of the literal light of day — as explained within. "All the days of your life" — to include the nights — the aspect of darkness — the withdrawal of the mochin which are the light — even then one must remember the Exodus — for the beginning of the Egyptian redemption was specifically at night — as stated. And the Chachamim say: "the days of your life" = this world — "all the days of your life" = to bring in the Messianic era — for then the complete redemption will arrive and these rectifications will flow in their ultimate fullness — even so one will still recall the Exodus — for it is the first beginning and first foundation of Israel's redemption — and through it Israel merited to receive the Torah — through which we sustain ourselves in all the exiles — and through it we will merit the complete redemption. And everything is in the power of that first beginning — the Exodus through Moshe our teacher. And see in the Siddur of Rav Yaakov Kopel [Siddur RYK] — who arranged the four sons in one way also according to this approach.

[§23 — The Second Cup and the Four Sons]
And this: our Sages taught: "one pours the second cup — and here the child asks." For with the first cup of Kiddush the child did not yet feel any change — for on every Shabbos and Yom Tov one must make Kiddush — and regarding the other changes he had not yet been moved to express his question. But here — with the second cup — which corresponds to the aspect of Binah — "from which judgments are aroused" — as is known — and from there is the root of all difficulties and questions — therefore the child is also aroused to bring his intellect and mochin into actual expression through the questions he asks his father. And through answering him at length and arranging the entire order of the Haggadah — through this the judgments are sweetened and great sweetened mochin are drawn. And this is what one says: "we were slaves" — etc. — the kingdom of the sitra achra overpowered and enslaved us — etc. — "and Hashem took us out" — etc. — "with a mighty hand" — [for we were not deserving of this] — and: "Hashem gave signs" — etc. — in Egypt — in Pharaoh and all his house — before our eyes — meaning He subdued the kingdom of the sitra achra completely — and: "us He took out from there" — etc. — meaning the essential purpose of the Exodus was to bring us to the Land of Israel and fulfil there the entire Torah — for many mitzvahs depend on the Land of Israel — and also the Land of Israel is the aspect of Heavenly Kingship and the drawing of the mochin — for its air makes one wise. "And Hashem commanded us to do all these statutes" — [which are the aspect of Chochmah — as brought in the kavanos] — "to fear Hashem our G-d" — [the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of the awe of Malchus — and this is the purpose and beginning of Chochmah] — "for our good — all the days" — [the aspect of the attributes — to give them life] — "to give us life — as this day." And: "it shall be righteousness for us — that we observe all this commandment before Hashem our G-d — as He commanded us" [Devarim 6:25] — meaning: one should not think that since we accepted the yoke of Heavenly Kingship and observe His mitzvahs — we are therefore deserving of attainment and drawing down of the mochin. For this is not the way — as stated — but everything must be considered only as righteousness and free gift. And: "that we observe all this commandment" — the aspect of the yoke of Heavenly Kingship and the observance of mitzvahs — for action is the aspect of Malchus. And: "before Hashem our G-d" — the drawing of the mochin — to know and feel in one's mind and heart His G-dliness — as if seeing Him eye to eye — standing before Him. And: "as He commanded us" — for He truly commanded us to fulfil the mitzvahs in this manner — and this itself shall be considered for us a great righteousness and free gift — as stated.

segments.he: סימן תק"ל וכו'
segments.en:
[§24]
Thus the entire above is explained at some length. And our Sages summed up the entire reply to the wise son in brief words — as befits them. And this too is alluded to in the phrase k'halachos haPesach.

[§25]
For Pesach is translated as chayyim [life] — as it is written: "zevach Pesach" — and its Aramaic translation: devach chayyim [sacrifice of life] — and so in many other instances — as Rashi explained. Meaning: through this one teaches and tells him that everything is only through mercy and compassion and life — the aspect of tzedakah — as stated.

segments.he: הלכות חול המועד. עיין בכוונות, ומחמת שהמשכת הארת קדושת יו"ט הוא על ידי קדושת ישראל שהם בעלי בחירה ולפעמים מכריעים לצד הטוב ולפעמים להיפך ח"ו ואז גובר ח"ו כח המלכות דסט"א ח"ו שמזה נמשך כל הגליות שהוא בחי' אבידה כמ"ש צאן אובדות וכו' וכן ובאו האובדים בארץ אשור וכו' ע"כ בפסח וסוכות יש בהם ימים שנקראים חול המועד שזה בחינת תיקון הבחירה שכלול משני צדדים, וכן חול המועד כלול מבחי' חול שיש בו אחיזה להסט"א ח"ו ומבחי' קדושת מועד ויו"ט שאז נכנע כח הסט"א הרבה כי הם ימים טובים וקדושים כנ"ל.
segments.en:
[§26 — The Wicked Son]
And this: the wicked son — what does he say? — for he excluded himself from the community and threw off the yoke of Heavenly Kingship — and is therefore utterly remote from holy Chochmah — for he is in the aspect of: "the fool desires not wisdom" — and moreover thinks himself wise — in the aspect of: "do you see a man wise in his own eyes?" [Mishlei 26:12] — etc. And therefore he is placed next to the wise son — who is his exact opposite.

segments.he: ובחול המועד אע"פ שהוא ג"כ בחי' קדש וע"כ הזהירו רז"ל מאד על המבזה את המועדות ופירש"י דר"ל חול המועד, אעפ"כ יש בו ג"כ מבחי' חול ומותר אף במלאכת עבודה בכל מה שהתירו חכמים דוקא, כי מחמת שהם חכמים ומקושרים אל החכמה והשכל דקדושה בתמידות אף בימי החול וזה ע"י בחירתם הטוב שבחרו בחיים והכריעו עצמם לצד הקדושה לגמרי ע"כ יש להם כח ושכל לברר איזה מלאכות מותרות בחול המועד ואיזה אסורות:
segments.en:
[§27]
And the wicked son is the aspect of wicked Esav. And therefore one blunts his teeth [hakheh es shinav] — for the thirty-two teeth correspond to the thirty-two paths of Chochmah — as is known. For in truth great wisdom and holiness are needed to chew food properly and clarify all the aspects of holy clarifications — for "all of them are clarified through thought." And Esav damaged holy Chochmah — therefore he said: "feed me now" — for he ate with such great craving and haste that he did not pause to chew his food with his teeth properly — but in a manner of gulping. Therefore: one blunts this wicked one's teeth — for what does he need teeth for? — and it also alludes to dishonoring and despising his evil wisdom — for there is more hope for a fool than for him.

[§28]
And one says to him: "it is because of this that Hashem acted for me" — "for me" specifically — and in the way of wit and elegance one may say: li [for me] alludes to the connection of lower Chochmah with upper Chochmah — the aspect of the filling of the moon — as explained in Likutay Moharan [Siman 91].

segments.he: וע"כ התירו אפילו מלאכת אומן לצורך דבר האבד היינו שלא יפסיד מהקרן, כי ממון ישראל בשרשו יקר מאד כמבואר במ"א וכמובן גם מהמבואר לעיל בחי' בצל החכמה בצל הכסף וכשארז"ל לעולם ידרים אפילו הרוצה להתעשר כי מאחר שמתחכם מתעשר נמצא כי ממון ועשירות ישראל יש בו מבחי' מלכות דקדושה בחי' עשיר ברשים ימשול ומבחי' ניצוצי החכמה דקדושה שמשם עיקר שורש העשירות דקדושה וע"כ התירו לעשות בשביל זה מלאכה גם בחול המועד להציל הניצוצות דקדושה המלובשין בממון ישראל שלא יבואו לידי אבידה והיזק ח"ו שזה נמשך מצד הסט"א שמשם כל ההזיקות והגליות והאבידות ר"ל, וגם כי יש ניצוצות קדושות שהם בחי' אבידה וגלות בין הסט"א ר"ל ועיקר עלייתם דייקא ע"י הבירורים הקדושים שנתבררין על ידי המלאכות שעושין ישראל בחול כנ"ל ויש ניצוצות כאלו שאין להם כח לעלות ע"י מלאכת חול שגבר אז ביותר כח הסט"א ר"ל והם עולים דייקא ע"י המלאכות שהתירו חז"ל לעשות בחוה"מ לצורך דבר האבד ואז עולין בכח קדושת יו"ט והכנעת הסט"א שיש בחוה"מ ג"כ ובכח קדושת המלאכה שעושה אז ע"פ דעת חז"ל בכדי להציל ממונו מהיזק ואבידה ח"ו.
segments.en:
[§29]
And this: "it is because of this Hashem acted for me specifically" — for I am among those who believed in Moshe our teacher — and then one could ascend from Egypt through Moshe our teacher — who could elevate even the wicked and bring them back to good — through his connecting lower Chochmah with upper Chochmah — as explained there.

[§30]
But those who excluded themselves entirely from the community — G-d forbid — certainly if they had been there they would not have been redeemed. And this is explained in the holy Torah in Parshas Bo: "and it shall come about that your children will say to you: what is this service to you?" — and it is written: "you shall say." And it is not written: "you shall say to them." For: "answer not a fool according to his folly" — and it is forbidden to gaze upon the face of a wicked person — and to speak with him.

segments.he: וע"כ אין היתר רק אם נזדמן לו כך שמוכרח לעשות מלאכה בחול המועד בשביל דבר האבד, אבל אם כיון לעשות מלאכתו במועד אפילו בדבר האבד אסור ומאבדין אותה ממנו, כי מאחר שהיה יכול להציל הדבר גם בחול וכיון לעשות מלאכתו במועד אזי פוגם עי"ז בקדושת יו"ט, ולא די שאין הניצוצות עולין עי"ז אף גם להיפך ח"ו ע"כ מאבדין אותה הימנו, ומזה תבין גם לשאר ענינים שהתירו רז"ל במועד כגון לצורך המועד וכו' כמבואר מזה בשו"ע בפרטיות וכן עוד איזה ענינים המבוארים שם.
segments.en:
[§31]
But even so — in words of Torah it is written: "answer a fool according to his folly — lest he become wise in his own eyes" [Mishlei 26:5] — especially this wicked one who is wise in his own eyes — as stated. Therefore it is written: va-amartem [and you shall say] — meaning: he himself speaks — for everyone who has not said these three things on Pesach has not fulfilled his obligation. Therefore: "va-amartem: the Pesach sacrifice is to Hashem" — and its Aramaic: devach chayyim — etc. — for this is only through His mercy — He Who passed over the houses of the children of Israel — "the houses of the children of Israel" — they are the aspect of holy Malchus — called beis [house] — in the aspect of: "through wisdom a house is built" — as stated many times. And: "in striking Egypt — and our houses He saved." Thus it is explained: specifically the houses of the children of Israel — which were attached to holiness — He saved — and this too through His compassion and in the merit of the blood of Pesach that they placed on the lintel and two doorposts. But such wicked ones as these — had they been there — they would not have been saved and redeemed.

[§32 — The Simple Son]
And this: the simple son — what does he say? "What is this?" — for he too feels a new illumination in his soul — and lacks the sharpness to delve deeply into his wisdom. But at least he knows that everything flows through the holy Torah — which is the aspect of mah — through which holy Malchus — the aspect of zos — receives strength to prevail — etc. — as stated. But it is difficult for him — for it was still before the receiving of the Torah — and how did they merit this?

segments.he: וזה ג"כ החילוק בין מלאכת מעשה הדיוט שאין בה חכמה כ"כ והכל יכולין לעשות אותה ובין מלאכת אומן שיש בה מבחי' החכמה כ"ש מלא אותם חכמת לב לעשות כל מלאכת וכו' וכיוצא בזה עוד הרבה כמבואר בפרשת ויקהל, ועיקר בירורי הניצוצות הוא על ידי בחי' החכמה כי כולהו במחשבה איתברירו כמובא לעיל כמה פעמים.
segments.en:
[§33]
And one says to him: "with a mighty hand Hashem took us out of Egypt" — etc. — meaning: for this very reason — it being before the receiving of the Torah — Hashem truly needed to reveal His mighty hand. And: "because Pharaoh hardened himself against sending us" — for this very reason — because it was before the receiving of the Torah and Israel's merit was not sufficient — and the sitra achra sought to prevail through their aspects of the firstborn of the sitra achra. And: "Hashem killed all the firstborn in Egypt — from the firstborn of man to the firstborn of beast" — and we then merited the sanctity of the firstborn — as stated [see kavanos].

segments.he: ומה ששבועות הוא רק יום אחד מן התורה עיין זוה"ק, ולדרכינו יובן ג"כ קצת כי מאחר שהוא זמן מתן תורתינו שעל ידה נתתקן כח הבחירה בשלימות וכמ"ש אני אמרתי אלהים אתם וכו' וכשדרז"ל חרות על הלוחות חירות ממלאך המות ומשיעבוד מלכיות וכו' ע"כ הוא רק יום אחד כי הוא בחי' העוה"ב שנאמר עליו והיה יום אחד יוודע לה' וכו'. אך אעפ"כ מאחר שקבלת התורה בעצמו היה ע"י טוב בחירתינו ע"כ קדושתו שוה לשאר הימים טובים לענין מלאכת אוכל נפש וכיוצא:
segments.en:
[§34 — The Son Who Cannot Ask]
And this: the son who does not know how to ask — who corresponds to the aspect of Malchus in its poverty and lowliness — when it has drifted from its Beloved — as it were — and has no opening of the mouth to ask anything. And from this itself comes the strengthening of the sitra achra — and it has a mouth — to the wicked son — G-d forbid. For: "when she is filled — the ruined one is desolated" [Yeshayahu 27:11]. And therefore: "you open for him" — for on this night one is obligated to illuminate and open a gate of wisdom even for such people — for the great illumination that shines then enables this — and this is the aspect of: "open your mouth for the mute" [Mishlei 31:8] — the aspect of: "when Your words open — it gives light" [Tehillim 119:130]. And this: "and you shall tell your son on that day" — "Haggadah alludes to wisdom" [Zohar, Parshas Shelach 161] — meaning: one draws the illumination of Chochmah even upon him — for at this time it is drawn upon Malchus with wondrous illumination. Therefore: "it is because of this that Hashem acted for me" — as stated. And within all this is also alluded the answer to the wicked son — whose essential strengthening is against holy Malchus — as stated.

[§35]
And this: "one might think from Rosh Chodesh" — for from then the moon begins to fill — and the illumination of these rectifications begins to flow — especially from Rosh Chodesh Nisan when a great illumination flows — as stated. [Therefore:] "the Torah says: 'on that day'" — etc. — "I said it only" — etc. — for then these rectifications flow in wondrous fullness — and that is the primary time to recount the Exodus and to make known His wonders to each person according to their aspect.

segments.he: וזה בחי' אסרו חג שמצוה להרבות בו קצת באכילה ושתיה כמבואר בשו"ע סי' תכ"ט ועיין בסימן תצ"ד, כי קדושת שבת אף שקדושתו גבוה מאד וצריכין להמשיך קדושת שבת על כל ששת ימי החול בבחי' זכרהו מאחד בשבת, היינו להשתוקק אחר קדושת שבת בכל ימי השבוע ולעשות הכנות לקדושת שבת בכל מה שאפשר לו בבחי' מחד בשביך לשבתא, אבל להמשיך איזה בחינה מקדושת שבת לחול בפועל היינו על ידי אכילה ושתיה של חול זה א"א מחמת שקדושת שבת הוא רק מלמעלה כי משמיא הוא דמקדשי ליה וקדושתו גבוה מאד ועל ידו קיום כל הבריאה וקיום כל ימי החול. אבל אעפ"כ הוא רחוק מאד מבחי' החול.
segments.en:
[§36 — Beginning with Shame; Idolaters]
And now one begins with shame again in a different way. And says: "at first our forefathers were idolaters — and now the Omnipresent drew us close to His service." And this is a sufficient answer and essential knowledge for every person — not to be surprised at what happens to them through the power of their free choice — for sometimes one is proper and sometimes disqualified — etc. — for this is rooted in us from the fact that our forefathers were at first idol-worshippers like all nations. But in His kindness He drew us close — and chose us from all nations — etc. And therefore the yetzer hara and all the nations — which are the aspect of the sitra achra — engage with us most — but even this one must know: that now — this specific moment [v'achshav] — the Omnipresent drew us close to His service. And the word v'achshav limits the time very precisely — meaning: now specifically — on this very day and hour and moment when we are speaking and engaging with it — for one must believe that on this night — and especially in this very hour when Israel sit at the Seder and engage in the recounting of the Exodus and fulfil the mitzvahs of this night — at that moment a great illumination flows from above upon each person of Israel — to the point that each one can truly draw close to the service of Hashem — even one who has passed through whatever he has passed through.

[§37]
And this is what the Haggadah explains — that Yehoshua specifically — [who is the aspect of the moon — and to him and his aspect the matter most pertains — for the moon is sometimes deficient and sometimes full — and from this is the root of human free choice] — said to all the people: thus says Hashem — etc. — "your forefathers dwelt across the river" — etc. — and worshipped other gods — "and I took your father Avraham and led him throughout all the land of Canaan" — which is most conducive to drawing the sanctity of these rectifications — "and I multiplied his seed" — [for there specifically he merited children] — "and I gave him Yitzchak — and to Yitzchak I gave Yaakov and Esav — and I gave to Esav Har Se'ir to inherit it" — Har Se'ir is the aspect of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — which are Esav's portion — "and Yaakov and his sons went down to Egypt" — to be refined there in the fire of the subjugation — and to clarify from there the holy sparks — until they merited all that they merited — as stated there in the passage. And the Lavan situation was harder than Esav — as our Sages taught: the majority of sons follow after their mother's brother — and Lavan was a harder and more evil klippa than Esav — and it was necessary to go there and subdue the sitra achra at its root — and to clarify from there all of Israel's holiness — the Foremothers and the Tribes.

segments.he: וענין סעודת מוצאי שבת מבואר לעיל, אבל קדושת יו"ט מאחר שיש לנו ג"כ איזה חלק בהמשכת קדושתו בבחי' אשר תקראו אותם כנ"ל ע"כ צריכין לעשות איסור וקשר לחג להמשיך איזה בחי' מהמשכת התיקונים והארות של יו"ט גם על ימי החול, ועיין בכונות ותבין ביותר. ועל כן בשבועות שמאיר בו הארה יתירה ביותר וע"כ אינו אלא יום אחד ואין בו חול המועד כנ"ל ע"כ גם האסרו חג שלו קדושתו גבוה ביותר כי הוא יום טבחו וכמבואר בפוסקים:
segments.en:
[§37b — Baruch Shomer]
And this: Baruch shomer havtachaso l'Yisrael — Baruch Hu [Blessed is He Who kept His promise to Israel — Blessed is He]. For this matter too is both concealed and revealed — for beyond what is visible to us from the miracles and wonders Hashem did for us in every generation — beyond all this there are endless hidden matters in the aspect of: "Who performs great wonders alone" [Tehillim 136:4] — and our Sages taught: the person who experienced the miracle does not recognize his own miracle [ein baal hanes makir b'niso] — and the essential aspect is the great war each person has with the yetzer hara — which is a constant warfare — as our Sages expounded on the verse: "He saves the poor man from one stronger than him" [Tehillim 35:10] — and our Sages taught: every day the yetzer of a person grows stronger over him — and were it not that Hashem helps him — he could not prevail — as it is said: "the wicked man lurks for the righteous" — etc. — "and Hashem will not abandon him to his hand" [Tehillim 37:32–33]. And this: Hashem calculated the appointed end to fulfil His word — etc. — "and also the nation they shall serve — I shall judge" [Bereishis 15:14] — and our Sages expounded: to include the other kingdoms — etc. — "and afterwards they shall go out with great wealth" — for in the end the descent will turn into a great ascent — and the holy people of Israel will ascend to a wondrous level without measure.

[§37c — V'hi She'amda; Tzei U'lemad]
[One holds the cup — which alludes to Malchus — as is known — and says:] V'hi she'amda l'avoseinu v'lanu [And this is what stood for our forefathers and for us] — etc. — that in every generation they rise up against us to destroy us — literally G-d forbid — and the Holy One, blessed be He, saves us from their hand. Tzei u'lemad [Go out and learn] — what Lavan the Aramean sought to do to Yaakov our father — etc. — for Yaakov our father merited the birthright and the blessing — which alludes to the sanctity of these rectifications — and for this: "Esav hated Yaakov" — etc. — and Yaakov our father was compelled to flee to Lavan — and it is written there: "and Yitzchak sent Yaakov" — etc. — "to Lavan" — etc. — "the brother of Rivka — the mother of Yaakov and Esav." Through this the Torah hinted to us: for the root of the evil in Esav was from Lavan — as our Sages taught: most sons follow after their mother's brother — and Lavan was a harder and more evil klippa than Esav — and it was necessary to go there and subdue the sitra achra at its root — and to clarify all of Israel's holiness — the Foremothers and the Tribes.

segments.he: סימן תקמ"ט וכו'
segments.en:
[§38]
And therefore when [Yaakov] sent to Esav: "with Lavan I dwelt" — etc. — great fear fell upon him — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: הלכות תשעה באב וכו'. כי מחמת שבד' ימים אלו גברה הסט"א מאד וע"כ ארעו בהם הצרות והחורבות ע"כ אסורין באכילה ושתיה וצריכין להתענות בהם ולעורר הלבבות לתשובה בכדי להכניע כח הסטר"א בחי' עשו הרשע וסטרין דיליה שעיקר אחיזתם בבחי' אכילה ושתיה. כנ"ל כמבואר בזוה"ק על פסוק בננו זה סורר ומורה וכו' זולל וסובא שזה היה עיקר הגורם של הצרות והחורבנות. רק תענית תשעה באב (שבו חרב הבית שני פעמים) חמור מכולם כי הוא בסוד כי נגע בכף ירך יעקב בגיד הנשה כמבואר בזוה"ק. ומי לנו גדול מיעקב אבינו שהוא כלל נשמות ישראל ונכנס בעובי הקורה ללחום בעד כלל ישראל עם שרו של עשו בעצמו שהוא השטן והיצה"ר וגבר עליו כ"ש כי שרית עם אלהים ועם אנשים ותוכל והכרח לברכו אעפ"כ וירא כי לא יכול לו ויגע בכף ירכו וכו' ומאז נרמז בחי' החורבן והתענית של תשעה באב ע"כ הוא חמור מכולם. וחייבין בו בחמשה עינויים ומפסיקין מבעוד יום ואפילו עוברות ומניקות מתענות בו כיוצא בה עוד. וע"כ משנכנס אב ממעטין בשמחה שהיא בחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל בשלימות. ובר ישראל דאית ליה דינא בהדי עכו"ם לישתמיט מיניה כי גבר אז כח הסט"א כחו של עשו. ושבוע שחל בו ט' באב חמור עוד ביותר כמבואר בשו"ע לענין כמה דינים והכל מבואר ע"פ הנ"ל: וע"כ אין מברכין על פרי או על מלבוש שהחיינו בין המצרים. כי אין מאיר בהם בחי' החכמה שהיא עיקר החיות בהתגלות. וזה בחי' במחשכים הושיבני
